name: NominalDiameter
description: Nominal diameter of the pipe segment.

name: Abnormal Berthing Factor
definition: Risk assessed safety factor

name: Above Deck Projected Wind End
definition: End on projected windage area above the main deck

name: Above Deck Projected Wind Side
definition: Side on projected windage area above the main deck

name: Above Ground
definition: Indication whether this building storey is fully above ground (TRUE), or below ground (FALSE), or partially above and below ground (UNKNOWN) - as in sloped terrain.

name: Acceptance Date
definition: Date on which the element is accepted by the manager or administrator.

name: Access Cover Load Rating
definition: The load rating of the access cover (which may be a value or an alphanumerically defined class rating).

name: Access Cover Material
definition:
The material from which the access cover to the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

name: Access Length Or Radius
definition: The length of the chamber access cover or, where the plan shape of the cover is circular, the radius.

name: Access Type
definition: Defines the types of access (or cover) to a tank that may be specified.Note that covers are generally specified for rectangular tanks. For cylindrical tanks, access will normally be via a manhole.

name: Access Width
definition: The width of the chamber access cover where the plan shape of the cover is not circular.

name: Accident Response
definition: Accident response chosen for the asset

name: Accuracy Class
definition: A designation assigned to an instrument transformer the current (or voltage) error and phase displacement of which remain within specified limits under prescribed conditions of use (IEC 321-01-24).

name: Accuracy Grade
definition: The grade of accuracy.

name: Accuracy Of Fire Sensor
definition: The accuracy of the sensor.

name: Accuracy Quality Expected
definition: A measure of the accuracy quality of survey points as expected expressed in percentage terms.

name: Accuracy Quality Obtained
definition: A measure of the accuracy quality of survey points as obtained expressed in percentage terms.

name: Acidity Concentration
definition: Maximum CaCO3 equivalent that would neutralize the acid.

name: Acknowledge
definition: Indicates acknowledgement status where False indicates acknowlegement is required and outstanding, True indicates condition has been acknowedged, and Unknown indicates no acknowledgement is required.  Upon resetting the condition, then acknowledgement reverts to Unknown.

name: Acoustic Rating
definition:
Acoustic rating for this object.
It is provided according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ratio (instead of providing full sound absorption values).

name: Acquisition Date
definition: The date that the manufactured item was purchased.

name: Acquisition Method
definition: The means by which survey data was acquired.

name: ACResistance
definition: The resistance under AC.

name: Action Bar Movement Length
definition: The movement of the bar that pulls the point of a turnout.

name: Activation
definition: Identifies the predefined methods of sprinkler activation from which that required may be set.

name: Activation Temperature
definition: The temperature at which the object is designed to activate.

name: Actor Category
definition: Designation of the category into which the actors in the population belong.

name: Actual Erection Date
definition: Date erected.

name: Actual Production Date
definition: Production date (stripped from form).

name: Actuation Type
definition: Enumeration that identifies the different types of dampers.

name: Actuator Application
definition: Indicates application of actuator.

name: Actuator Input Power
definition: Maximum input power requirement.

name: Actuator Status
definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

name: Added Mass Coefficient Method
definition: Method used to determine the Added Mass Coefficient used for design

name: Additional Processing
definition: Any additional or special processing requirements on the associated cargo.

name: Addressablility
definition: The type of addressability.

name: Address Lines
definition: The postal address.NOTE  A postal address may occupy several lines (or elements) when recorded. It is expected that normal usage will incorporate relevant elements of the following address concepts: A location within a building (e.g. 3rd Floor) Building name (e.g. Interoperability House) Street number (e.g. 6400) Street name (e.g. Alliance Boulevard). Typical content of address lines may vary in different countries.

name: Adjustment Designation
definition: The desgnation on the device for the adjustment.

name: Adjustment Value Type
definition: The type of adjustment value that is applied through the property set. This determines the properties that should be asserted (see below).

name: Admixtures Description
definition: Description of the admixtures added to the concrete mix.

name: Agreement Date
definition: The date on which the version of the agreement became applicable.

name: Agreement Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of property agreement from which the type required may be set.

name: Agreement Version
definition: The version number of the agreement that is identified.

name: Air Conditioning
definition: Indication whether this space requires air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Air Conditioning Central
definition:
Indication whether the space  requires a central air conditioning provided (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
It should only be given, if the property "AirConditioning" is set to TRUE.

name: Air Diffusion Performance Index
definition: The Air Diffusion Performance Index (ADPI) is used for cooling mode conditions. If several measurements of air velocity and air temperature are made throughout the occupied zone of a space, the ADPI is the percentage of locations where measurements were taken that meet the specifications for effective draft temperature and air velocity.

name: Air Exchange Rate
definition: Loads from the air exchange rate.

name: Air Exchange Rate Time History
definition: Loads from the air exchange rate.

name: Air Flow Configuration
definition: Air flow configuration type of cooled beam.

name: Air Flow Leakage
definition: Volumetric leakage flow rate.

name: Air Flow Rate
definition:
Air flow rate.

Volumetric air flow rate.

name: Air Flow Rate History
definition: Volumetric flow rate.

name: Air Flow Rate Range
definition: Possible range of airflow that can be delivered.

name: Air Flowrate Versus Flow Control Element
definition: Air flowrate versus flow control element position at nominal pressure drop.

name: Air Handler Construction
definition: Enumeration defining how the air handler might be fabricated.

name: Air Handler Fan Coil Arrangement
definition: Enumeration defining the arrangement of the supply air fan and the cooling coil.

name: Air Handling Name
definition: The name of the air side system.IfcRelServicesBuildings should be used to reference the correct AirHandlingSystem (IfcSystem)

name: Air Particle Filter Type
definition:
A panel dry type extended surface filter is a dry-type air filter with random fiber mats or blankets in the forms of pockets, V-shaped or radial pleats, and include the following:CoarseFilter: Filter with a efficiency lower than 30% for atmosphere dust-spot.
CoarseMetalScreen: Filter made of metal screen.
CoarseCellFoams: Filter made of cell foams.
CoarseSpunGlass: Filter made of spun glass.
MediumFilter: Filter with an efficiency between 30-98% for atmosphere dust-spot.
MediumElectretFilter: Filter with fine electret synthetic fibers.
MediumNaturalFiberFilter: Filter with natural fibers.
HEPAFilter: High efficiency particulate air filter.
ULPAFilter: Ultra low penetration air filter.
MembraneFilters: Filter made of membrane for certain pore diameters in flat sheet and pleated form.
A renewable media with a moving curtain viscous filter are random-fiber media coated with viscous substance in roll form or curtain where fresh media is fed across the face of the filter and the dirty media is rewound onto a roll at the bottom or to into a reservoir:
RollForm: Viscous filter used in roll form.
AdhesiveReservoir: Viscous filter used in moving curtain form.
A renewable moving curtain dry media filter is a random-fiber dry media of relatively high porosity used in moving-curtain(roll) filters.
An electrical filter uses electrostatic precipitation to remove and collect particulate contaminants.

name: Air Pressure Drop Curve
definition:
Air pressure drop as a function of air flow rate.

Air pressure drop versus air-flow rate.

name: Air Pressure Drop Curve History
definition: Air pressure drop curve, pressure drop – flow rate curve, AirPressureDrop = f (AirflowRate).

name: Air Pressure Drop Curves
definition: Air pressure drop as function of air flow rate.

name: Air Pressure Range
definition: Allowable air static pressure range at the entrance of the air terminal box.

name: Air Pressurization
definition: Indication whether the space is required to have pressurized air (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Air Resistance Curve
definition: Air resistance curve (w/ fan only); Pressure = f ( flow rate).

name: Air Side System Distribution Type
definition: This enumeration defines the basic types of air side systems (e.g., SingleDuct, DualDuct, Multizone, etc.).

name: Air Side System Type
definition: This enumeration specifies the basic types of possible air side systems (e.g., Constant Volume, Variable Volume, etc.).

name: Air Terminal Location
definition: Location  (a single type of diffuser can be used for multiple locations); high means close to ceiling.

name: Air Terminal Mounting Type
definition:
The way the air terminal is mounted to the ceiling, wall, etc.Surface: mounted to the surface of something (e.g., wall, duct, etc.).
Flat flush: mounted flat and flush with a surface.
Lay-in: mounted in a lay-in type ceiling (e.g., a dropped ceiling grid).

name: Air Terminal Shape
definition: Shape of the air terminal. Slot is typically a long narrow supply device with an aspect ratio generally greater than 10 to 1.

name: Air Volume
definition: Relative volume of air stratum constituents.

name: Alarm Condition
definition: Table mapping alarm condition identifiers to descriptive labels, which may be used for interpreting Pset_AlarmPHistory.Condition.

name: Alkalinity Concentration
definition: Maximum alkalinity concentration (maximum sum of concentrations of each of the negative ions substances measured as CaCO3).

name: Allowable Hull Pressure
definition: Allowable contact pressure between fender and hull

name: Ambient Design Dry Bulb Temperature
definition: Ambient design dry bulb temperature used for selecting the cooling tower.

name: Ambient Design Wet Bulb Temperature
definition: Ambient design wet bulb temperature used for selecting the cooling tower.

name: Amplifier Type
definition: Indicates the type of amplifier.

name: Anchorage Type
definition: Mooring device anchorage type

name: Anchor Bolt Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the anchor bolt bar(s).

name: Anchor Bolt Length
definition: The length of the anchor bolt.

name: Anchor Bolt Protrusion Length
definition: The length of the protruding part of the anchor bolt.

name: Anchor Bolt Thread Length
definition: The length of the threaded part of the anchor bolt.

name: Angle Between Component Axes
definition: The angle between the axes of each pair of components.

name: Angle To First Axis
definition: The angle of rotation of the axis of the first component relative to the ‘West’ edge of the slab.

name: Annual Range
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) annual range in levels.

name: Annual Trend
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) annual rise in level.

name: Antenna Gain
definition: Indicates the antenna gain, which is a ratio of the power transmitted by an antenna in a specific direction compared to an isotropic antenna.

name: Antenna Type
definition:
Indicates the type of antenna.

Indicates the type of antenna integrated in the device.

name: Apparent Power
definition: Apparent power.

name: Appearance Grade
definition: Grade with respect to visual quality.

name: Appliance Diversity
definition: Diversity of appliance load.

name: Appliance Percent Load To Radiant
definition: Percent of sensible load to radiant heat.

name: Applicable Structural Design Method
definition: Determines whether mechanical material properties are applicable to 'ASD' = allowable stress design (working stress design), 'LSD' = limit state design, or 'LRFD' = load and resistance factor design.

name: Application
definition: Indicates application of controller.

name: Application Method
definition: State the application method used... e.g. spray, extruded

name: Application Of Fan
definition:
The functional application of the fan.SupplyAir: Supply air fan.
ReturnAir: Return air fan.
ExhaustAir: Exhaust air fan.
Other: Other type of application not defined above.

name: Application Temperature
definition: Indicates the ambient temperature at which the course is applied

name: Applied Line Load
definition: The load of line where the derailer is installed. It is a design parameter and is defined by mass per length.

name: Applies To Train Category
definition: Sign information relative to train category, e.g. freight, passenger.

name: Approach Speed
definition: The design speed of trains approaching the signal if different from the line speed.

name: Arc Extinction Type
definition: Type of arc extinction used.

name: Area
definition:
Calculated area for the object.

Total area of the outer lining of the window.

name: Area Per Occupant
definition: Design occupancy loading for this type of usage assigned to this space.

name: Arrangement Type
definition:
Terminal box arrangement.
SingleDuct: Terminal box receives warm or cold air from a single air supply duct.
DualDuct: Terminal box receives warm and cold air from separate air supply ducts.

name: Article Number
definition: Article number or reference that is be applied to a configured product according to a standard scheme for article number definition as defined by the manufacturer. It is often used as the purchasing number.

name: Artificial Lighting
definition: Indication whether this space  requires artificial lighting (as natural lighting would be not sufficient). (TRUE) indicates yes (FALSE) otherwise.

name: As Built Location Number
definition: Defines a unique location within a structure, the ‘slot’ into which the piece was installed. Where pieces share the same piece mark, they can be interchanged. The value is only known after erection.

name: Aspect Ratio
definition: The default aspect ratio.

name: Assembly Instruction
definition: Instructions to describe how the system / equipment / facility is assembled.

name: Assembly Place
definition: Enumeration defining where the assembly is intended to take place, either in a factory, other offsite location or on the building site.

name: Assessment Condition
definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

name: Assessment Date
definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

name: Assessment Description
definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

name: Assessment Frequency
definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

name: Assessment Method
definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

name: Assessment Type
definition: Category of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

name: Asset Accounting Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

name: Asset Criticality
definition: Rating of the asset's criticality to the operation of the facility

name: Asset Frailty
definition: Rating of the asset's frailty to breakage or deterioration

name: Asset Identifier
definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.NOTE  The asset identifier is unique within the asset register. It differs from the globally unique id assigned to the instance of an entity populating a database.

name: Asset Insurance Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of insurance rating from which the type required may be set.

name: Asset Priority
definition: Combined criticality and frailty rating indicating the operational and maintenance priority of the asset

name: Asset Status
definition: Current status or stage in life cycle.

name: Asset Tax Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of taxation group from which the type required may be set.

name: Asset Use
definition: General use category of the asset

name: Associated Activity
definition: An indication or link to any associated activity or process that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

name: Associated Location
definition: An indication or link to any associated location or space that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

name: Associated Product
definition: An indication or link to any associated product or material that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

name: Atex Verified
definition: An indication whether the tripping_unit is verified to be applied in EX-environment or not.

name: Atmospheric Acidification
definition: Quantity of gases responsible for the atmospheric acidification calculated in equivalent SO2.

name: Atmospheric Acidification Per Unit
definition: Quantity of gases responsible for the atmospheric acidification calculated in equivalent SO2

name: Atmospheric Pressure
definition: Ambient atmospheric pressure.

name: Attenuation
definition: Indicates the optical or electrical attenuation of the cable measured in dB, at a certain wavelength or frequency, changing with the length of the cable.

name: Audio Amplification
definition: Indicates audio amplification frequency ranges.

name: Audio Mode
definition: Indicates audio sound modes and corresponding labels, if applicable.

name: Audio Volume
definition: Indicates discrete audio volume levels and corresponding sound power offsets, if applicable.  Missing values may be interpolated.

name: Audio Volume History
definition: Indicates the audio volume level where the integer level corresponds to an entry or interpolation within Pset_AudioVisualApplianceTypeCommon.AudioVolume.

name: Automatic Condensate Discharge
definition: Whether or not the condensing water or oil is discharged automatically from the filter.

name: Auxiliary Energy Consumption
definition: Boiler secondary energy source consumption (i.e., the electricity consumed by electrical devices such as fans and pumps).

name: Auxiliary Energy Source Consumption
definition: Auxiliary energy source consumption.

name: Axle Counter Response Time
definition: The time that axle counter can detect the axles of locomotive and vehicle.

name: Axle Counting Equipment Type
definition: The type of axle counting equipment.

name: Azimuth
definition: The azimuth of the outward normal for the outward or upward facing surface.

name: Backboard Type
definition: The type of the backboard of the signal frame.

name: Backflow Preventer Type
definition: Identifies the type of backflow preventer installed to prevent the backflow of contaminated or polluted water from an irrigation/reticulation system to a potable water supply.

name: Bar Allocation Type

name: Bar Code
definition: The identity of the bar code given to an occurrence of the product.

name: Base Material
definition:
The material from which the base of the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber base will be constructed of a single material.

name: Base Thickness
definition: The thickness of the base construction, assumed to be constructed at a single thickness.

name: Base Type
definition:
Defines general types of pump bases.FRAME: Frame.
BASE: Base.
NONE: There is no pump base, such as an inline pump.
OTHER: Other type of pump base.

name: Basin Reserve Volume
definition: Volume between operating and overflow levels in cooling tower basin.

name: Batch Reference
definition: The identity of the batch reference from which an occurrence of a product is taken.

name: Bath Type
definition: The property enumeration defines the types of bath that may be specified within the property set.

name: Batter At End
definition: The angle, in radians, by which the formwork at the ending face of a piece is to be rotated from the vertical in order to compensate for the rotation of the face that will occur once the piece is stripped from its form, inducing camber due to eccentric prestressing.

name: Batter At Start
definition: The angle, in radians, by which the formwork at the starting face of a piece is to be rotated from the vertical in order to compensate for the rotation of the face that will occur once the piece is stripped from its form, inducing camber due to eccentric prestressing.

name: Battery Charging Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of battery charging.

name: Beam Cooling Capacity
definition: Cooling capacity of beam. This excludes cooling capacity of supply air.

name: Beam Heating Capacity
definition: Heating capacity of beam. This excludes heating capacity of supply air.

name: Bearing Strength
definition: Defining values: α; defined values: bearing strength of bolt holes, i.e. intrados pressure.

name: Bend Angle
definition: The change of direction of flow.

name: Bending Strength
definition: Bending strength.

name: Bend Radius
definition: The radius of bending if circular arc or zero if sharp bend.

name: Bent Spacing
definition: Bent (upright) spacing

name: Berth Approach
definition: How the vessel approaches the berth

name: Berth Cargo Weight
definition: Total cargo weight of berths within the facility

name: Berth Grade
definition: Berth grade

name: Berthing Angle
definition: Angle of approach for the vessel to the berth

name: Berthing Velocity
definition: Velocity of the vessel as it berths

name: Berth Mode
definition: Orientation of vessel as it approaches berth

name: Berths
definition: Number of standard berths within the facility

name: Blade Action
definition: Blade action.

name: Blade Edge
definition: Blade edge.

name: Blade Position Angle
definition: Blade position angle; angle between the blade and flow direction ( 0 - 90).

name: Blade Radius
definition: The radius of the blade bend defined as design parameter.

name: Blade Shape
definition: Blade shape. Flat means triple V-groove.

name: Blades Orientation
definition: Orientation of internal blades.

name: Blade Thickness
definition: The thickness of the damper blade.

name: Body Colour
definition: Colour of the body of the hydrant.Note: Consult local fire regulations for statutory colours that may be required for hydrant bodies in particular circumstances.

name: Body Mass
definition: Overall body mass of the heater.

name: Boiling Point
definition: The boiling point of the material (fluid).

name: Bolthole Pitch
definition: Diameter of the circle along which the boltholes are placed.

name: Bolt Size
definition: Size of the bolts securing the flange.

name: Bore Hole Purpose
definition: Purpose for which the borehole, section or volumetric model was created. (EU Inspire, boreholeML)

name: Borehole State
definition: The state the borehole or trial pit has been left in. (boreholeML).

name: Bore Size
definition: The nominal bore of the pipe flange.

name: Botanical Name
definition: Formal scientific name conforming to the International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants (ICN)

name: Boulders Volume
definition: Relative volume of boulders (typically larger than 200mm) stratum constituents.

name: Boundary Area Heat Loss
definition: Heat loss per unit area for the boundary object. This is a design input value for use in the absence of calculated load data.

name: Braking Length
definition: Length of the braking distance as a design parameter of the bumper occurrence.

name: Branch Line Direction
definition: Describes the direction associated to the branch line of the turnout (deviated branch).

name: Breakdown Voltage Tolerance
definition: Nominal value of the spark gap breakdown voltage tolerance.

name: Breaker Unit Curve
definition:
A curve that establishes the let through energy of a breaker unit when a particular prospective current is applied.  Note that the breaker unit curve is defined within a Cartesian coordinate system and this fact must be asserted within the property set:(1) Defining value: ProspectiveCurrent: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 16 numbers providing the currents in [A] for points in the current/I2t log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.
(2) Defined value: LetThroughEnergy: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 16 numbers providing the let-through energy, I2t, in [A2s] for points in the current/I2t log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.

name: Breaker Unit Fuse Breakinging Curve
definition:
A curve that establishes the let through breaking energy of a breaker unit when a particular prospective breaking current is applied.  Note that the breaker unit fuse breaking curve is defined within a Cartesian coordinate system and this fact must be:(1) Defining value: ProspectiveCurrentBreaking: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 8 numbers providing the currents in [A] for points in the
current/breaking energy log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.
(2) Defined value: LetThroughBreakingEnergy: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 8 numbers providing the breaking energy whereby the fuse has provided a break, I2t, in [A2s] for points in the current/breakting_energy log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive.

name: Breaker Unit Fuse Melting Curve
definition:
A curve that establishes the energy required to melt the fuse of a breaker unit when a particular prospective melting current is applied.  Note that the breaker unit fuse melting curve is defined within a Cartesian coordinate system and this fact must be:(1) Defining value: ProspectiveCurrentMelting :A list of minimum 2 and maximum 8 numbers providing the currents in [A] for points in the
current/melting_energy log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.
(2) Defined value: MeltingEnergy: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 8 numbers providing the energy whereby the fuse is starting to melt, I2t, in [A2s] for points in the current/melting_energy log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.

name: Breaker Unit IPICurve
definition:
A curve that establishes the let through peak current of a breaker unit when a particular prospective current is applied.  Note that the breaker unit IPI curve is defined within a Cartesian coordinate system and this fact must be asserted within the property set:(1) Defining value: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 16 numbers providing the currents in [A] for points in the I/Î log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.
(2) Defined value: A list of minimum 2 and maximum 16 numbers providing the let-through peak currents, Î, in [A] for points in the I/Î log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.

name: Breaking Capacity
definition: The current that a fuse, circuit breaker, or other electrical apparatus is able to interrupt without being destroyed or causing an electric arc with unacceptable duration.

name: Breeching Inlet Type
definition: Defines the type of breeching inlet.

name: Brightness
definition: Indicates the display brightness.

name: Budget Source
definition: The budget source requested.

name: Buildable Area
definition: The area of site utilization expressed as a maximum value according to local building codes.

name: Building Height Limit
definition: Allowed maximum height of buildings on this site - according to local building codes.

name: Building ID
definition: A unique identifier assigned to a building. A temporary identifier is initially assigned at the time of making a planning application. This temporary identifier is changed to a permanent identifier when the building is registered into a statutory buildings and properties database.

name: Building Thermal Exposure
definition: The thermal exposure expected by the building based on surrounding site conditions.

name: Bulb Liquid Colour
definition: The colour of the liquid in the bulb for a bulb activated sprinkler. Note that the liquid colour varies according to the activation temperature requirement of the sprinkler head. Note also that this property does not need to be asserted for quick response activated sprinklers.

name: Bumper Orientation
definition: Direction in which the bumper is aligned, e.g. same direction as increasing stationing values or opposite.

name: Bypass Factor
definition: Fraction of air that is bypassed by the coil (0-1).

name: Cable Armour Type
definition: The armour type of the cable for mechanical protection.

name: Cable Arranger Position
definition: Indicates the directional position of the cable arranger: vertical, horizontal, front or rear. It is relative to the element (usually a cabinet) that the cable arranger is affiliated.

name: Cable Duct Occupancy Ratio
definition: Indicates the ratio between the number of cables in the duct and the maximum number of cables that the duct can contain.

name: Cable Function Type
definition: Distinguishes between Telecom and Power Supply cables.

name: Camber At Midspan
definition: The camber deflection, measured from the midpoint of a cambered face of a piece to the midpoint of the chord joining the ends of the same face, as shown in the figure below, divided by the original (nominal) straight length of the face of the piece.

name: Camera Type
definition: Indicates the type of camera.

name: Cantilever Type
definition: Type of cantilever assembly.

name: Capacitance
definition: Maximum value of the capacitance between the electrodes at specified frequency and temperature.

name: Capacity
definition:
The capacity of the element.

Heat transfer rate of the cooling tower between air stream and water stream.

name: Capacity Control
definition:
FanCycling: Fan is cycled on and off to control duty.
TwoSpeedFan: Fan is switched between low and high speed to control duty.
VariableSpeedFan: Fan speed is varied to control duty.
DampersControl: Dampers modulate the air flow to control duty.
BypassValveControl: Bypass valve modulates the water flow to control duty.
MultipleSeriesPumps: Turn on/off multiple series pump to control duty.
TwoSpeedPump: Switch between high/low pump speed to control duty.
VariableSpeedPump: vary pump speed to control duty.

name: Capacity Control Type
definition:
InletVane: Control by adjusting inlet vane.
VariableSpeedDrive: Control by variable speed drive.
BladePitchAngle: Control by adjusting blade pitch angle.
TwoSpeed: Control by switch between high and low speed.
DischargeDamper: Control by modulating discharge damper.

name: Capacity Curve
definition:
Chiller cooling capacity is a function of condensing temperature and evaporating temperature, data is in table form, Capacity = f (TempCon, TempEvp), capacity = a1+b1*Tei+c1*Tei\^2+d1*Tci+e1*Tci\^2+f1*Tei*Tci.
This table uses multiple input variables; to represent, both DefiningValues and DefinedValues lists are null and IfcTable is attached using IfcResourceConstraintRelationship and IfcMetric.  Columns are specified in the following order:
1.IfcPowerMeasure:Capacity
2.IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure:CondensingTemperature
3.IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure:EvaporatingTemperature

name: Capacity People
definition: Capacity of the transportation element measured in numbers of person.

name: Capacity Weight
definition: Capacity of the transport element measured by weight.

name: Cap Colour
definition: Colour of the caps of the hydrant.Note: Consult local fire regulations for statutory colours that may be required for hydrant caps in particular circumstances.

name: Cap Depth
definition: Depth of cap (boreholeML).

name: Cap Material
definition: Cap material or 'NOT CAPPED' or 'UNKNOWN' (boreholeML).

name: Carbon Content
definition: The carbon content in the fuel. This is measured in weight of carbon per unit weight of fuel and is therefore unitless.

name: Carbon Dioxide Emissions
definition: Rate of emission of carbon dioxide

name: Cargo Dead Weight
definition: Weight of (bulk) cargo carried

name: Carrier Stack Number
definition: Number of carrier segments (tray, ladder etc.) that are vertically stacked (vertical is measured as the z-axis of the local coordinate system of the carrier segment).

name: Casing Depth
definition:
Depth of the casing.

For a door, it is the dimension in the plane perpendicular to door leaf. If given it is applied equally to all four sides of the adjacent wall.

name: Casing Thickness
definition:
Thickness of the casing.

For a door, it is the dimension in plane of the door leaf. If given it is applied equally to all four sides of the adjacent wall.

name: Casting Method
definition: The method of casting the concrete into its designed form.

name: Category
definition: Designation of the category into which the actors in the population belong.

name: Catenary Stay Type
definition: Indicates the type of catenary stay used.

name: Catenary Wire Type
definition: Indicate the type of Catenary wire.

name: Ceiling Covering
definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space ceiling. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.The material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CEILING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Ceiling Covering Thickness
definition: Thickness of the material layer(s) for the space ceiling.The thickness information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CEILING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned IfcCovering and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Ceiling RAPlenum
definition: Ceiling plenum used for return air or not. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

name: Centerline Air Velocity
definition: Centerline air velocity versus distance from the diffuser and temperature differential; a function of distance from diffuser and temperature difference between supply air and room air.

name: Centre Line To Fairlead
definition: Distance from the vessel centreline to the fairlead for the line

name: Chamber Length Or Radius
definition: Length or, in the event of the shape being circular in plan, the radius of the chamber.

name: Chamber Width
definition: Width, in the event of the shape being non circular in plan.

name: Characteristic Exponent
definition: Characteristic exponent, slope of log(heat output) vs log (surface temperature minus environmental temperature).

name: Characteristic Function
definition: The characteristic function to show the relationship between varistor current and voltage.

name: Characteristic Impedance
definition:
A quantity defined for a mode of propagation at a given frequency in a specific uniform transmission line or uniform waveguide by one of the three following relations:
Z1 = S/ |I|2
Z2 = |U|2 / S
Z3 = U / I
where Z is the complex characteristic impedance, S the complex power and U and I are the values, usually complex, respectively of a voltage and a current conventionally defined for each type of mode by analogy with transmission line equations.

name: Charge Pressure
definition: Nominal or design operating pressure of the tank.

name: Check Rail Type
definition: Type of the check rail. Check rail types enumerated in this property are defined based on EN 13674.

name: Chiller Capacity
definition: Nominal cooling capacity of chiller at standardized conditions as defined by the agency having jurisdiction.

name: Chromatic Dispersion Tolerance
definition: Indicates the tolerance of the transport equipment chromatic dispersion. The value is defined by picosecond per nanometer (ps/nm).

name: Cill Level Lower Head
definition: Height of the lower head cill level

name: Cill Level Upper Head
definition: Height of the upper head cill level

name: Circuit Type
definition:
OpenCircuit: Exposes water directly to the cooling atmosphere.
CloseCircuit: The fluid is separated from the atmosphere by a heat exchanger.
Wet: The air stream or the heat exchange surface is evaporatively cooled.
Dry: No evaporation into the air stream.
DryWet: A combination of a dry tower and a wet tower.

name: Cistern Capacity
definition: Volumetric capacity of the cistern

name: Cistern Height
definition: Enumeration that identifies the height of the cistern or, if set to 'None' if the urinal has no cistern and is flushed using mains or high pressure water through a flushing valve.

name: Classification Authority
definition: The name of the authority that applies the classification of service to the hose reel (e.g. NFPA/FEMA).

name: Class Of Service
definition: A classification of usage of the hose reel that may be applied.

name: Clay Volume
definition: Relative volume of clay (typically smaller than 0.002mm) stratum constituents.

name: Clear Depth
definition:
The clear depth.

It indicates the distance from the inner surface of the elevator door to the opposite surface of the elevator car.

name: Clear Height
definition:
Clear height of the object (elevator).
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Clear Width
definition:
The clear width.

It indicates the distance from the inner surfaces of the elevator car left and right from the elevator door.

name: Climate Change
definition: Quantity of greenhouse gases emitted calculated in equivalent CO2.

name: Climate Change Per Unit
definition: Quantity of greenhouse gases emitted calculated in equivalent CO2

name: Clogging Indicator
definition: Whether the filter has an indicator to display the degree of clogging of the filter.

name: Close Off Rating
definition: Close off rating.

name: Closure Rating Enum
definition: Enumeration that identifies the closure rating for the damper.

name: CO2 Content
definition: Carbon dioxide (CO2) content of the products of combustion. This is measured in weight of CO2 per unit weight and is therefore unitless.

name: Cobbles Volume
definition: Relative volume of cobbles (typically larger than 63mm) stratum constituents.

name: COContent
definition: Carbon monoxide (CO) content of the products of combustion. This is measured in weight of CO per unit weight and is therefore unitless.

name: Coefficient Of Friction
definition: Coefficient of friction value for the fender

name: Coefficient Of Performance
definition:
The Coefficient of performance (COP) is the ratio of heat removed to energy input.
The energy input may be obtained by multiplying
Pset_DistributionPortPHistoryGas.FlowRate on the 'Fuel' port of the IfcChiller by Pset_MaterialFuel.LowerHeatingValue.
The IfcDistributionPort for fuel has an associated IfcMaterial with fuel properties and is assigned to an IfcPerformanceHistory object nested within this IfcPerformanceHistory object.

name: Coefficient Of Performance Curve
definition:
Chiller coefficient of performance (COP) is function of condensing temperature and evaporating temperature, data is in table form, COP= f (TempCon, TempEvp), COP = a2+b2*Tei+c2*Tei\^2+d2*Tci+e2*Tci\^2+f2*Tei*Tci.
This table uses multiple input variables; to represent, both DefiningValues and DefinedValues lists are null and IfcTable is attached using IfcResourceConstraintRelationship and IfcMetric.  Columns are specified in the following order:
1.IfcPositiveRatioMeasure:CoefficientOfPerformance
2.IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure:CondensingTemperature
3.IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure:EvaporatingTemperature

name: Cohesion Behaviour
definition: Cohesive shear strength of a rock or soil that is independent of interparticle friction.

name: Coil Connection Direction
definition: Coil connection direction (facing into the air stream).

name: Coil Coolant
definition: The fluid used for heating or cooling used by the hydronic coil.

name: Coil Face Area
definition: Coil face area in the direction against air the flow.

name: Coil Fluid Arrangement
definition:
Fluid flow arrangement of the coil.CrossCounterFlow: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CrossFlow: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
CrossParallelFlow: Air and water flow enter in same directions.

name: Coil Length
definition: Length of coil.

name: Coil Placement
Coil Position
definition:
Defines the relationship between a fan and a coil.DrawThrough: Fan located downstream of the coil.
BlowThrough: Fan located upstream of the coil.

name: Coil Width
definition: Width of coil.

name: Colour
definition: Colour of this object.

name: Colour Appearance
definition: In both the DIN and CIE standards, artificial light sources are classified in terms of their colour appearance. To the human eye they all appear to be white; the difference can only be detected by direct comparison. Visual performance is not directly affected by differences in colour appearance.

name: Colour Code
definition: Name of a colour for identifying the connector, if applicable.

name: Colour Rendering Index
definition: The CRI indicates how well a light source renders eight standard colours compared to perfect reference lamp with the same colour temperature. The CRI scale ranges from 1 to 100, with 100 representing perfect rendering properties.

name: Colour Temperature
definition: The colour temperature of any source of radiation is defined as the temperature (in Kelvin) of a black-body or Planckian radiator whose radiation has the same chromaticity as the source of radiation. Often the values are only approximate colour temperatures as the black-body radiator cannot emit radiation of every chromaticity value. The colour temperatures of the commonest artificial light sources range from less than 3000K (warm white) to 4000K (intermediate) and over 5000K (daylight).

name: Column Shoe Base Plate Depth
definition: The depth of the column shoe base plate.

name: Column Shoe Base Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the column shoe base plate.

name: Column Shoe Base Plate Width
definition: The width of the column shoe base plate.

name: Column Shoe Casing Depth
definition: The depth of the column shoe casing.

name: Column Shoe Casing Height
definition: The height of the column shoe casing.

name: Column Shoe Casing Width
definition: The width of the column shoe casing.

name: Combined Kerb Gutter
definition: Indicating  the use of a combined kerb and gutter.

name: Combustible
definition: Indication whether the object is made from combustible material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Combustion Chamber Temperature
definition: Average combustion chamber temperature.

name: Combustion Efficiency
definition: Combustion efficiency under nominal condition.

name: Combustion Temperature
definition:
Combustion temperature.

Combustion temperature of the material when air is at 298 K and 100 kPa.

name: Commencement Date
definition: Date on which the agreement commences.

name: Common Interface Type
definition: Indicates the type of the device common interfaces.

name: Communication Standard
definition: Indicates the communication standard supported by the physical wired communication port.

name: Compacted Volume
definition: Volume of the earthworks when finished and compacted in place.

name: Compartmentation
definition: Indication whether the object is designed to serve as a fire compartmentation (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Complementaryfunction
definition: Indicates the complementary function of the drain channel.

name: Composite Fractions
definition: Denomination into soil groups by composite fractions

name: Composition Type
definition: Denotes, whether the predefined spatial structure element represents itself, or an aggregate (complex) or a part (part). The interpretation is given separately for each subtype of spatial structure element. If no CompositionType is asserted, the default value ''ELEMENT'' applies.

name: Compressed Air Filter Type
definition: ACTIVATEDCARBON: absorbs oil vapor and odor; PARTICLE_FILTER: used to absorb solid particles of medium size; COALESCENSE_FILTER: used to absorb fine solid, oil, and water particles, also called micro filter

name: Compression Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to the work delivered to the gas within the compression volume (as obtained by measurement).

name: Compressive Strength
definition:
The compressive strength of the object or material.

Defining values: α; defined values: compressive strength.

name: Compressor Capacity
definition: The product of the  ideal capacity and the overall volumetric efficiency of the compressor.

name: Compressor Condenser Heat Gain
definition: Heat gain between condenser inlet to compressor outlet.

name: Compressor Condenser Pressure Drop
definition: Pressure drop between condenser inlet and compressor outlet.

name: Compressor Evaporator Heat Gain
definition: Heat gain between the evaporator outlet and the compressor inlet.

name: Compressor Evaporator Pressure Drop
definition: Pressure drop between the evaporator outlet and the compressor inlet.

name: Compressor Speed
definition: Compressor speed.

name: Compressor Total Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the thermal cooling capacity to electrical input.

name: Compressor Total Heat Gain
definition: Compressor total heat gain.

name: Comp Strength
definition: Compressive strength, α=0°.

name: Comp Strength Perp
definition: Compressive strength, α=90°.

name: Concealed Ceiling
definition: Indication whether this space is designed to have a concealed flooring space (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed ceiling space is normally meant to be the space between a slab and a ceiling.

name: Concealed Ceiling Offset
definition: Distance between the upper floor slab and the suspended ceiling, often used for distribution systems. Often referred to as plenum.

name: Concealed Flooring
definition: Indication whether this space is designed to have a concealed flooring space (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A concealed flooring space is normally meant to be the space beneath a raised floor.

name: Concealed Flooring Offset
definition: Distance between the floor slab and the floor covering, often used for cables and other installations. Often referred to as raised flooring.

name: Concrete Cover
definition: The protective concrete cover at the reinforcing bars according to local building regulations.

name: Concrete Cover At Links
definition: The protective concrete cover at the reinforcement links according to local building regulations.

name: Concrete Cover At Main Bars
definition: The protective concrete cover at the main reinforcing bars according to local building regulations.

name: Condenser Entering Temperature
definition: Temperature of fluid entering condenser.

name: Condenser Flowrate
definition: Flow rate of fluid through the condenser.

name: Condenser Leaving Temperature
definition: Temperature of fluid leaving condenser.

name: Condenser Mean Void Fraction
definition: Mean void fraction in condenser.

name: Condensing Temperature
definition: Refrigerant condensing temperature.

name: Condition Commencement
definition: Condition of property provided on commencement of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key.

name: Condition Disposal Level
definition: Condition that will trigger a disposal process

name: Condition History
definition: Indicates alarm condition over time.  The range of possible values and their meanings is defined by Pset_AlarmTypeCommon.Condition.  An empty value indicates no present alarm condition.

name: Condition Maintenance Level
definition: Condition that will trigger maintenance

name: Condition Replacement Level
definition: Condition that will trigger a replacement process

name: Condition Target Performance
definition: Target condition of the asset

name: Condition Termination
definition: Condition of property required on termination of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key.

name: Conductor Diameter
definition: Indicates the conductor diameter. It is only used for twisted and untwisted wire pair.

name: Conductor Function
definition: Indicates function of the conductors to which the load is connected. Where L1, L2 and L3 represent the phase lines according to IEC 60446 notation (sometimes phase lines may be referenced by color [Red, Blue, Yellow] or by number [1, 2, 3] etc). Protective Earth is sometimes also known as CPC or common protective conductor. Note that for an electrical device, a set of line conductor functions may be applied.

name: Conductor Material
definition: Type of material from which the conductor is constructed.

name: Conductor Shape
definition: Indication of the shape of the conductor.

name: Conduit Shape Type
definition: The shape of the conduit segment.

name: Conicity Ratio
definition: The ratio of the diameter of the cone bottom surface to the height of the pole.

name: Connected Conductor Function
definition: Function of the conductors to which the load is connected.

name: Connection Gender
definition: The physical connection gender.

name: Connection Size
definition:
The connection size of the object.

The connection to and from the pump.

name: Connection Subtype
definition:
The physical port connection subtype that further qualifies the ConnectionType. The following values are recommended:ACPLUG: A, B, C, D, E, F, EF, G, H, I, J, K, L, M
DIN: Mini3P, Mini4P, Mini5P, Mini6P, Mini7P, Mini8P, Mini9P
DSub: DA15, DB25, DC37, DD50, DE9, DE15
EIAJ: RC5720
HDMI: A, B, C
RADIO: IEEE802.11g, IEEE802.11n
RJ: 4P4C, 6P2C, 8P8C
SOCKET: E-11, E-12, E-14, E-17, E-26, E-27, E-39, E-40
TRS: TS_Mini, TS_SubMini, TRS_Mini, TRS_SubMini

name: Connection Type
definition:
The end-style treatment of the duct port:BEADEDSLEEVE: Beaded Sleeve.
COMPRESSION: Compression.
CRIMP: Crimp.
DRAWBAND: Drawband.
DRIVESLIP: Drive slip.
FLANGED: Flanged.
OUTSIDESLEEVE: Outside Sleeve.
SLIPON: Slipon.
SOLDERED: Soldered.
SSLIP: S-Slip.
STANDINGSEAM: Standing seam.
SWEDGE: Swedge.
WELDED: Welded.
OTHER: Another type of end-style has been applied.
NONE: No end-style has been applied.

name: Connector AColour
definition: Indicates the colour A- end of connector.

name: Connector AGender
definition: Indicates the gender of A-end connector.

name: Connector AType
definition: Indicates the type of A-end connector.

name: Connector BColour
definition: Indicates the colour B- end of connector.

name: Connector BGender
definition: Indicates the gender of B-end connector.

name: Connector BType
definition: Indicates the type of B-end connector.

name: Connector Type
definition: Indicates the type of connector.

name: Construction
definition: Purpose of informing on how the vonductor is constructed (interwined or solid). I.e. Solid (IEV 461-01-06), stranded (IEV 461-01-07), solid-/finestranded(IEV 461-01-11) (not flexible/flexible).

name: Construction Method
definition: The type of construction action to the object, e.g. new construction, renovation, refurbishment, etc.

name: Construction Tolerance Class
definition: Classification designation of the on-site construction tolerances according to local standards.

name: Contactor Type
definition:
A list of the available types of contactor from which that required may be selected where:CapacitorSwitching: for switching 3 phase single or multi-step capacitor banks.
LowCurrent: requires the use of low resistance contacts.
MagneticLatching: enables the contactor to remain in the on position when the coil is no longer energized.
MechanicalLatching: requires that the contactor is mechanically retained in the on position.
Modular: are totally enclosed and self contained.
Reversing: has a double set of contactors that are prewired.
Standard: is a generic device that controls the flow of power in a circuit on or off.

name: Contact Resistance
definition: Resistance when electrical node is closed.

name: Contact Wire Height
definition: Distance from the top of the rail to the lower face of the contact wire, measured perpendicular to the track.

name: Contact Wire Stagger
definition: Lateral displacement of the contact wire to opposite sides of the track centre at successive supports.

name: Container Material
definition: Special requirements for material used to contain an artefact.

name: Contaminant Volume
definition: Relative volume of contaminant stratum constituents.

name: Contour Value
definition: Value of the elevation of the contour above or below a reference plane.

name: Contractual Type
definition: The contractual type of the work.

name: Contrast Ratio
definition: Indicates the display contrast ratio.

name: Contributed Luminous Flux
definition: Luminous flux is a photometric measure of radiant flux, i.e. the volume of light emitted from a light source. Luminous flux is measured either for the interior as a whole or for a part of the interior (partial luminous flux for a solid angle). All other photometric parameters are derivatives of luminous flux. Luminous flux is measured in lumens (lm). The luminous flux is given as a nominal value for each lamp.

name: Control Damper Operation
definition: The inherent characteristic of the control damper operation.

name: Controller Interface Type
definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

name: Control Pulse Current
definition: The current of the electric actuator control pulse.

name: Control Strategy
definition:
FixedExitingWaterTemp: The capacity is controlled to maintain a fixed exiting water temperature.
WetBulbTempReset: The set-point is reset based on the wet-bulb temperature.

name: Control Type
definition: The type controller, signal modification effected and applicable ports

name: Convector Type
definition: Indicates the type of convector, whether forced air (mechanically driven) or natural (gravity).

name: Conversion Time
definition: Turnout conversion completion time.

name: Cooling Air Flow Rate
definition: Cooling air flow rate in the space.

name: Cooling Design Air Flow
definition: The air flowrate required during the peak cooling conditions.

name: Cooling Design Day
definition: The month, day  and time that has been selected for the cooling design calculations.

name: Cooling Dry Bulb
definition: Dry bulb temperature, usually for for cooling design.

name: Cooling Efficiency
definition: Coefficient of Performance: Ratio of cooling energy output to energy input under full load operating conditions.

name: Cooling Relative Humidity
definition: Inside relative humidity for cooling design.

name: Cooling Temperature Delta
definition: Cooling temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates.

name: Cooling Water Flow Rate
definition: Water flow rate for cooling.

name: Cooling Wet Bulb
definition: Outside wet bulb temperature for cooling design.

name: Core Conductor Diameter
definition: Indicates the core conductor diameter. It is only used for coaxial wire pair.

name: Core Identifier
definition: The core identification used  Identifiers may be used such as by color (Black, Brown, Grey) or by number (1, 2, 3) or by IEC phase reference (L1, L2, L3) etc.

name: Core Set Horizontal
definition: Degree of horizontal (in the X-axis of the LocalPlacement) blade set from the centerline.

name: Core Set Vertical
definition: Degree of vertical (in the Y-axis of the LocalPlacement) blade set from the centerline.

name: Core Type
definition: Identifies the way the core of the AirTerminal is constructed.

name: Corner Chamfer
definition: The chamfer in the corners of the precast element. The chamfer is presumed to be equal in both directions.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane X
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane X.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane Z
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane Z.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Length
definition: The length of the L-shaped corner plate.

name: Corner Fixing Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the L-shaped corner plate.

name: Correction Factor For Cooling
definition: Correction factor k as a function of water flow rate (used to calculate cooling capacity).

name: Correction Factor For Heating
definition: Correction factor k as a function of water flow rate (used to calculate heating capacity).

name: Corrosion Treatment
definition: Determines corrosion treatment for metal components. This property is provided if the requirement needs to be expressed (a) independently of a material specification and (b) as a mere requirements statement rather than a workshop design/ processing feature.

name: Count
definition: Total count of reinforcing items.

name: Counted Efficiency
definition: Filter efficiency based the particle counts concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

name: Counted Efficiency Curve
definition: Counted efficiency curve as a function of dust holding weight, efficiency = f (dust holding weight).

name: Counter Slope
definition:
Sloping angle of the object, measured perpendicular to the slope  - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).
Actual maximum slope for the passageway measured perpendicular to the direction of travel according to the current design. The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Note: new property in IFC4.

name: Country
definition: The two letter country code (from ISO 3166).

name: Coupling Loss
definition: Indicates the coupling loss of a leaky coaxial cable (radiating cable).

name: Coupling Type
definition: Defines the type coupling on the inlet of the breeching inlet.

name: Coverage Area
definition:
The area that is covered by the object.

Floor area (typically measured as a circle whose center is at the location of the sensor).

name: Cover Length
definition: The length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the cover of the object.

name: Cover Material
definition: Material from which the cover or grating is constructed.

name: Cover Width
definition: The length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the cover of the object.

name: Creepage Distance
definition: Shortest distance or the sum of the shortest distances along the surface on an insulator between two conductive parts which normally have the operating voltage between them. (IEV ref 471-01-04)

name: Crossfall
definition: Specifies the nominal crossfall as a ratio measure (slope) at the location of the event.

name: Crossing Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the crossing lower bar.

name: Crossing Upper Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the crossing upper bar.

name: Cross Sectional Area
definition: Cross section area of the phase(s) lead(s).

name: Cross Section Area
definition: Total area of the cross section (or profile) of the object.

name: Cross Section Shape
definition: Cross sectional shape. Note that this shape is uniform throughout the length of the segment. For nonuniform shapes, a transition fitting should be used instead.

name: Current
definition: The actual current and operable range.

name: Current Adjustment Range
definition: Upper and lower current adjustment limits for an AdjustmentValueType = RANGE. Note that this property should not have a value for an  AdjustmentValueType = LIST.

name: Current Adjustment Range Step Value
definition: Step value of current adjustment for an AdjustmentValueType = RANGE. Note that this property should not have a value for an  AdjustmentValueType = LIST.

name: Current Adjustment Values
definition: A list of current adjustment values that may be applied to a tripping unit for an AdjustmentValueType = LIST. A minimum of 1 and a maximum of 16 adjustment values may be specified. Note that this property should not have a value for an  AdjustmentValueType = RANGE.

name: Current Carrying Capacity
definition: Maximum value of electric current which can be carried continuously by a conductor, a device or an apparatus, under specified conditions without its steady-state temperature exceeding a  specified value. Based on IEC60826-11-13. NOTE: The temperature specified value is maximum Design Ambient Temperature.

name: Current Content3rd Harmonic
definition: The ratio between the third harmonic current and the phase current.

name: Current For Time Delay
definition: The tripping current in [x In] at which the time delay is specified. A value for this property should only be asserted for time delay of L-function, and for I2t of the S and G function.

name: Current History
definition: Log of electrical current.

name: Current Regulation Rate
definition: It shows the ability of DC regulated power supply to suppress the fluctuation of output voltage caused by the change of load current (output current) when the input voltage is constant.

name: Current RMS
definition: Maximum rms (root mean square) current of an electric-electronic or electromechanical component at specified ambient temperature.

name: Current Tolerance1
definition: The tolerance for the current of time/current-curve in [%].

name: Current Tolerance2
definition: The tolerance for the current of time/current-curve in [%] valid for times above CurrentTolereanceLimit1.

name: Current Tolerance Limit1
definition: The time limit in [s] limiting the application of CurrentTolerance1, if any. If the value is set to 0, the value of the CurrentTolerance1 is valid for the whole time/current-curve.

name: Curve Designation
definition: The designation of the trippingcurve given by the manufacturer. For a MCB the designation should be in accordance with the designations given in IEC 60898.

name: Curve Shape
definition: Shape according to CurveShapeEnum

name: Cyclic Path
definition: Represents the time:angle table of the kinematic behaviour.

name: Cyclic Range
definition: Identifies the angular range of the kinematic behaviour

name: Damper Control Type
definition: The type of control used to operate the damper (e.g., Open/Closed Indicator, Resettable Temperature Sensor, Temperature Override, etc.).

name: Damper Position
definition: Control damper position, ranging from 0 to 1; damper position (0=closed=90deg position angle, 1=open=0deg position angle).

name: Damping Ratio
definition: Indicates the damping ratio of the device.

name: Dashed Line
definition: State if the line is dashed or continuous

name: Dashed Line Pattern
definition: Indicates the pattern for dashed line types e.g. '3+9'

name: Data Collection Type
definition: Indicates the type or manner of data collection.

name: Data Connection Type
definition: Indicates the data connection type of the junction box e.g. copper pair, fiber or others.

name: Data Received
definition: For data ports, captures log of data received.  The LIST at IfcTimeSeriesValue.Values may split out data according to Pset_DistributionPortTypeCable.Protocols.

name: Data Transmission Unit Usage
definition: Indicates the usage of the data transmission unit. It can be used to transmit data for different types of sensors.

name: Data Transmitted
definition: For data ports, captures log of data transmitted.  The LIST at IfcTimeSeriesValue.Values may split out data according to Pset_DistributionPortTypeCable.Protocols.

name: DCResistance
definition: The resistance under direct current and 20 degrees centigrade.

name: Deep Penetration Throat Thickness
definition: Nominal throat thickness or effective throat thickness to which a certain amount of fusion penetration is added.REFERENCE Symbol s according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Defined Temperature
definition: The ambient temperature at which the thermal current/time-curve associated with this protection device is defined.

name: Defrost Temperature Effectiveness
definition: Temperature heat transfer effectiveness when defrosting is active.

name: Degree Of Linearity
definition: Indicates the degree of linearity of the earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

name: Delivery Type
definition: Determines how the accessory will be delivered to the site.

name: Depth
definition:
The depth of the object.

Depth (one direction of the non-projected foot print area) of the slab. It shall only be provided, if the slab is rectangular.NOTE  Also referred to as width, but not to be confused with the "Width" quantity, that denotes the thickness in the context of the slab.

name: Derailment Height
definition: Height of derailment block when derailer in protection state.

name: Derailment Maximum Speed Limit
definition: Indicates the maximum allowable train speed for the derailer.

name: Derailment Wheel Diameter
definition: Indicates the wheel diameter requirement for the derailer.

name: Derivative Constant
definition: The derivative gain factor of the controller (usually referred to as Kd).  Asserted where ControlType is PROPORTIONALINTEGRALDERIVATIVE.

name: Description
definition: The Description of the object.

name: Design Air Flow
definition: Design air flow rate for the space.

name: Design Ambient Temperature
definition: The highest and lowest local ambient temperature likely to be encountered.

name: Design Level
definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of design level employed.

name: Design Location Number
definition: Defines a unique location within a structure, the ‘slot’ for which the piece was designed.

name: Design Name
definition: A name for the design values.

name: Design Speed
definition:
Speed selected in designing a new road or in modernizing, strengthening or rehabilitating an existing road section, to determine the various geometric design features of the carriageway that allow a car to travel safely at that speed, under normal road surface and weather conditions.NOTE  Definition according to PIARC.
NOTE  The design speed is not constant, but may vary depending on the conditions of relief (plain, hill, mountain).

name: Design Traffic Volume
definition: The traffic volume used for planning and design purposes specified as the number of vehicles per day . Typically given as AADT - Average Annual Daily Traffic

name: Design Vehicle Class
definition: A vehicle designator with content according to local standards.

name: Detection Range
definition: The detection range of the equipment.

name: Device Capacity
definition: Mooring device force capacity

name: Device Type
definition: Mooring device type

name: Diagonal Truss Base Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

name: Diagonal Truss Cross Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the diagonal cross-bars.

name: Diagonal Truss Cross Bar Spacing
definition: The spacing between diagonal cross-bar sections.

name: Diagonal Truss Height
definition: The overall height of the truss connector.

name: Diagonal Truss Length
definition: The overall length of the truss connector.

name: Diagonal Truss Secondary Bar Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

name: Diagram Number
definition: A designator with content according to local standards, e.g. M25.

name: Diameter
definition: The Diameter of the object.

name: Dilatation Length
definition: Length dilatation admitted by the element.

name: Dimensional Accuracy Class
definition: Classification designation of the dimensional accuracy requirement according to local standards.

name: Dimensional Change Coefficient
definition: Weighted dimensional change coefficient, relative to 1% change in moisture content.

name: Dimmer Type
definition: A list of the available types of dimmer switch from which that required may be selected.

name: Direction
definition: Indicates sensed direction for sensors capturing magnitude and direction measured from True North (0 degrees) in a clockwise direction.

name: Direction Of Rotation
definition:
The direction of the centrifugal fan wheel rotation when viewed from the drive side of the fan.CLOCKWISE: Clockwise.
COUNTERCLOCKWISE: Counter-clockwise.
OTHER: Other type of fan rotation.

name: Discharge Coefficient
definition: The coefficient of flow at the sprinkler.

name: Discharge Direction
definition:
Discharge direction of the air terminal.Parallel: discharges parallel to mounting surface designed so that flow attaches to the surface.
Perpendicular:  discharges away from mounting surface.
Adjustable: both parallel and perpendicular discharge.

name: Discharge Flow Rate
definition: The volumetric rate of fluid discharge.

name: Discharge Position
definition:
Centrifugal fan discharge position.TOPHORIZONTAL: Top horizontal discharge.
TOPANGULARDOWN: Top angular down discharge.
DOWNBLAST: Downblast discharge.
BOTTOMANGULARDOWN: Bottom angular down discharge.
BOTTOMHORIZONTAL: Bottom horizontal discharge.
BOTTOMANGULARUP: Bottom angular up discharge.
UPBLAST: Upblast discharge.
TOPANGULARUP: Top angular up discharge.
OTHER: Other type of fan arrangement.

name: Discharge Pressure Loss
definition: Fan discharge pressure loss associated with the discharge arrangement.

name: Discharge Type
definition:
Defines the type of connection at the fan discharge.Duct: Discharge into ductwork.
Screen: Discharge into screen outlet.
Louver: Discharge into a louver.
Damper: Discharge into a damper.

name: Discharge Velocity
definition: The speed at which air discharges from the fan through the fan housing discharge opening.

name: Discontinued Heating
definition: Indication whether discontinued heating is required/desirable from user/designer view point. (TRUE) if yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

name: Dishwasher Type
definition: Type of dishwasher.

name: Dispatching Board Type
definition: Indicates the type of dispatching board.

name: Displacement
definition: Weight of water displaced by the vessel

name: Displacement Accommodated
definition: A list of exactly three boolean values representing an accommodated displacement (value TRUE or 1) or no displacement (value FALSE or 0) on the corresponding axis where the first value represents axis X, second value axis Y and third value axis Z.

name: Display Height
definition: Indicates the physical height of the screen (only the display surface).

name: Display Size
definition:
The physical size of the display.

In the case of a stem thermometer, this will be the length of the stem. For a dial thermometer, it will be the diameter of the dial.

name: Display Type
definition: Indicates the type of display.

name: Display Width
definition: Indicates the physical width of the screen (only the display surface).

name: Disposal Level
definition: Performance level at which disposal takes place

name: Dissolved Solids Content
definition: Fraction of the dissolved solids to the total amount of water. This is measured in weight of dissolved solids per weight of water and is therefore unitless.

name: Distance Between Component Axes
definition: The distance between the axes of the components, measured along the ‘South’ edge of the slab.

name: Distance Between Parallel Circuits
definition: Distance measured between parallel circuits.

name: Distance To Stop Mark
definition: Distance from the signal to the nearest stop mark at a platform.

name: Diversity
definition:
The ratio, expressed as a numerical
value or as a percentage, of the
simultaneous maximum demand of
a group of electrical appliances or
consumers within a specified period,
to the sum of their individual maximum
demands within the same
period. The group of electrical appliances is in this case connected to this circuit. Definition from IEC 60050, IEV 691-10-04
NOTE1: It is often not desirable to size each conductor in a distribution system to support the total connected load at that point in the network. Diversity is applied on the basis of the anticipated loadings that are likely to result from all loads not being connected at the same time.
NOTE2: Diversity is applied to final circuits only, not to sub-main circuits supplying other DBs.

name: Downstream Connections
definition: Names of downstream connected equipment and spaces, if not otherwise represented

name: Downstream Flood Water Level
definition: the design minimum upstream water level for the lock complex

name: Downstream Maintenance Water Level
definition: Design minimum upstream water level for the lock complex

name: Downstream Pressure
definition: The operating pressure of the fluid downstream of the pressure reducing valve.

name: Drain Connection Size
definition: Size of the drain connection inlet to the waste disposal unit.

name: Drain Size
definition: The size of the drain outlet connection from the object.

name: Drill On Rail
definition: Indicates if the manufactured rail is drilled at its extremities or not. It can have holes on one, both or none of its extremities.

name: Drive Connection Type
definition:
The way the pump drive mechanism is connected to the pump.DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive.
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive.
COUPLING: Coupling.
OTHER: Other type of drive connection.

name: Drive Power Loss
definition: Fan drive power losses associated with the type of connection between the motor and the fan wheel.

name: Dry Bulb Temperature
definition:
Dry bulb temperature of the object.

Loads from the dry bulb temperature.

name: Dry Bulb Temperature History
definition: Loads from the dry bulb temperature.

name: Dual Deck
definition: Does the AirHandler have a dual deck? TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

name: Duct Sealant
definition: Type of sealant used on the duct and fittings.

name: Duct Sizing Method
definition: Enumeration that identifies the methodology to be used to size system components.

name: Durability Rating
definition: Durability against mechanical stress. It is given according to the national code or regulation.

name: Duration
definition:
Duration.

The period of time for the lease.

name: Duration Disposal Level
definition: Duration interval at which disposal is performed

name: Duration Maintenance Level
definition: Duration interval at which maintenance is performed

name: Duration Replacement Level
definition: Duration interval at which replacement is performed

name: Duration Target Performance
definition: Target time to failure of the asset

name: Dust Holding Capacity
definition: Maximum filter dust holding capacity.

name: Dynamic Range
definition: Indicates the dynamic range of the sensor.

name: Dynamic Viscosity
definition: A measure of the viscous resistance of the material.

name: Earth Fault1 Pole Maximum State
definition: Maximum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

name: Earth Fault1 Pole Minimum State
definition: Minimum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

name: Earth Fault1 Pole Power Factor Maximum State
definition: Power factor of the maximum 1 pole earth fault  current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

name: Earth Fault1 Pole Power Factor Minimum State
definition: Power factor of the minimum 1 pole earth fault current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and PE/PEN.

name: Earthing Style
definition: Indicates the earthing style of the electric device.

name: Earthquake Sensor Range
definition: Indicates the measuring range of the earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

name: Earthquake Sensor Type
definition: Indicates the type of earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

name: Eaves Height
definition: Standard net height of this storey, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the bottom surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

name: Eccentricity In Y
definition: Distance in y direction between the two points (or vertex points) engaged in the point connection.

name: Eccentricity In Z
definition: Distance in z direction between the two points (or vertex points) engaged in the point connection.

name: Edge Distance To First Axis
definition: The distance from the left (‘West’) edge of the slab (in the direction of span of the components) to the axis of the first component.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane X
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane X.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Flange Width In Plane Z
definition: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane Z.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Length
definition: The length of the L-shaped edge plate.

name: Edge Fixing Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the L-shaped edge plate.

name: Effective Area
definition: Effective discharge area of the air terminal.

name: Effective Capacity
definition: The total effective or actual volumetric capacity of the tank.

name: Effective Chamber Size
definition: Volumetric measure defining the effective chamber size for operational and design activities.

name: Effectiveness
definition:
Effectiveness, represented as ratio.

Ratio of the real heat transfer rate to the maximum possible heat transfer rate.

name: Effectiveness Table
definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary air flow rate.

name: Efficiency Curve
definition: Fan efficiency =f (flow rate).

name: Electric Actuator Type
definition: Enumeration that identifies electric actuator as defined by its operational principle.

name: Electrical Clearance Distance
definition: The distance between two conductive parts along a string stretched the shortest way between these conductive parts. (IEV ref 441-17-31)

name: Electrical Connection Type
definition:
The physical port connection:ACPLUG: AC plug
DCPLUG: DC plug
CRIMP: bare wire

name: Electrical Cross Capacity
definition: Indicates the electrical cross capacity of the transport equipment.

name: Electrical Feeder Type
