definition: Type of electrical feeder.

name: Electrical System Category
definition: Designates the voltage range of the circuit, according to IEC.  HIGHVOLTAGE indicates >1000V AC or >1500V DV; LOWVOLTAGE indicates 50-1000V AC or 120-1500V DC; EXTRALOWVOLTAGE indicates <50V AC or <120V DC.

name: Electrical System Type
definition:
For certain purposes of electrical regulations, IEC 60364 defines types of system using type identifiers. Assignment of identifiers depends upon the relationship of the source, and of exposed conductive parts of the installation, to Ground (Earth).   Identifiers that may be assigned through IEC 60364 are:•TN type system, a system having one or more points of the source of energy directly earthed, the exposed conductive parts of the installation being connected to that point by protective conductors,
•TN C type system, a TN type system in which neutral and protective functions are combined in a single conductor throughout the system,
•TN S type system, a TN type system having separate neutral and protective conductors throughout the system,
•TN C S type system, a TN type system in which neutral and protective functions are combined in a single conductor in part of the system,
•TT type system, a system having one point of the source of energy directly earthed, the exposed conductive parts of the installation being connected to earth electrodes electrically independent of the earth electrodes of the source,
•IT type system, a system having no direct connection between live parts and Earth, the exposed conductive parts of the electrical installation being earthed.

name: Electric Cooker Type
definition: Type of electric cooker.

name: Electric Generator Efficiency
definition: The ratio of output capacity to intake capacity.

name: Electricity
definition: The amount of electricity consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Electric Motor Efficiency
definition: The ratio of output capacity to intake capacity.

name: Electrification Type
definition: Indicates the type of railway electrification.

name: Electro Magnetic Standards Compliance
definition: Information about compliance with regard to electro magnetic related standards.

name: Electronic Mail Addresses
definition: The list of Email addresses at which Email messages may be received.

name: Electronic Tripping Unit Type
definition: A list of the available types of electronic tripping unit  from which that required may be selected.

name: Element Type
definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute 'PredefinedType' is set to USERDEFINED.

name: Elevation
definition: Elevation of the entity

name: Elevational Flatness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the elevational surface in ZX, if different to the overall flatness.

name: Elevation Of FFLRelative
definition: Elevation of the top surface of the finished floor level given in elevation above the local zero height. If the level varies and there is no significantly more prominent elevation, then this property may be omitted. In case of any inconsistency with the geometric positioning of the top surface, the geometric representation takes precedence.

name: Elevation Of Ref Height
definition: Elevation above sea level of the reference height used for all storey elevation measures, equals to height 0.0. It is usually the ground floor level.

name: Elevation Of SSLRelative
definition: Elevation of the top surface of the structural slab level given in elevation above the local zero height. If the level varies and there is no significantly more prominent elevation, then this property may be omitted. In case of any inconsistency with the geometric positioning of the top surface, the geometric representation takes precedence.

name: Elevation Of Terrain
definition: Elevation above the minimal terrain level around the foot print of the building, given in elevation above sea level.

name: Elevation with Flooring
definition: Level of flooring of this space; the average shall be taken, if the space ground surface is sloping or if there are level differences within this space.

name: Enabled
definition: Indicates whether alarm is enabled or disabled over time.

name: Encapsulation Technology Code
definition: Code indicating the encapsulation technology which has been applied in an electric, electronic or electromechanical component.

name: End Date
definition: Date and time at which the permit ceases to be valid.

name: End Shape Type
definition: Defines the types of end shapes that can be used for preformed tanks. The convention for reading these enumerated values is that for a vertical cylinder, the first value is the base and the second is the top; for a horizontal cylinder, the order of reading should be left to right. For a speherical tank, the value UNSET should be used.

name: Energy Absorption
definition: Energy absorption capacity of the element.

name: Energy Absorption Tolerance
definition: Manufacturing tolerance on energy absorption

name: Energy Consumption
definition: Annual energy consumption requirement

name: Energy Conversion Efficiency
definition: Measure of the efficiency of conversion of fuel energy to mechanical energy

name: Energy Efficiency Ratio
definition: Energy efficiency ratio (EER).

name: Energy Gain Sensible
definition: The sum of total energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level sensible energy gains.

name: Energy Gain Total
definition: The total amount of energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level total energy gains.

name: Energy Loss
definition: The sum of energy losses for the spaces served by the system during the peak heating conditions.

name: Energy Source
definition:
Enumeration defining the energy source or fuel cumbusted.

Note: hydronic heaters shall use UNSET; dual-use hydronic/electric heaters shall use ELECTRICITY.

name: Energy Source Consumption
definition: Energy consumption.

name: Energy Source Label
definition: Type of energy source e.g. Electricity, Diesel, LPG etc. utilised by the element.

name: Entrance Level
definition: Indication whether this building storey is an entrance level to the building (TRUE), or (FALSE) if otherwise.

name: Equipment Capacity
definition: Indicates the equipment capacity of the appliance. The value is defined in bits/s.

name: Equipment Loading
definition: Loading from equipment

name: Equipment Sensible
definition: Heat gains and losses from equipment.

name: Equipment Sensible History
definition: Heat gains and losses from equipment.

name: Escort Requirement
definition: Indicates whether or not an escort is required to accompany persons carrying out a work order at or to/from the place of work (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).NOTE - There are many instances where escorting is required, particularly in a facility that has a high security rating. Escorting may require that persons are escorted to and from the place of work. Alternatively, it may involve the escort remaining at the place of work at all times.

name: Eutrophication
definition: Quantity of eutrophicating compounds calculated in equivalent PO4.

name: Eutrophication Per Unit
definition: Quantity of eutrophicating compounds calculated in equivalent PO4

name: Evaporating Temperature
definition: Refrigerant evaporating temperature.

name: Evaporator Coolant
definition: The fluid used for the coolant in the evaporator.

name: Evaporator Mean Void Fraction
definition: Mean void fraction in evaporator.

name: Evaporator Medium Type
definition:
ColdLiquid: Evaporator is using liquid type of fluid to exchange heat with refrigerant.
ColdAir: Evaporator is using air to exchange heat with refrigerant.

name: Exclusions
definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.

name: Exhaust Air
definition: Loads from exhaust air.

name: Exhaust Air Flow Rate
definition: Design exhaust air flow rate for the space.

name: Exhaust Air History
definition: Loads from exhaust air.

name: Expansion Direction
definition: The expansion direction, e.g. single direction, bi-direction

name: Expected Service Life
definition: Expected service life in years.

name: Explosive Atmosphere Standards Compliance
definition: Information about compliance with regard to explosive atmosphere related standards.

name: Exposure Class
definition: Classification of exposure to environmental conditions, usually specified in accordance with the concrete design code which is applied in the project.

name: Extend To Structure
definition: Indicates whether the object extend to the structure above (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Exterior Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Exterior heat transfer coefficient associated with exterior surface area.

name: External Adjusted
definition: An indication if the ground fault protection may be adjusted according to an external current coil or not.

name: External Surface Area
definition: External surface area (both primary and secondary area).

name: Extreme High Water Level
definition: Extreme high water level

name: Extreme Low Water Level
definition: Extreme low water level

name: Face Area
definition: Face area open to the airstream.

name: Face Surface Area
definition: Face area of filter frame.

name: Face Type
definition: Identifies how the terminal face of an AirTerminal is constructed.

name: Face Velocity
definition: Air velocity through the coil.

name: Facsimile Numbers
definition: The list of fax numbers at which fax messages may be received.

name: Fail Position
definition: Specifies the required fail-safe position of the actuator.

name: Failure Information
definition: The information for failure description.

name: Fairlead To Termination
definition: Distance from the fairlead to the bitt or winch on the vessel where the line terminates

name: Fan
definition: Indicates fan operation where True is on, False is off, and Unknown is automatic.

name: Fan Arrangement
definition:
Defines the fan and motor drive arrangement as defined by AMCA.ARRANGEMENT1: Arrangement 1.
ARRANGEMENT2: Arrangement 2.
ARRANGEMENT3: Arrangement 3.
ARRANGEMENT4: Arrangement 4.
ARRANGEMENT7: Arrangement 7.
ARRANGEMENT8: Arrangement 8.
ARRANGEMENT9: Arrangement 9.
ARRANGEMENT10: Arrangement 10.
OTHER: Other type of fan drive arrangement.

name: Fan Efficiency
definition: Fan mechanical efficiency.

name: Fan Mounting Type
definition: Defines the method of mounting the fan in the building.

name: Fan Power
definition: Fan motor loads contributing to the cooling load.

name: Fan Power Rate
definition: Fan power consumption.

name: Fan Rotation Speed
definition: Fan rotation speed.

name: Fastening Type
definition: Indicates the type of fastening used to generate traction between the foot of the rail and the sleeper. It depends on but is not uniquely identified by the type of sleeper. This property shall only be used when sleeper fastening is not modelled as an element.

name: Faucet Function
definition: Defines the operating temperature of a faucet that may be specified.

name: Faucet Operation
definition:
Defines the range of ways in which a faucet can be operated that may be specified where:CeramicDisc: Quick action faucet with a ceramic seal to open or close the orifice
.
LeverHandle: Quick action faucet that is operated by a lever handle
.
NonConcussiveSelfClosing:    Self closing faucet that does not induce surge pressure
.
QuarterTurn: Quick action faucet that can be fully opened or shut by turning the operating mechanism through 90 degrees.
QuickAction: Faucet that can be opened or closed fully with a single small movement of the operating mechanism
.
ScrewDown: Faucet in which a plate or disc is moved, by the rotation of a screwed spindle, to close or open the orifice.
SelfClosing: Faucet that is opened by pressure of the top of an operating spindle and is closed under the action of a spring or weight when the pressure is released.
TimedSelfClosing:   Self closing faucet that discharges for a predetermined period of time
.

name: Faucet Top Description
definition: Description of the operating mechanism/top of the faucet.

name: Faucet Type
definition:
Defines the range of faucet types that may be specified where:Bib:     Faucet with a horizontal inlet and a nozzle that discharges downwards.
Globe:   Faucet fitted through the end of a bath, with a horizontal inlet, a partially spherical body and a vertical nozzle.
Diverter:   Combination faucet assembly with a valve to enable the flow of mixed water to be transferred to a showerhead.
DividedFlowCombination:  Combination faucet assembly in which hot and cold water are kept separate until emerging from a common nozzle
.
Pillar:  Faucet that has a vertical inlet and a nozzle that discharges downwards
.
SingleOutletCombination =    Combination faucet assembly in which hot and cold water mix before emerging from a common nozzle
.
Spray:   Faucet with a spray outlet
.
SprayMixing:     Spray faucet connected to hot and cold water supplies that delivers water at a temperature determined during use.

name: Fault Priority Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:High: action is required urgently.
Medium: action can occur within a reasonable period of time.
Low: action can occur when convenient.

name: Fender Type
definition: The type of fender

name: Fiber Colour
definition: Indicates the colour of a single fiber.

name: Fiber Mode
definition: Indicates the fiber mode.

name: Fiber Tube Colour
definition: Indicates the colour of a single fiber tube.

name: Fiber Type
definition: Indicates the type of the single fiber.

name: Fill Gas
definition: Name of the gas by which the gap between two glass layers is filled. It is given for information purposes only.

name: Filling Depth
definition: Depth of filling (boreholeML).

name: Filling Material
definition: Filling material or 'NOT FILLED' or 'UNKNOWN' (boreholeML).

name: Fill Volume
definition: Relative volume of fill (controlled placement of anthropogenic soil) stratum constituents.

name: Final Resistance
definition: Filter fluid resistance when replacement is required (i.e., Pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter needs replacement per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

name: Fin Corrugated Type
definition: Description of a fin corrugated type.

name: Finish
definition: Description of the (surface) finish of the object for informational purposes.

name: Finish Ceiling Height
definition: Height of the suspended ceiling (from top of flooring to the bottom of the suspended ceiling). To be provided only if the space has a suspended ceiling with constant height.

name: Finish Colour
definition: The finish colour of the object.

name: Finish Floor Height
definition: Height of the flooring (from base slab without flooring to the flooring height). To be provided only if the space has a constant flooring height.

name: Finishing
definition: The finishing applied to system furniture elements of this type e.g. walnut, fabric.

name: Finish Type
definition: The type of finish for the air terminal.

name: Fire Exit
definition:
Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Here it defines an exit window in accordance to the national building code.

name: Fire Fighting Lift
definition: Indication whether the elevator is designed to serve as a fire fighting lift the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE). A fire fighting lift is used by fire fighters to access the location of fire and to evacuate people.

name: Fire Hydrant Type
definition:
Defines the range of hydrant types from which the required type can be selected where.DryBarrel:   A hydrant that has isolating valves fitted below ground and that may be used where the possibility of water freezing is a consideration.
WetBarrel:   A hydrant that has isolating valves fitted above ground and that may be used where there is no possibility of water freezing.

name: Fire Proofing Standards Compliance
definition: Information about compliance with regard to fire proofing related standards.

name: Fire Protection Class
definition: Main fire protection class for the building which is assigned from the fire protection classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

name: Fire Rating
definition: Fire rating for this object. It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

name: Fire Resistance Rating
definition: Measure of the fire resistance rating in hours (e.g., 1.5 hours, 2 hours, etc.).

name: Fire Risk Factor
definition: Fire Risk factor assigned to the space according to local building regulations. It defines the fire risk of the space at several levels of fire hazard.

name: Fire Sensor Set Point
definition: The temperature value to be sensed to indicate the presence of fire.

name: Firmware Version
definition: Indicates version of device firmware according to device manufacturer.

name: First Curvature Radius
definition: FirstCurvatureRadius should be defined as the base or left side radius of curvature value.

name: First Mullion Offset
definition: Offset of the mullion centerline, measured along the x-axis of the window placement coordinate system. An offset value = 0.5 indicates that the mullion is positioned in the middle of the window.

name: First Transom Offset
definition: Offset of the transom centerline, measured along the z-axis of the window placement coordinate system. An offset value = 0.5 indicates that the transom is positioned in the middle of the window.

name: Fitting Loss Factor
definition: A factor that determines the pressure loss due to friction through the fitting.

name: Fixing Socket Height
definition: The overall height of the fixing socket.

name: Fixing Socket Thread Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the thread.

name: Fixing Socket Thread Length
definition: The length of the threaded part of the fixing socket.

name: Fixing Socket Type Reference
definition: Type reference for the fixing socket according to local standards.

name: Fixture Height
definition: The height of the fixture, such as the text height of an exit sign.

name: Flammability Rating
definition:
Flammability Rating for this object.
It is given according to the national building code that governs the rating of flammability for materials.

name: Flammable Storage
definition: Indication whether the space is intended to serve as a storage of flammable material (which is regarded as such by the presiding building code. (TRUE) indicates yes, (FALSE) otherwise.

name: Flange Diameter
definition: Overall diameter of the flange.

name: Flange Standard
definition: Designation of the standard describing the flange table.

name: Flange Table
definition: Designation of the standard table to which the flange conforms.

name: Flange Thickness
definition: Thickness of the material from which the pipe bend is constructed.

name: Floor Area Ratio
definition: The ratio of all floor areas to the buildable area as the maximum floor area utilization of the site as a maximum value according to local building codes.

name: Floor Covering
definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space flooring. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.The material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=FLOORING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Floor Covering Thickness
definition: Thickness of the material layer(s) for the space flooring.The thickness information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=FLOORING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned IfcCovering and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Flow Arrangement
definition:
Defines the basic flow arrangements for the heat exchanger or cooler tower:COUNTERFLOW: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CROSSFLOW: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
PARALLELFLOW: Air and water flow enter in same directions.
MULTIPASS: Multipass flow heat exchanger arrangement. 
OTHER: Other type of heat exchanger flow arrangement not defined above.

name: Flow Class
definition: Alphanumeric indication of the flow class of a hydrant (may be used in connection with or instead of the FlowRate property).

name: Flow Coefficient
definition: Flow coefficient (the quantity of fluid that passes through a fully open valve at unit pressure drop), typically expressed as the Kv or Cv value for the valve.

name: Flow Condition
definition: Defines the flow condition as a percentage of the cross-sectional area.

name: Flow Condition History
definition: Defines the flow condition as a percentage of the cross-sectional area.

name: Flow Control Type
definition: Type of flow control element that may be included as a part of the construction of the air terminal.

name: Flow Loading
definition: Flow loading force

name: Flow Meter Ourpose
definition: Enumeration defining the purpose of the flow meter occurrence.

name: Flow Pattern
definition: Flow pattern.

name: Flowrate
definition: The flowrate of the fluid.

name: Flowrate Leakage
definition: Leakage flowrate versus pressure difference.

name: Flow Rate Range
definition: Allowable range of volume of fluid being pumped against the resistance specified.

name: Flow Rating
definition: Actual flow capacity for the gutter. Value of 0.00 means this value has not been set.

name: Flow Resistance Range
definition: Allowable range of frictional resistance against which the fluid is being pumped.

name: Fluid Flow Leakage
definition: Volumetric leakage flow rate.

name: Fluid Pressure Range
definition: Allowable water working pressure range inside the tube.

name: Flushing Rate
definition: The predetermined quantity of water to be flushed.

name: Flush Rate
definition: The minimum and maximum volume of water used at each flush. Where a single flush is used, the value of upper bound and lower bound should be equal. For a dual flush toilet, the lower bound should be used for the lesser flush rate and the upper bound for the greater flush rate. Where flush is achieved using mains pressure water through a flush valve, the value of upper and lower bound should be equal and should be the same as the flush rate property of the flush valve (see relevant valve property set). Alternatively, in this case, do not assert the flush rate property; refer to the flush rate of the flush valve.

name: Flush Type
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_FlushTypeEnum defines the types of flushing mechanism that may be specified for cisterns and sanitary terminals where:-Lever:  Flushing is achieved by twisting a lever that causes a predetermined flow of water to be passed from a cistern to the sanitary terminal.
Pull:   Flushing is achieved by pulling a handle or knob vertically upwards that causes a predetermined flow of water to be passed from a cistern to the sanitary terminal.
Push:   Flushing is achieved by pushing a button or plate that causes a predetermined flow of water to be passed from a cistern to the sanitary terminal.
Sensor: Flush is activated through an automatic sensing mechanism.

name: Foot Print Area
definition: Gross area of the site covered by the building(s).

name: Force
definition: Indicates the maximum close-off force for the actuator.

name: Foreign Object Detection Sensor Type
definition: Indicates the type of foreign object detection sensor.

name: Form Stripping Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete at form stripping time.

name: Fouling Factor
definition: Fouling factor of the tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Fountain Type
definition:
Selection of the type of fountain from the enumerated list of types where:-DrinkingWater:  Sanitary appliance that provides a low pressure jet of drinking water.
Eyewash:    Waste water appliance, usually installed in work places where there is a risk of injury to eyes by solid particles or dangerous liquids, with which the user can wash the eyes without touching them.

name: Fraction Convective Heat Transfer
definition: Fraction of the total heat transfer rate as the convective heat transfer.

name: Fraction Of Motor Heat To Air Stream
definition: Fraction of the motor heat released into the fluid flow.

name: Fraction Radiant Heat Transfer
definition: Fraction of the total heat transfer rate as the radiant heat transfer.

name: Fragility Rating
definition: Indication on the fragility of the covering (e.g., under fire conditions).  It is given according to the national building code that might provide a classification for fragility.

name: Frame Depth
definition:
The length (or depth) of the frame.

For a window, it is the depth of panel frame, measured from front face to back face horizontally (i.e. perpendicular to the window elevation plane).

name: Frame Material
definition: Filter frame material.

name: Frame Size
definition: Designation of the frame size according to the named range of frame sizes designated at the place of use or according to a given standard.

name: Frame Thickness
definition:
The thickness of the frame.

For a window, it is the width of panel frame, measured from inside of panel (at glazing) to outside of panel (at lining), i.e. parallel to the window (elevation) plane.

name: Frame Type
definition: The type of frame used by the damper (e.g., Standard, Single Flange, Single Reversed Flange, Double Flange, etc.).

name: Freezing Point
definition: The freezing point of the material (fluid).

name: Frequency Response
definition: Indicates the output over a specified range of frequencies.

name: Friction Angle
definition: Friction angle is the tested inclination angle from horizontal.

name: Friction Behaviour
definition: Friction shear strength of a rock or soil that is dependent on interparticle friction.

name: Friction Heat Gain
definition: Friction heat gain.

name: Friction Loss
definition: The pressure loss due to friction per unit length. (Data type = PressureMeasure/LengthMeasure)

name: Fuel
definition: The amount of fuel consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Full Load Ratio
definition: Ratio of actual power to full load power as a quadratic function of part load, at certain condensing and evaporating temperature, FracFullLoadPower = f ( PartLoadRatio).

name: Full Load Ratio Curve
definition: Ratio of actual power to full load power as a quadratic function of part load, at certain condensing and evaporating temperature, FracFullLoadPower = f ( PartLoadRatio).

name: Full Scale Output
definition: Indicates the full scale output of the earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

name: Function
definition: Type of function for which the conductor is intended.

name: Functional Unit Reference
definition: Reference to a database or a classification

name: Function Reliable
definition: Element (such as cable, bus, core) maintain given properties/functions over a given (tested) time and conditions. According to IEC standard.

name: Funding Source
definition: Investment funding source

name: Furniture Panel Type
definition: Available panel types from which that required may be selected.

name: Fuse Disconnector Type
definition:
A list of the available types of fuse disconnector from which that required may be selected where:EngineProtectionDevice: A fuse whose characteristic is specifically designed for the protection of a motor or generator.
FuseSwitchDisconnector: A switch disconnector in which a fuse link or a fuse carrier with fuse link forms the moving contact,
HRC: A standard fuse (High Rupturing Capacity)
OverloadProtectionDevice: A device that disconnects the supply when the operating conditions in an electrically undamaged circuit causes an overcurrent,
SemiconductorFuse: A fuse whose characteristic is specifically designed for the protection of sem-conductor devices.
SwitchDisconnectorFuse: A switch disconnector in which one or more poles have a fuse in series in a composite unit.

name: Fusible Link Temperature
definition: The temperature that the fusible link melts.

name: Gas Detected
definition: Identification of the gas that is being detected, according to chemical formula.  For example, carbon monoxide is 'CO', carbon dioxide is 'CO2', oxygen is 'O2'.

name: Gas Pressure
definition: Fill pressure (e.g. for between-pane gas fills): the pressure exerted by a mass of gas confined in a constant volume.

name: Gas Type
definition: Defines the types of gas that may be specified.

name: Glass Colour
definition: Colour (tint) selection for this glazing. It is given for information purposes only.

name: Glass Layers
definition: Number of glass layers within the frame. E.g. "2" for double glazing.

name: Glass Thickness1
definition: Thickness of the first (inner) glass layer.

name: Glass Thickness2
definition: Thickness of the second (intermediate or outer) glass layer.

name: Glass Thickness3
definition: Thickness of the third (outer) glass layer.

name: Glazing Area Fraction
definition:
Fraction of the glazing area relative to the total area of the filling element.
It shall be used, if the glazing area is not given separately for all panels within the filling element.

name: Global ID
definition: Assignment of a globally unique identifier within the entire software world.

name: Global Trade Item Number
definition: The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is an identifier for trade items developed by GS1 (www.gs1.org).

name: Gradient
definition: The gradient of the pipe segment.

name: Grain Size
definition: Grain size diameter.

name: Gravel Volume
definition: Relative volume of gravel (typically larger than 2mm) stratum constituents.

name: Gross Area
definition:
Gross Area of the object. Openings, recesses, projections and cut-outs are not taken into account.

Including the outer frame.

name: Gross Ceiling Area
definition: Sum of all ceiling areas of the space. It includes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.). The ceiling area is the real (and not the projected) area (e.g. in case of sloped ceilings).

name: Gross Cross Section Area
definition:
Area of the cross section.

Including the pipe itself and the interior flow space.

name: Gross Floor Area
definition:
Sum of all gross floor areas within the spatial structure element.

Includes the area covered by elements inside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.) and excludes the area covered by wall claddings.

name: Gross Height
definition: Standard gross height of this storey, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the top surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

name: Gross Perimeter
definition:
Gross perimeter at the outer contour of the object.

Measured at floor level with all sides of the space, including those parts of the perimeter that are created by virtual boundaries and openings (like doors).

name: Gross Planned Area
definition: Total planned gross area of the spatial structure element. Used for programming the spatial structure element.

name: Gross Side Area
definition: Area of the wall as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the wall.  It does not take into account any wall modifications (such as openings).

name: Gross Surface Area
definition: Total gross area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area. It is the sum of OuterSurfaceArea + (2 x CrossSectionArea) and shall only be given, if the OuterSurfaceArea and CrossSectionArea cannot be established separately.

name: Gross Volume
definition: Total gross volume of the object. Openings, recesses, enclosed objects and projections are not taken into account.

name: Gross Wall Area
definition: Sum of all wall (and other vertically bounding elements, like columns) areas bounded by the space. It includes the area covered by elements inside the wall area (doors, windows, other openings, etc.).

name: Gross Weight
definition: Total Gross Weight of the object without any add-on parts and not taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

name: Ground Fault Current Set Value
definition: Ground fault current set value. The set value of the ground tripping current if adjustable.

name: Ground Fault Function
definition: Applying ground fault function. A flag indicating that the ground fault function of the device is used. The value should be set to FALSE for devices not having a ground fault function, or if the ground fault function is not selected to be used.

name: Ground Faulti2t Function
definition: Applying ground fault i2t function. A flag indicating that the I2t ground fault function of the device is used. The value should be set to TRUE only if the I2t function is explicitly selected for the device.

name: Ground Fault Tripping Time
definition: Ground fault tripping time. The set value of the ground fault tripping current if adjustable.

name: Grounding Type
definition: The type of grounding connection.

name: Ground Resistance
definition: The soil or ground resistance to electrical current from the cable fitting.

name: Groundwater Depth
definition: Depth groundwater encountered (boreholeML).

name: Group Code
definition: e.g. panels, worksurfaces, storage, etc.

name: Guard Rail Connection
definition: Indicates how the guard rail is connected along its length, when the fasteners are not explicitly modelled.

name: Guard Rail Type
definition: Type of the guard rail.

name: Gully Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of gully from which the type required may be set.

name: Halogen Proof
definition: Produces small amount of smoke and irritating Deaerator/Gas.

name: Handicap Accessible
definition: Indication that this object is designed to be accessible by the handicapped. Set to (TRUE) if this object is rated as handicap accessible according to the local building codes, otherwise (FALSE). It is giving according to the requirements of the national building code.

name: Hand Signalling Prohibited
definition: Indicates if hand signalling is prohibited in case of any failure.

name: Hanging Height
definition: The hanging height of the worksurface.

name: Hardening Module
definition: A measure of the hardening module of the material (slope of stress versus strain curve after yield range).

name: Hardness
definition: Water hardness as positive, multivalent ion concentration in the water (usually concentrations of calcium and magnesium ions in terms of calcium carbonate).

name: Has Anti Static Surface
definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent electrostatic charge (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Ballast Track
definition: Indicates whether the track has ballast or not.

name: Has Break Line Lock
definition: Indicates whether the equipment has the function of brake line lock or not.

name: Has Built In Alarm
definition: Indicates whether the smoke sensor is included as an element within a smoke alarm/sensor unit (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Caps
definition: Does the inlet connection have protective caps.

name: Has Coating
definition: TRUE if the fin has a coating, FALSE if it does not.

name: Has Conductor Rail Guard Board
definition: Indicates if a guard board is provided.

name: Has Connector
definition: Indicate whether the wire pair end point is terminated with a connector or not.

name: Has Cover
definition: Indication of whether the cable tray has a cover (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE). By default, this value should be set to FALSE..

name: Has CWR
definition: Indicates if the track has continuous welded rails.

name: Has Deflector
definition: Indication of whether the sprinkler has a deflector (baffle) fitted to diffuse the discharge on activation (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Has Defrost
definition: has the heat exchanger has defrost function or not.

name: Has Drainage
definition: Indicates whether the infrastructure element has drainage embedded or not.

name: Has Drive
definition: Indication whether this object has an automatic drive to operate it (TRUE) or no drive (FALSE)

name: Has Earthquake Alarm
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit includes earthquake alarm function.

name: Has Earthquake Collection
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects earthquake information.

name: Has Exterior Insulation
definition: TRUE if the silencer has exterior insulation. FALSE if it does not.

name: Has Fan
definition: Terminal box has a fan inside (fan powered box).

name: Has Foreign Object Collection
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects foreign object information.

name: Has Grab Handles
definition: Indicates whether the bath is fitted with handles that provide assistance to a bather in entering or leaving the bath.

name: Has Hose Union
definition: Indicates whether the object is fitted with a hose union connection (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Has Hot Gas Bypass
definition: Whether or not hot gas bypass is provided for the compressor. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

name: Has Increasing Station
definition: Inform on the increasing or decreasing progress of stationing values, for referents nested in a given alignment.If present and true, or if not present, then the relevant subsequently nested referents are expected to have greater Pset_Stationing.Station values (i.e., increasing stations).If present and false, then the relevant subsequently nested referents are expected to have lower Pset_Stationing.Station values (i.e., decreasing stations).

name: Has Integral Control
definition: If TRUE, a self powered temperature control is included in the AirTerminal.

name: Has Integral Shut Off Device
definition: Indication of whether the flushing valve has an integral shut off device fitted (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE).

name: Has Ladder
definition: Indication of whether the tank is provided with a ladder (set TRUE) for access to the top. If no ladder is provided then value is set FALSE.Note: No indication is given of the type of ladder (gooseneck etc.)

name: Has Lightning Rod
definition: Indicates whether the element is equipped with a lightning rod (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Liner
definition: TRUE if the fitting has interior duct insulating lining, FALSE if it does not.

name: Has Lock
definition: Indication of whether a switching device has a key operated lock (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Has Lock Inside
definition: Indicates whether the locking is inside  (TRUE) or outside (FALSE) of the point machine.

name: Has Non Skid Surface
definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent slippery (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Opening
definition: indicates whether the panel has an opening (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Has Output Function
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit includes an output function.

name: Has Part Winding
definition: Indication of whether the motor is single speed, i.e. has a single winding (= FALSE) or multi-speed i.e.has part winding (= TRUE) .

name: Has Protective Earth
definition: Indicates whether the object has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Has Rail Drainage
definition: Indicates whether there is rail drainage or not.

name: Has Rain Collection
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects information on rain.

name: Has Return Air
definition: Terminal box has return air mixed with supply air from duct work.

name: Has Sill External
definition: Indication whether the window opening has an external sill (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Sill Internal
definition: Indication whether the window opening has an internal sill (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Snow Collection
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects information on snow depth.

name: Has Sound Attenuation
definition: TRUE if the coil has sound attenuation, FALSE if it does not.

name: Has Sound Attenuator
definition: If TRUE, the object has sound attenuation.

name: Has Special Equipment
definition: Indicates whether the sleeper has any special equipment for fastening components (e.g. Balise, signum magnet) or not.

name: Has Steps
definition: Indicates whether the chamber has steps (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Has Strainer
definition: Indicates whether the gully trap has a strainer (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Has Thermal Insulation
definition: If TRUE, the air terminal has thermal insulation.

name: Has Tight Jacket
definition: Indicates whether the fiber has a tight jacket or not.

name: Has Tray
definition: Indicates whether the shower has a separate receptacle that catches the water in a shower and directs it to a waste outlet.

name: Has Turbulator
definition: TRUE if the tube has a turbulator, FALSE if it does not.

name: Has Visual Indicator
definition: Indication of whether the tank is provided with a visual indicator (set TRUE) that shows the water level in the tank. If no visual indicator is provided then value is set FALSE.

name: Has Wind Collection
definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects information on wind.

name: Hazardous Waste
definition: Quantity of hazardous waste generated.

name: Hazardous Waste Per Unit
definition: Quantity of hazardous waste generated

name: Headroom
definition:
Actual headroom clearance for the passageway according to the current design.
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Head Shape
definition: Shape of the bolt's head, e.g. 'Hexagon', 'Countersunk', 'Cheese'

name: Heat
definition: The amount of heat energy consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Heat Dissipation
definition: Indicates the heat dissipation of the electric device measured in power.

name: Heat Exchange Area
definition: Heat exchange area.

name: Heat Exchange Surface Area
definition: Heat exchange surface area associated with U-value.

name: Heating Air Flow Rate
definition: Heating air flow rate in the space.

name: Heating Capacity
definition: Heating capacity.

name: Heating Design Air Flow
definition: The air flowrate required during the peak heating conditions, but could also be determined by minimum ventilation requirement or minimum air change requirements.

name: Heating Design Day
definition: The month, day and time that has been selected for the heating design calculations.

name: Heating Dry Bulb
definition: Dry bulb temperature for heating design.

name: Heating Efficiency
definition: Heating efficiency under full load heating conditions.

name: Heating Relative Humidity
definition: Inside relative humidity for heating design.

name: Heating Temperature Delta
definition: Heating temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates.

name: Heating Water Flow Rate
definition: Water flow rate for heating.

name: Heating Wet Bulb
definition: Outside wet bulb temperature for heating design.

name: Heat Output
definition:
Total nominal heat output as listed by the Boiler manufacturer.

For water boilers, it is a function of inlet versus outlet temperature. For steam boilers, it is a function of inlet temperature versus steam pressure.  Note: as two variables are used, DefiningValues and DefinedValues are null, and values are stored in IfcTable in the following order: InletTemperature(IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure), OutletTemperature(IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure), HeatOutput(IfcEnergyMeasure).  The IfcTable is related to IfcPropertyTableValue using IfcMetric and IfcResourceConstraintRelationship.

name: Heat Output Rate
definition: Overall heat transfer rate.

name: Heat Rejection Rate
definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

name: Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Heat transfer coefficient-area product.

name: Heat Transfer Dimension
definition: Indicates how heat is transmitted according to the shape of the space heater.

name: Heat Transfer Medium
definition: Enumeration defining the heat transfer medium if applicable.

name: Heat Transfer Surface Area
definition: Total heat transfer area of the vessel.

name: Heat Transfer Type Enum
definition: Type of heat transfer between the two air streams.

name: Height
definition:
Characteristic height

Total outer height of the window lining. It should only be provided, if it is a rectangular window.

name: Height Above Main Deck
definition: Height of the fairlead above the main deck of the vessel

name: Higher Heating Value
definition: Higher Heating Value is defined as the amount of energy released (MJ/kg) when a fuel is burned completely, and H2O is in liquid form in the combustion products.

name: Highest Seating Height
definition: The value of seating height of high level if the chair height is adjustable.

name: High Water Level
definition: High water level

name: Hindering Obstacles Description
definition: Description of obstacles that hinder the visibility for the staff in the station.

name: Hollow Core Plugging
definition: A descriptive label for how the hollow core ends are treated: they may be left open, closed with a plug, or sealed with cast concrete. Values would be, for example: 'Unplugged', 'Plugged', 'SealedWithConcrete'. This property applies to  hollow core slabs only.

name: Hollow Sleeper Usage
definition: Indicates the purpose of using hollow sleeper. The possible value can be eg. cable trenching, protection of turnout mechanism, etc.

name: Hoop Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the hoop bar.

name: Horizontal Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the horizontal bar.

name: Horizontal Flatness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the horizontal surface in XY, if different to the overall flatness.

name: Horizontal Orthogonality
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in X, if different to the overall orthogonality.

name: Horizontal Spacing
definition: Horizontal spacing between tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Horizontal Straightness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness  associated to the horizontal shape in X, if different to the overall straightness.

name: Horizontal Tolerance
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in X, if different to the overall tolerance.

name: Horizontal Uncertainty
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

name: Hose Connection Size
definition: The size of connections to which a hose may be connected (other than that to be linked to a pumping unit).

name: Hose Diameter
definition: Notional diameter (bore) of the hose.

name: Hose Length
definition: Notional length of the hose fitted to the hose reel when fully extended.

name: Hose Nozzle Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of nozzle (in terms of spray pattern) fitted to the end of the hose from which the type required may be set.

name: Hose Reel Mounting Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of hose reel mounting from which the type required may be set.

name: Hose Reel Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of hose arrangement from which the type required may be set.

name: Hot Strip Orientation
definition: Position of the hot strip, which indicates the direction of the focus of the light beam and is given in terms like "left upper quadrant (LUQ)" or "5 o'clock".

name: Housing Thickness
definition: Air terminal box housing material thickness.

name: Humidifier Application
definition:
Humidifier application.Fixed: Humidifier installed in a ducted flow distribution system.
Portable: Humidifier is not installed in a ducted flow distribution system.

name: Humidity Effectiveness
definition: Humidity heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of primary airflow absolute humidity changes to maximum possible absolute humidity changes.

name: Humidity Max
definition: Maximal permitted humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Humidity Min
definition: Minimal permitted humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Humidity Set Point
definition: Humidity of the space or zone that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space humidity requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period. Provide this property, if no humidity range (Min-Max) is available.

name: Humidity Summer
definition: Humidity of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

name: Humidity Winter
definition: Humidity of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.

name: Hydraulic Conductivity
definition: Hydraulic Conductivity (permeability) of soil for water, given with the K or Kf value in m/s

name: Hydraulic Diameter
definition: Hydraulic diameter.

name: Hygrothermal Rating
definition: Resistance against hygrothermal impact from different temperatures and humidities inside and outside. It is given according to the national code or regulation.

name: I1
definition: The (thermal) lower testing current limit in [x In], indicating that for currents lower than I1, the tripping time shall be longer than the associated tripping time, T2.

name: I2
definition: The (thermal) upper testing current limit in [x In], indicating that for currents larger than I2, the tripping time shall be shorter than the associated tripping time, T2.

name: I2 TApplicability
definition: The applicability of the time adjustment related to the tripping function.

name: IC60269
definition: The breaking capacity in [A] for fuses in accordance with the IEC 60269 series.

name: ICM60947
definition: The making capacity in [A] for a circuit breaker or motor protection device tested in accordance with the IEC 60947 series.

name: ICN60898
definition: The nominal breaking capacity in [A] for an MCB tested in accordance with the IEC 60898 series.

name: ICS60898
definition: The service breaking capacity in [A] for an MCB tested in accordance with the IEC 60898 series.

name: ICS60947
definition: The service breaking capacity in [A] for an object tested in accordance with the IEC 60947 series.

name: ICU60947
definition: The ultimate breaking capacity in [A] for an object tested in accordance with the IEC 60947 series.

name: ICW60947
definition: The thermal withstand current in [A] for a circuit breaker or motor protection device tested in accordance with the IEC 60947 series. The value shall be related to 1 s.

name: Ideal Capacity
definition: Compressor capacity under ideal conditions.

name: Ideal Shaft Power
definition: Compressor shaft power under ideal conditions.

name: If Not Accomplished
definition: Comments if the job is not accomplished.

name: IK_Code
definition: IK Code according to IEC 62262 (2002) is a numeric classification for the degree of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against external mechanical impacts.NOTE  In earlier labeling, the third numeral (1..) had been occasionally added to the closely related IP Code on ingress protection, to indicate the level of impact protection.

name: Illuminance
definition: Required average illuminance value for this space.

name: Image Resolution
definition: Indicates the image resolution of snow depth meter.

name: Image Shooting Mode
definition: Indicates the type or manner of snow depth meter image shooting.

name: Imaginary Impedance Ratio
definition:
The ratio between the imaginary part of the zero sequence impedance and the imaginary part of the positive impedance (i.e. imaginary part of the short-circuit voltage) of the transformer.
Used for three-phase transformer which includes a N-conductor.

name: Impact Parameter
definition: Impact parameter of the equipment.

name: Impedence
definition: Indicates the speaker impedence.

name: Impeller Diameter
definition: Diameter of object - used to scale performance of geometrically similar objects.

name: Impurities Content
definition: Fraction of impurities such as dust to the total amount of water. This is measured in weight of impurities per weight of water and is therefore unitless.

name: Incoming Station
definition: The optional station value of the incoming segment that ends at this location. This value needs to be set if the intention is to specify a station equation, i.e. a location where stationing changes.

name: Indication Rod Movement Range
definition: Indicates the range of indication rod movement.

name: Indicators Unit
definition: The unit of the quantity the environmental indicators values are related with.

name: Indoor Environment
definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the indoor environment (where appropriate).

name: Inductance
definition: Measure of the Inductance.

name: Induction Ratio
definition: Induction ratio versus distance from the diffuser and its discharge direction; induction ratio (or entrainment ratio) is the ratio of the volumetric flow rate in the jet to the volumetric flow rate at the air terminal.

name: Inert Waste
definition: Quantity of inert waste generated .

name: Inert Waste Per Unit
definition: Quantity of inert waste generated

name: Infiltration
definition: Infiltration flowrate of outside air for the filler object based on the area of the filler object at a pressure level of 50 Pascals. It shall be used, if the length of all joints is unknown.

name: Infiltration Diversity Summer
definition: Diversity factor for Summer infiltration.

name: Infiltration Diversity Winter
definition: Diversity factor for Winter infiltration.

name: Infiltration Sensible

name: Lamp Ballast Type
definition:
The type of ballast used to stabilise gas discharge by limiting the current during operation and to deliver the necessary striking voltage for starting. Ballasts are needed to operate Discharge Lamps such as Fluorescent, Compact Fluorescent, High-pressure Mercury, Metal Halide and High-pressure Sodium Lamps.
Magnetic ballasts are chokes which limit the current passing through a lamp connected in series on the principle of self-induction. The resultant current and power are decisive for the efficient operation of the lamp. A specially designed ballast is required for every type of lamp to comply with lamp rating in terms of Luminous Flux, Color Appearance and service life. The two types of magnetic ballasts for fluorescent lamps are KVG Conventional   (EC-A series) and VVG Low-loss ballasts (EC-B series). Low-loss ballasts have a higher efficiency, which means reduced ballast losses and a lower thermal load. Electronic ballasts are used to run fluorescent lamps at high frequencies (approx. 35 - 40 kHz).

name: LRMUnit
definition: Specifies the units of measure used by this Linear Referencing Method for measures along the linear element being measured.NOTE Definition according to ISO 19148:2021.

name: Lubricant Pump Heat Gain
definition: Lubricant pump heat gain.

name: Lubrication Power Supply Type
definition: Type of power supply method used by the rail lubrication.

name: Lubrication System Type
definition: Design and type of lubricating system e.g. active, passive.

name: Main Colour
definition: The main colour of the furniture of this type.

name: Maintenance Downtime
definition: Maintenance downtime proportion.

name: Maintenance Factor
definition: The arithmetical allowance made for depreciation of lamps and reflective equipment from their initial values due to dirt, fumes, or age.

name: Maintenance Level
definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the level or degree of maintenance applied to dcomponents.

name: Maintenance Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of maintenance that can be done from which the type that generates the maintenance work order may be set where:ConditionBased: generated as a result of the condition of an asset or artefact being less than a determined value.
Corrective: generated as a result of an immediate and urgent need for maintenance action.
PlannedCorrective: generated as a result of immediate corrective action being needed but with sufficient time available for the work order to be included in maintenance planning.
Scheduled: generated as a result of a fixed, periodic maintenance requirement.

name: Managing Software
definition: Indicates the type of software responsible for managing the equipment.

name: Manual Override
definition: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE). Note that this value should be set to FALSE by default in the case of a Hand Operated Actuator.

name: Manufacturer
definition: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

name: Manufacturing Date
definition: Date on which the element was manufactured.

name: Manufacturing Technology
definition: The method / technology used to produce the equipment.

name: Manufacturing Tolerance Class
definition: Classification designation of the manufacturing tolerances according to local standards.

name: Margin Of Error
definition: Indicates the margin of error of the measurement.

name: Marker Type
definition: The type of marker (sign) e.g. stop signal, restriction signal, track circuit tuning zone sign or others specified in PEnum_MarkerType.

name: Market Category
definition: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

name: Market Sub Categories Available Future
definition: A list of the sub categories of property that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

name: Market Sub Categories Available Now
definition: A list of the sub categories of property that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

name: Market Sub Category
definition: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise.

name: Marking Rod Movement Length
definition: The length of the movement bar which indicates the turnout position.

name: Mass
definition: Mass represented, if lower surface of stratum known.

name: Mass Density
definition: Material mass density.

name: Mass Flow Rate
definition: The mass flow rate of the fluid.

name: Mass Flow Rate History
definition: The mass flow rate of the fluid.

name: Mass Per Length
definition: Mass per length, i.e. mass of a beam with a unit length of extrusion. For example measured in kg/m.

name: Material Colour
definition: Actual colour on the road marking material

name: Material Thickness
definition: Nominal thickness of the applied material

name: Material Type
definition: Material type used... e.g. paint, tape, thermoplastic, stone

name: Max Adjustment X_ICS
definition: Provides the maximum setting value for the available current adjustment in relation to the Ics breaking capacity of the protection device of which the actual tripping unit is a part of. The value is not asserted unless the instantaneous time protection is.

name: Max Aggregate Size
definition: The maximum aggregate size of the concrete.

name: Max Ambient Temp
definition: Maximum ambient temperature of the site used as a basis of design

name: Maximum Air Flow Rate
definition: Maximum allowable air flow rate.

name: Maximum Allowed Voltage Drop
definition:
The maximum voltage drop across the circuit that must not be exceeded.
There are two  voltage drop limit settings that may be applied; one for sub-main circuits, and one in each Distribution Board or Consumer Unit for final circuits connected to that board. The settings should limit the overall voltage drop to the required level. Default settings of 1.5% for sub-main circuits and 2.5% for final circuits, giving an overall limit of 4% may be applied.
NOTE: This value may also be specified as a constraint within an IFC model if required but is included within the property set at this stage pending implementation of the required capabilities within software applications.

name: Maximum Angular Velocity
definition: Identifies the maximum angular velocity of the kinematic behaviour.

name: Maximum Apparent Power
definition: Maximum apparent power/capacity in VA (volt ampere).

name: Maximum Atmospheric Pressure
definition: Maximum level of atmospheric pressure that the equipment can operate effectively in.

name: Maximum Bending Radius
definition: The maximum bending radius that the cable could withstand.

name: Maximum Cable Length
definition: Maximum cable length based on voltagedrop. NOTE: This value may also be specified as a constraint within an IFC model if required but is included within the property set at this stage pending implementation of the required capabilities within software applications.

name: Maximum Constant Speed
definition: Identifies the maximum constant speed over the kinematic path.

name: Maximum Current
definition: The maximum allowed current that a device is certified to handle.

name: Maximum Display Distance
definition: The maximum distance that can be displayed. The value relates only to the signal type, not to the circumstances at a special position.

name: Maximum Downstream Navigable Water Level
definition: Design maximum downstream water level for the lock complex

name: Maximum Flow Rate
definition: Maximum rate of flow which the meter is expected to pass.

name: Maximum Insulated Voltage
definition: The max voltage that the insulation would operate normally

name: Maximum Line Count
definition: Maximum number of lines that may be secured to the mooring device.

name: Maximum Line Slope
definition: Maximum allowable line angle in degrees (negative if below horizontal from quay)

name: Maximum Load Retention
definition: Maximum possible impact load retention.

name: Maximum Noise Emissions
definition: Maximum noise emissions limit at this location.

name: Maximum Operating Temperature
definition: The maximum temperature at which a cable or bus is certified to operate.

name: Maximum Operating Time
definition: The maximum duration of the turnout movement before the interlocking turns to out of control status.

name: Maximum Outlet Pressure
definition: Maximum steam outlet pressure.

name: Maximum Part Load Ratio
definition: Maximum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

name: Maximum Plenum Sensible Load
definition: Maximum or Peak sensible thermal load contributed to return air plenum by the light fixture.

name: Maximum Power Output
definition: The maximum output power rating of the engine.

name: Maximum Pressure Loss
definition: Pressure loss expected across the meter under conditions of maximum flow.

name: Maximum Rain Intensity
definition: Maximum level of rain intensity that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is usually measured in millimeter per hour (mm/h).

name: Maximum Short Circuit Temperature
definition: The maximum short circuit temperature at which a cable or bus is certified to operate.

name: Maximum Solar Radiation
definition: Maximum level of solar irradiance that the equipment can operate effectively in. This is usually tested and measured by a national or international standard. The value indicates power density measured in watt per square meter (w/m2).

name: Maximum Space Sensible Load
definition: Maximum or Peak sensible thermal load contributed to the conditioned space by the light fixture.

name: Maximum Speed Limit Of Diverging Line
definition: Maximum speed for diverging line that corresponds to the type of turnout and design constraints.

name: Maximum Supported Weight
definition: The maximum weight that can be carried by the vibration isolator.

name: Maximum Temperature Factor
definition: Deviation in performance due to maximum design temperature

name: Maximum Transfer Rate
definition: Indicates the transmission rate in bit/s over the wired port.

name: Maximum Transmission Attenuation
definition: Indicates the Maximum transmission attenuation of feeder.

name: Maximum Upstream Navigable Water Level
definition: Design maximum upstream water level for the lock complex

name: Maximum Velocity
definition: The maximum design velocity of the air in the duct or fitting.

name: Maximum Vibration
definition: Maximum tolerable vibration level of the device.

name: Maximum Wind Speed
definition: Maximum resistance to wind load exposure.

name: Maximum Working Pressure
definition: Maximum pressure that the object is manufactured to withstand.

name: Max Reaction
definition: Maximum reaction from the element

name: Max Reaction Tolerance
definition: Manufacturing tolerance on maximum reaction at fender support.

name: Mean Time Between Failure
definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

name: Mean Time To Repair
definition: Mean time to repair.

name: Measured Flow Rate
definition: The rate of flow of a fluid measured across the valve.

name: Measured Pressure Drop
definition: The actual pressure drop in the fluid measured across the valve.

name: Mechanical Efficiency
definition: The objects operational mechanical efficiency.

name: Mechanical Load Rating
definition:
Mechanical load rating for this object.
It is provided according to the national building code.

name: Mechanical Operated
definition:
Indication whether the element is operated machanically (TRUE) or not, i.e. manually  (FALSE).

Indication whether the element is operated mechanically (TRUE) or not, i.e. manually (FALSE).

name: Mechanical Stress Type
definition: Indicates which type of stress is applied to the element.

name: Mechanical Tension
definition: Nominal value of mechanical force applied to a flow segment.

name: Mechanical Ventilation
definition: Indication whether the space is required to have mechanical ventilation (TRUE), or not (FALSE).

name: Mechanical Ventilation Rate
definition: Indication of the requirement of a particular mechanical air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

name: Media Content
definition: Indicates the media content storage location, such as URLs to camera footage within particular time periods.

name: Media Extended Area
definition: Total extended media area.

name: Media Source
definition: Indicates media sources and corresponding names of ports (IfcDistributionPort with FlowDirection=SINK and PredefinedType=AUDIOVISUAL) or aggregated audio/video components (IfcAudioVisualAppliance).

name: Media Source History
definition: Indicates the media source where the identifier corresponds to an entry within the table of available media sources on Pset_AudioVisualApplianceTypeCommon.MediaSource.

name: Messaging IDs
definition: IDs or addresses for any other means of telecommunication, for example instant messaging, voice-over-IP, or file transfer protocols. The communication protocol is indicated by the URI value with scheme designations such as irc:, sip:, or ftp:.

name: Methodology
definition: Methodology used to prepare the contents of the geotechnical assembly.

name: Midship To Fair Lead
definition: Distance from the vessel midship to the fairlead for the line

name: Min Ambient Temp
definition: Minimum ambient temperature of the site used as a basis of design

name: Min Compressed Fender Height
definition: Minimum height required for a compressed fender to prevent vessels striking the structure

name: Minimum Allowable Support Length
definition: The minimum allowable support length.

name: Minimum Downstream Navigable Water Level
definition: Design minimum downstream water level for the lock complex

name: Minimum Headroom
definition: Headroom required for the activity assigned to this space.

name: Minimum Height
definition: The minimum duct height for rectangular, oval or round duct.

name: Minimum Operating Speed
definition: Minimum operating speed of the point machine.

name: Minimum Optical Signal To Noise Ratio
definition: Indicates the minimum optical signal to noise ratio of the transport equipment.

name: Minimum Part Load Ratio
definition: Minimum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

name: Minimum Temperature Factor
definition: Deviation in performance due to minimum design temperature

name: Minimum Tensile Strength
definition: Indicates the minimum tensile strength.

name: Minimum Time
definition: Identifies the minimum time for the kinematic behaviour.

name: Minimum Upstream Navigable Water Level
definition: Design minimum upstream water level for the lock complex

name: Minimum Width
definition: The minimum duct width for oval or rectangular duct.

name: Minumum Line Slope
definition: Minimum allowable line angle in degrees (negative if below horizontal from quay)

name: Mitigated Risk Consequence
definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

name: Mitigated Risk Likelihood
definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

name: Mitigated Risk Significance
definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the mitigation of likelihood and consequence.

name: Mitigation Planned
definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

name: Mitigation Proposed
definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

name: Mixer Control
definition: Defines the form of control of the mixing valve.

name: Model Label
definition: The descriptive model name of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

name: Model Number
definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

name: Model Reference
definition: The model number or designator of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

name: Moisture Capacity Thermal Gradient
definition: Thermal gradient coefficient for moisture capacity. Based on water vapor density.

name: Moisture Content
definition: Total weight of moisture relative to oven-dried weight of the wood.

name: Moisture Diffusivity
definition: Moisture diffusivity is a transport property that is frequently used in the hygrothermal analysis of building envelope components.

name: Molding
definition: Label to indicate the material or construction of the molding around the space ceiling. The label is used for room book information.The material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=MOLDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Molding Height
definition: Height of the molding.The height information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=MOLDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the height assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Molecular Weight
definition: Molecular weight of material (typically gas).

name: Momentary Type
definition: A list of the available types of momentary switch from which that required may be selected.

name: Money Stuck Ratio
definition: Indicates the ratio of money being stuck or jammed in appliance.

name: Monitoring Type
definition: Monitoring strategy chosen for the asset

name: Motor Drive Type
definition:
Motor drive type:
DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive.
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive.
COUPLING: Coupling.
OTHER: Other type of motor drive.
UNKNOWN: Unknown motor drive type.

name: Motor Enclosure Type
definition: A list of the available types of motor enclosure from which that required may be selected.

name: Motor Position
definition:
Defines the location of the motor relative to the air stream.InAirStream: Fan motor is in the air stream.
OutOfAirStream: Fan motor is out of the air stream.

name: Mountable
definition: Specifies whether the kerb can be readily climbed by a vehicle or not.

name: Mounting
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_SanitaryMountingEnum defines the forms of mounting or fixing of the sanitary terminal that may be specified within property sets used to define sanitary terminals (WC’s, basins, sinks, etc.) where:-BackToWall:     A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections
Pedestal:   A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base
CounterTop:     A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung:   A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor.Note that BackToWall, Pedestal and WallHung are allowable values for a bidet.

name: Mounting Method
definition: The method of mounting cable segment occurrences on a cable carrier occurrence from which the method required can be selected. This is for the purpose of carrying out 'worst case' cable sizing calculations and may be a conceptual requirement rather than a statement of the physical occurrences of cable and carrier segments.

name: Mounting Offset
definition: For counter top mounted basins the vertical offset between the top of the sink and the counter top.

name: Movement Sensing Type
definition: Enumeration that identifies the type of movement sensing mechanism.

name: Mullion Thickness
definition:
Thickness of the mullion.

For a window, it is the thickness of the mullion (i.e., the vertical separator of window panels within a window), measured parallel to the window elevation plane. The mullion is part of the lining and the mullion depth is assumed to be identical to the lining depth. If the MullionThickness is set to zero (and the MullionOffset set to a positive length), then the window is divided horizontally without a physical divider.

name: Multiple Tarriff
definition: Indicates whether meter has built-in support for multiple tarriffs (variable energy cost rates).

name: N_Protection
definition: An indication whether the electronic tripping unit has separate protection for the N conductor, or not.

name: N_Protection_100
definition: An indication whether the electronic tripping unit is tripping if the current in the N conductor is more than 100% of that of the phase conductors. The property is only asserted if the property N_Protection is asserted.

name: N_Protection_50
definition: An indication whether the electronic tripping unit is tripping if the current in the N conductor is more than 50% of that of the phase conductors. The property is only asserted if the property N_Protection is asserted.

name: N_Protection_Select
definition: An indication whether the use of the N_Protection can be selected by the user or not. If both the properties N_Protection_50 and N_Protection_100 are asserted, the value of N_Protection_Select property is set to TRUE. The property is only asserted if the property N_Protection is asserted.

name: N20 Content
definition: Nitrous oxide (N2O) content of the products of combustion. This is measured in weight of N2O per unit weight and is therefore unitless.

name: Name
definition: Optional name for use by the participating software systems or users. For some subtypes of IfcRoot the insertion of the Name attribute may be required. This would be enforced by a where rule.

name: Name Format
definition: Specifies a reference to or description of the formatting or encoding of the Name attribute of the IfcReferent occurrence.

name: Narrative Text
definition: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description.

name: Narrow Channel Width
definition: Indicates the width of the narrow channel.

name: Natural Ventilation
definition: Indication whether the space is required to have natural ventilation (TRUE), or not (FALSE).

name: Natural Ventilation Rate
definition: Indication of the requirement of a particular natural air ventilation rate, given in air changes per hour.

name: Nature Of Risk
definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

name: Neck Air Velocity
definition: Air velocity at the neck.

name: Neck Area
definition: Neck area of the air terminal.

name: Net Area
definition:
Total net area of the object. Openings, recesses and cut-outs are taken into account by subtraction, projections by addition.

Indicates the extruded area of the object. Only given when prismatic.

name: Net Ceiling Area
definition: Sum of all ceiling areas of the space. It excludes the area covered by elementsinside the space (columns, inner walls, etc.). The ceiling area is the real (and not the projected) area (e.g. in case of sloped ceilings).

name: Net Cross Section Area
definition:
Area of the cross section of the object.

Excluding the interior flow space.

name: Net Earned Value
definition: Net earned value

name: Net Floor Area
definition:
Sum of all net usable floor areas.

It excludes the area covered  by elements inside the space (columns, inner walls, built-in's etc.), slab openings, or other protruding elements. Varying heights are not taking into account (i.e. no reduction for areas under a minimum headroom).

name: Net Height
definition: Standard net height of this storey, from the top surface of the construction floor, to the bottom surface of the construction floor or roof above. Only provided is there is a constant height.

name: Net Impedance
definition: The maximum earth loop impedance upstream of a circuit (typically stated as the variable Zs). This value is for 55o C (130oF) Celsius usage.

name: Net Perimeter
definition: Net perimeter at the floor level of this space. It excludes those parts of the perimeter that are created by by virtual boundaries and openings (like doors). It is the measurement used for skirting boards and may include the perimeter of internal fixed objects like columns.

name: Net Planned Area
definition: Total planned net area of the object. Used for programming the object.

name: Net Positive Suction Head
definition: Minimum liquid pressure at the pump inlet to prevent cavitation.

name: Net Side Area
definition: Area of the object as viewed by an elevation view of the middle plane of the object. It does take into account all object modifications (such as openings).

name: Net Surface Area
definition: Net surface area of the object, normally generated as perimeter * length + 2 * cross section area taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

name: Net Volume
definition:
Total net volume of the object, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

Volume of the wall, after subtracting the openings and after considering the connection geometry.

name: Net Wall Area
