definition: Sum of all wall (and other vertically bounding elements, like columns) areas bounded by the space. It excludes the area covered by elements inside the wall area (doors, windows, other openings, etc.).

name: Net Weight
definition: Total net weight of the object without add-on parts, taking into account possible processing features (cut-out's, etc.) or openings and recesses.

name: Next Assessment Date
definition: Date of next condition inspection

name: Nitrogen Oxides Emissions
definition: Rate of emission of nitrogen oxides

name: Noise Emissions
definition: Level of sound emission

name: Nominal Air Flow Rate
definition:
Nominal air flow rate.

Nominal rate of air flow into which water vapor is added.

name: Nominal Body Depth
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the z-axis of the local coordinate system of the object.

name: Nominal Body Length
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the x-axis of the local coordinate system of the object.

name: Nominal Body Width
definition: Nominal or quoted length, measured along the y-axis of the local coordinate system of the object.

name: Nominal Capacity
definition:
The total nominal or volumetric capacity of the object.

Nominal cooling tower capacity in terms of heat transfer rate of the cooling tower between air stream and water stream at nominal conditions.

name: Nominal Condensing Temperature
definition: Chiller condensing temperature.

name: Nominal Cooling Capacity
definition: Nominal cooling capacity.

name: Nominal Counted Efficiency
definition: Nominal filter efficiency based the particle count concentration before and after the filter against particles with a certain size distribution.

name: Nominal Current
definition: The nominal current that is designed to be measured.

name: Nominal Current Adjusted
definition: An indication if the tripping currents of the short time protection is related to the nominal current multiplied with the actual setting of the current adjustment, if any, of the long time protection part of the protective device, or not.

name: Nominal Currents
definition:
A set of values providing information on available modules (chips) for setting the nominal current of the protective device.

A set of values providing information on available modules (chips) for setting the nominal current of the protective device. If
the set is empty, no nominal current modules are available for the tripping unit.

name: Nominal Damper Diameter
definition: Nominal damper diameter.

name: Nominal Depth
definition: Nominal Depth of the object

name: Nominal Diameter
definition:
Nominal diameter or width of the object.

Nominal diameter or width of the tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Nominal Diameter Or Width
definition: The nominal diameter or width of the duct segment.

name: Nominal Efficiency
definition: Nominal object efficiency under nominal conditions.

name: Nominal Efficiency Table
definition: The nominal efficiency of the boiler as defined by the manufacturer. For steam boilers, a function of inlet temperature versus steam pressure.  Note: as two variables are used, DefiningValues and DefinedValues are null, and values are stored in IfcTable in the following order: InletTemperature(IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure) and OutletTemperature(IfcThermodynamicTemperatureMeasure) in DefiningValues, and NominalEfficiency(IfcNormalisedRatioMeasure) in DefinedValues. For example, DefininfValues(InletTemp, OutletTemp), DefinedValues(null, NominalEfficiency).  The IfcTable is related to IfcPropertyTableValue using IfcMetric and IfcResourceConstraintRelationship.

name: Nominal Energy Consumption
definition: Nominal fuel consumption rate required to produce the total boiler heat output.

name: Nominal Evaporating Temperature
definition: Chiller evaporating temperature.

name: Nominal Filter Face Velocity
definition: Filter face velocity.

name: Nominal Flowrate
definition: Nominal fluid flow rate through the filter.

name: Nominal Frequency
definition: The nominal frequency of the supply.

name: Nominal Frequency Range
definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

name: Nominal Heating Capacity
definition: Nominal heating capacity.

name: Nominal Heat Rejection Rate
definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

name: Nominal Heat Transfer Area
definition: Nominal heat transfer surface area associated with nominal overall heat transfer coefficient.

name: Nominal Heat Transfer Coefficient
definition: Nominal overall heat transfer coefficient associated with nominal heat transfer area.

name: Nominal Height
definition:
The nominal height of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Height of the vibration isolator before the application of load.

name: Nominal Inlet Air Pressure
definition: Nominal airflow inlet static pressure.

name: Nominal Installation Depth
definition: Nominal installation depth underground.

name: Nominal Latent Capacity
definition: Nominal latent capacity.

name: Nominal Length
definition: The nominal overall length of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Nominal Length Or Diameter
definition: The nominal length or, in the case of a vertical cylindrical tank, the nominal diameter of the tank.

name: Nominal Load
definition: The nominal load that a component can support.

name: Nominal Media Surface Velocity
definition: Average fluid velocity at the media surface.

name: Nominal Moisture Gain
definition: Nominal rate of water vapor added into the airstream.

name: Nominal Particle Geometric Mean Diameter
definition: Particle geometric mean diameter associated with nominal efficiency.

name: Nominal Particle Geometric Standard Deviation
definition: Particle geometric standard deviation associated with nominal efficiency.

name: Nominal Part Load Ratio
definition: Allowable part load ratio range.

name: Nominal Power
definition: A conventional value of apparent power determining a value of the rated current that may be carried with rated voltage applied, under specified conditions. ( IEV ref 421-04-04)

name: Nominal Power Consumption
definition: Nominal total power consumption.

name: Nominal Power Rate
definition: Nominal fan power rate.

name: Nominal Pressure Drop
definition: Total pressure drop across the filter.

name: Nominal Return Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Nominal return water temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

name: Nominal Return Water Temperature Heating
definition: Nominal return water temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity).

name: Nominal Rotation Speed
definition:
Rotational speed of the object under nominal conditions.

Pump rotational speed under nominal conditions.

name: Nominal Sensible Capacity
definition: Nominal sensible capacity.

name: Nominal Size
definition: Indicates the diagonal screen size.

name: Nominal Static Pressure
definition: The static pressure within the air stream that the fan must overcome to insure designed circulation of air.

name: Nominal Sump Depth
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the z-axis in the local coordinate system of the sump.

name: Nominal Sump Length
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the x-axis in the local coordinate system or the radius (in the case of a circular shape in plan) of the sump.

name: Nominal Sump Width
definition: Nominal or quoted length measured along the y-axis in the local coordinate system of the sump.

name: Nominal Supply Current
definition: The nominal current of the supply.

name: Nominal Supply Voltage
definition: The nominal voltage of the supply.

name: Nominal Supply Voltage Offset
definition: The maximum and minimum allowed voltage of the supply e.g. boundaries of 380V/440V may be applied for a nominal voltage of 400V.

name: Nominal Supply Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Nominal supply water temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

name: Nominal Supply Water Temperature Heating
definition: Nominal supply water temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity).

name: Nominal Surrounding Humidity Cooling
definition: Nominal surrounding humidity (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

name: Nominal Surrounding Temperature Cooling
definition: Nominal surrounding temperature (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

name: Nominal Surrounding Temperature Heating
definition: Nominal surrounding temperature (refers to nominal heating capacity).

name: Nominal Thickness
definition: The nominal thickness of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Nominal Thickness End
definition: The nominal thickness of the object after a transition from its original value. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Nominal Throat Thickness
definition: Design value of the height of the largest isosceles triangle that can be inscribed in the section of a fillet weld.REFERENCE Symbol a according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Nominal Topping Thickness
definition: The nominal thickness of the topping.

name: Nominal Total Pressure
definition: Nominal total pressure rise across the fan.

name: Nominal Transverse Inclination
definition: Required nominal angle of transverse slope.

name: Nominal UA
definition: Nominal UA value.

name: Nominal Voltage
definition: The optimum voltage for the electrical appliance or system.

name: Nominal Water Flow Cooling
definition: Nominal water flow (refers to nominal cooling capacity).

name: Nominal Water Flow Heating
definition: Nominal water flow (refers to nominal heating capacity).

name: Nominal Weight
definition: Nominal weight of the object.

name: Nominal Weighted Efficiency
definition: Nominal filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after the filter against particles with a certain size distribution.

name: Nominal Width
definition: The nominal overall width of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Nominal Width Or Diameter
definition: The nominal width or, in the case of a horizontal cylindrical tank, the nominal diameter of the tank.Note: Not required for a vertical cylindrical tank.

name: Non Hazardous Waste
definition: Quantity of non hazardous waste generated.

name: Non Hazardous Waste Per Unit
definition: Quantity of non hazardous waste generated

name: Non Renewable Energy Consumption
definition: Quantity of non-renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

name: Non Renewable Energy Consumption Per Unit
definition: Quantity of non-renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

name: Nosing Length
definition: Horizontal distance from the front of the tread to the riser underneath. It is the overhang of the tread.

name: Number Of Actors
definition: The number of actors that are to be dealt with together in the population.

name: Number Of Affected Poles
definition: Number of poles that the equipment affects.

name: Numberof Blades
definition: Number of blades.

name: Number Of Boltholes
definition: Number of boltholes in the flange.

name: Number Of Branches
definition: Indicates the number of branches that can be supported by the optical splitter.

name: Number Of Cable Entries
definition: Indicates the number of cable entries in the manhole.

name: Number Of Cantilevers
definition: Indicates the number of cantilevers in the OCS supporting system.

name: Number Of Cells
definition: Number of cells in one cooling tower unit.

name: Number Of Chairs
definition: Maximum number of chairs that can fit with the table for normal use.

name: Number Of Circuits
definition:
Number of circuits.

Number of circuits in the distribution board.

name: Number Of Coaxial Pairs
definition: Indicates the total number of coaxial pairs in the coaxial cable.

name: Number Of Common Interfaces
definition: Indicates the number of common interfaces on the device.

name: Number Of Compartments
definition: The number of separate internal compartments within the trunking.

name: Number Of Cooling Fans
definition: Indicates the number of cooling fans in the equipment.

name: Number Of Cores
definition: The number of cores.

name: Number Of CPUs
definition: The number of CPUs used by the equipment.

name: Number Of Crossed Tracks
definition: Number of tracks crossed in cable route.

name: Number Of Drafts
definition: Number of the chimney drafts, continuous holes in the chimney through which the air passes, within the single chimney.

name: Number Of Earth Fault Relays
definition: Indicates the number of relays used for preventing earth fault.

name: Number Of Emergency Buttons
definition: The number of emergency buttons built in the device.

name: Number Of Fibers
definition: Indicates the number of fibers in the single tube or cable.

name: Number Of Gangs
definition:
Number of gangs in the object.

Number of gangs in the junction box.

name: Number Of Hose Connections
definition: The number of hose connections on the hydrant (excluding the pumper connection).

name: Number Of Interfaces
definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

name: Number Of Lamps
definition: Number of lamps the signal is composed of.

name: Number Of Lamps Not Used
definition: Number of lamps which are not needed and blanked out (sealed).

name: Number Of Live Conductors
definition: Number of live conductors within this circuit. Either this property or the ConductorFunction property (if only one) may be asserted.

name: Number Of Managed BTSs
definition: Indicates the maximum number of base transceiver stations (BTSs) that can be handled by the device.

name: Number Of Managed Carriers
definition: Indicates how many carrier frequencies can be managed by the device.

name: Number Of Manhole Covers
definition: Indicates the number of manhole covers.

name: Number Of Multi Mode Fibers
definition: Total number of multi-mode fibers in the optical fiber cable.

name: Number Of Occupied Units
definition: Indicates the number of vertical units occupied by the equipment.

name: Number Of Over Current Relays
definition: Indicates number of relays used for preventing over current.

name: Number Of Packets
definition: Indicates the number of packets of the IP network equipment.

name: Number Of Panels
definition: Number of panels.

name: Number Of Parallel Circuits
definition: Number of parallel circuits.

name: Number Of Phases
definition: Number of phases that the equipment operates on.

name: Number Of Plates
definition: Number of plates used by the plate heat exchanger.

name: Number Of Poles
definition:
Number of poles that the object would affect.

Number of poles that the equipment would affect.

name: Number Of Power Supply Ports
definition: Indicates the number of power supply ports of the electric device.

name: Number Of Relays
definition: Indicates number of relays built in the device.

name: Number Of Riser
definition: Total number of the risers included in the stair or stair flight.

name: Number of Risers
definition: Number of the risers included in the stair flight;

name: Number Of Rows
definition: Number of tube rows in the tube bundle assembly.

name: Number Of Screws
definition: Number of screws/bolts/connections.

name: Number Of Sections
definition:
Number of sections.

Number of sections used in the construction of the tankNote: All sections assumed to be the same size.

name: Number Of Single Mode Fibers
definition: Total number of single-mode fibers in the optical fiber cable.

name: Number Of Slots
definition: Indicates the number of  slots.

name: Number Of Sockets
definition: The number of sockets that may be connected. In case of inconsistency, sockets defined on ports take precedence.

name: Number Of Sources
definition: Number of sources .

name: Number Of Storeys
definition:
The number of storeys within a building.
Captured for those cases where the IfcBuildingStorey entity is not used. Note that if IfcBuildingStorey is asserted and the number of storeys in a building can be determined from it, then this approach should be used in preference to setting a property for the number of storeys.

name: Number Of Through Lanes
definition: The total number of through lanes on the segment. This excludes auxiliary lanes, parking and turning lanes, acceleration/deceleration lanes, toll collection lanes, shoulders etc.

name: Number Of Track Centers
definition: Indicates the number of track centers running over the sleepers.

name: Number Of Tracks Crossed
definition: Indicates the number of tracks which OCS supporting system crosses.

name: Number Of Traffic Interfaces
definition: Indicates the number of traffic interfaces on the device.

name: Number Of Treads
definition: Total number of treads included in the stair or stairflight.

name: Number Of Tubes
definition: Number of fiber tubes.

name: Number Of Twisted Pairs
definition: Total number of twisted wire pairs in copper pair cables.

name: Number Of Units
definition: Indicates the number of vertical units.

name: Number Of Untwisted Pairs
definition: Total number of untwisted wire pairs in the copper pair cable.

name: Number Of Weld Elements
definition: Number of weld elements.REFERENCE Symbol n according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Number Of Wires
definition: The number of wires used in the element.

name: Number Of Workstations
definition: Indicates the types or purposes of workstations and their number in the equipment. The defined purpose can be e.g. 'Diagnostic and maintenance', 'Traffic and electric traction', etc.

name: Nuts Count
definition: Count of nuts to be mounted on one bolt

name: Nut Shape
definition: Shape of the nut, e.g. 'Hexagon', 'Cap', 'Castle', 'Wing'

name: NValue
definition: Blow count from standard penetration testing, to ISO 22476-3, ASTM D1586[1] and Australian Standards AS 1289.6.3.1, which correlates to other engineering properties of soils.

name: Object Type
definition: The type denotes a particular type that indicates the object further. The use has to be established at the level of instantiable subtypes. In particular it holds the user defined type, if the enumeration of the attribute PredefinedType is set to USERDEFINED or when the concrete entity instantiated does not have a PredefinedType attribute. The latter is the case in some exceptional leaf classes and when instantiating IfcBuiltElement directly.

name: Occupancy Diversity
definition: Diversity factor that may be applied to the number of people in the space.

name: Occupancy Number
definition: Number of people required for the activity assigned to this space.

name: Occupancy Number Peak
definition: Maximal number of people required for the activity assigned to this space in peak time.

name: Occupancy Time Per Day
definition: The amount of time during the day that the activity is required within this space.

name: Occupancy Type
definition:
Occupancy type for this object.
It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

name: OCSFastening Type
definition: Indicates the type of the overhead contact system (OCS) mechanical fastener.

name: Old Device
definition: Indication whether the protection_ unit is out-dated or not. If not out-dated, the device is still for sale.

name: Open Circuit Voltage
definition: Voltage of a cell or battery when the discharge current is zero  [Source IEC 482-03-32]

name: Open Pressure Drop
definition: Total pressure drop across damper.

name: Operating Mode
definition: Identifies the operating mode of the boiler.

name: Operating Weight
definition: Operating weight of the tank including all of its contents.

name: Operation
definition: The operational mechanism for the damper operation.

name: Operational Criteria
definition: Time of operation at maximum operational ambient air temperature.

name: Operational Document
definition: Manufacturer's operational document

name: Operational Efficiency
definition: Operational efficiency: boiler output divided by total energy input (electrical and fuel).

name: Operational Temperature Range
definition:
The temperature range in which the device operates normally.

Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

name: Operation Mode
definition: Table mapping operation mode identifiers to descriptive labels, which may be used for interpreting Pset_UnitaryControlElementPHistory.Mode.

name: Operation Mode History
definition: Indicates operation mode corresponding to Pset_UnitaryControlTypeCommon.Mode.  For example, 'HEAT', 'COOL', 'AUTO'.

name: Operation Pressure Max
definition: Maximum pressure under normal operating conditions.

name: Operation Temperature Range
definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

name: Operation Type
definition:
Type of operations. Also used to assign standard symbolic presentations according to national building standards.

For a window, it is the type of window panel operations. Also used to assign standard symbolic presentations according to national building standards.

name: Optical Cable Structure
definition: Distinguishes between different structures of an optical fiber cable.

name: Optical Network Unit Type
definition: Indicates the type of the optical network unit equipment.

name: Optical Splitter Type
definition: Indicates the type of optical splitter, single mode or multi-mode.

name: Options
definition: A statement of the options available in the agreement.

name: Organic Volume
definition: Relative volume of organic (peat/humus) stratum constituents especially soil.

name: Orientation
definition: The intended orientation for the damper as specified by the manufacturer.

name: Orthogonal Orthogonality
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

name: Orthogonal Straightness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness  associated to the horizontal shape  in Y, if different to the overall straightness.

name: Orthogonal Tolerance
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

name: Orthogonal Uncertainty
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

name: Orthometric Height
definition: The orthometric height is the vertical distance H along the plumb line from a point of interest to a reference surface known as the geoid, the vertical datum that approximates mean sea level.

name: Outdoor Environment
definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the outdoor environment (where appropriate)

name: Outer Diameter
definition: The actual outer diameter of the object.

name: Outer Surface Area
definition: Total area of the surfaces of the object (not taking into account the end cap areas), normally generated as perimeter * length in case of extrusions.

name: Outlet Connection Size
definition: Size of the outlet connection from the object.

name: Outlet Diameter
definition: The outlet diameter of the breeching inlet.

name: Outlet Temperature Range
definition: Allowable outlet temperature of either the water or the steam.

name: Output Capacity
definition: Total nominal heat output as listed by the manufacturer.

name: Output Capacity Curve
definition: Partial output capacity curve (as a function of water temperature); Q = f (Twater).

name: Output Signal Type
definition: The type of the output signal.

name: Outside Air Flowrate
definition: Flow rate of outside air entering the unit.

name: Outside Air Per Person
definition: Design quantity of outside air to be provided per person in the space.

name: Outside Diameter
definition: Actual outside diameter of the tube in the tube bundle.

name: Overall Diameter
definition:
The overall diameter of a object.

The overall diameter of a core (maximum space used).

name: Overall Efficiency
definition:
Total efficiency of object.

The pump and motor overall operational efficiency.

name: Overall Height
definition: Overall measure of the height, it reflects the Z Dimension of a bounding box, enclosing the body of the door opening. If omitted, the OverallHeight should be taken from the geometric representation of the IfcOpeningElement in which the door is inserted.

name: Overall Orthogonality
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the intended shape and orientation in XYZ.

name: Overall Straightness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the intended shape.

name: Overall Tolerance
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

name: Overall Width
definition: Overall width of the profile.

name: Packing Care Type
definition:
Identifies the predefined types of care that may be required when handling the artefact during a move where:Fragile: artefact may be broken during a move through careless handling.
HandleWithCare: artefact may be damaged during a move through careless handling.

name: Pager Number
definition: The pager number at which paging messages may be received.

name: Panel Depth
definition:
Depth of the panel.

For a door, it is the depth of the door panel, measured perpendicular to the plane of the door leaf.

name: Panel Operation
definition:
The way of operation of a panel.

For a door, it is the way of operation of the panel. The PanelOperation of the door panel shall correspond to the OperationType of the IfcDoorType by which it is referenced.

name: Panel Position
definition:
Position of the panel.

For a window, it is the position of the panel within the overall window style.

name: Panel Width
definition:
Width of the panel.

For a door, it is the width of the panel, given as ratio relative to the total clear opening width of the door. If omitted, it defaults to 1. A value shall be provided for all doors with OperationType's at IfcDoorType defining a door with more then one panel.

name: Pan Horizontal
definition: Indicates horizontal range for panning.

name: Pan Mounting
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_SanitaryMountingEnum defines the forms of mounting or fixing of the sanitary terminal that may be specified within property sets used to define sanitary terminals (WC’s, basins, sinks, etc.) where:-BackToWall:     A pedestal mounted sanitary terminal that fits flush to the wall at the rear to cover its service connections.
Pedestal:   A floor mounted sanitary terminal that has an integral base.
CounterTop:     A sanitary terminal that is installed into a horizontal surface that is installed into a horizontal surface. Note: When applied to a wash hand basin, the term more normally used is ‘vanity’. See also Wash Hand Basin Type specification.
WallHung:   A sanitary terminal cantilevered clear of the floor.

name: Pan Tilt Zoom Preset
definition: Indicates pan/tilt/zoom position presets.

name: Pan Vertical
definition: Indicates vertical range for panning.

name: Para Meter Takes Precedence
definition: The Boolean value reflects, whether the parameter given in the attached lining and panel properties exactly define the geometry (TRUE), or whether the attached style shape take precedence (FALSE). In the last case the parameter have only informative value. If not provided, no such information can be inferred.

name: Parking Units
definition: Indicates the number of transportation units of the type specified by the property ParkingUse that may be accommodated within the space. Generally, this value should default to 1 unit. However, where the parking space is for motorcycles or bicycles, provision may be made for more than one unit in the space.

name: Parking Use
definition: Identifies the type of transportation for which the parking space is designed. Values are not predefined but might include car, compact car, motorcycle, bicycle, truck, bus etc.

name: Partial Load Efficiency Curves
definition: Boiler efficiency as a function of the partial load factor; E = f (partialLaodfactor).

name: Particle Absorption Curve
definition: Ratio of particles that are removed by the filter.  Each entry describes the ratio of particles absorbed greater than equal to the specified size and less than the next specified size.  For example,  given for 3 significant particle sizes >= 0,1 micro m, >= 1 micro m, >= 5 micro m

name: Particle Mass Holding
definition: Mass of particle holding in the filter.

name: Particulate Matter Emissions
definition: Rate of emission of particulate matter

name: Partitioning Type
definition: Type defining the general layout of the window type in terms of the partitioning of panels.

name: Part Load Ratio
definition: Ratio of the real to the nominal capacity.

name: Pattern Type
definition: Defines the types of pattern (or shape of a tank that may be specified.

name: Pavement Roughness
definition: An assessment of the functional condition of the pavement surface indicated as an index according to the International Roughness Index (IRI).

name: Pavement Texture
definition: Characterization of pavement texture by mean profile depthNOTE  Definition according to ISO 13473-1:2019

name: Payback Period
definition: Payback period of investment

name: Payment Method
definition: Indicates the vending machine payment method.

name: People
definition: Heat gains and losses from people.

name: People History
definition: Heat gains and losses from people.

name: Percentage Open
definition: The ratio between the amount that the valve is open to the full open position of the valve.

name: Percent Shared
definition: Percent of costs paid by the other infrastructure owner.

name: Performance
definition: Water temperature change as a function of wet-bulb temperature, water entering temperature, water flow rate, air flow rate, Tdiff = f ( Twet-bulb, Twater,in, mwater, mair).

name: Performance Certificate
definition: Manufacturer's performance certificate

name: Performance Classes
definition:
A set of designations of performance classes for the breaker unit for which the data of this instance is valid.

A set of designations of performance classes for the breaker unit for which the data of this instance is valid. A breaker unit being a circuit breaker may be
constructed for different levels of breaking capacities. A maximum of 7 different
performance classes may be provided. Examples of performance classes that may be specified include B, C, N, S, H, L, V.

name: Performance Maintenance Level
definition: Performance level at which maintenance takes place

name: Perimeter
definition: Perimeter of the object.

name: Permeability
definition:
Ratio of the permeability of the ceiling.
The ration can be used to indicate an open ceiling (that enables identification of whether ceiling construction should be considered as impeding distribution of sprinkler water, light etc. from installations within the ceiling area).

name: Permeability Behaviour
definition: Proportionality constant in Darcy's law which relates flow rate and viscosity to a pressure gradient applied to the porous media.

name: Permissible Pavement Load
definition: Permissible traffic load on the pavement.

name: Permissible Road Load
definition: Permissible traffic load for the road design.

name: PHLevel
definition: Maximum water PH in a range from 0-14.

name: Photochemical Ozone Formation
definition: Quantity of gases creating the photochemical ozone calculated in equivalent ethylene.

name: Photochemical Ozone Formation Per Unit
definition: Quantity of gases creating the photochemical ozone calculated in equivalent ethylene

name: Physical Description Reference
definition: Physical description as external reference of the equipment, including e.g.weight, shape, model, length, height, diameter.

name: Pictogram Escape Direction
definition: The direction of escape pictogram.

name: Piece Mark
definition: Defines a unique piece for production purposes. All pieces with the same piece mark value are identical and interchangeable. The piece mark may be composed of sub-parts that have specific locally defined meaning (e.g. B-1A may denote a beam, of generic type ‘1’ and specific shape ‘A’).

name: Pier Section Type
definition: Whether the structure presents a solid/closed barrier to the passage of water or is open.

name: Piezometric Head
definition: Pressure head of water content.

name: Piezometric Pressure
definition: Pressure of water content.

name: Pipe Connection
definition: The manner in which the pipe connection is made to the cooled beam.

name: Pitch Angle
definition: Angle of the slab to the horizontal when used as a component for the roof (specified as 0 degrees or not asserted for cases where the slab is not used as a roof component).The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.  For geometry editing applications, like CAD: this value should be write-only.

name: Placing Type
definition: Location at which the type of junction box can be located.

name: Plan Area
definition: Projected plan area of upper surface of model.

name: Planar Flatness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

name: Plan Length
definition: Projected plan length of upper edge of slice.

name: Planning Control Status
definition: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

name: Plastic Strain
definition: A measure of the permanent displacement, as in slip or twinning, which remains after the stress has been removed. Currently applied to a strain of 0.2% proportional stress of the material.

name: Player Media Eject
definition: Indicates whether the media can be ejected from the player (if physical media).

name: Player Media Format
definition: Indicates supported media formats.

name: Player Type
definition: Indicates the type of player.

name: Plies
definition: Number of plies.

name: Point Of Contact
definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

name: Poisons Ratio
definition: Ratio of transverse contraction strain to longitudinal extension strain in the direction of stretching force.

name: Poisson Ratio
definition: A measure of the lateral deformations in the elastic range.

name: Polarity
definition: True indicates normal polarity; False indicates reverse polarity.

name: Polarization Mode
definition: Indicates the polarization mode of antenna.

name: Polarization Mode Dispersion Tolerance
definition: Indicates the polarization mode dispersion tolerance of the transport equipment. It is usually measured by picosecond.

name: Pole Usage
definition: Pole usage.

name: Porosity
definition: The void fraction of the total volume occupied by material (Vbr - Vnet)/Vbr.

name: Port Capacity
definition: Indicates the number of ports in the passive device that can be used to interconnect cables.

name: Port Number
definition: The port index for logically ordering the port within the containing element or element type.

name: Position History
definition: Indicates position of the actuator over time where 0.0 is fully closed and 1.0 is fully open.

name: Position In Track
definition: Indicates the relative position of the element in track, which lies to the left or right as facing in the direction of increasing stationing values.

name: Postal Box
definition: An address that is implied by an identifiable mail drop.

name: Postal Code
definition: The code that is used by the country's postal service.

name: Power
definition: The actual power and operable range.

name: Power Capacity
definition: Power capacity of the equipment

name: Power Demand
definition: Power demand of the element

name: Power Dissipation
definition: Permissible power which may be dissipated continuously, at specified conditions.

name: Power Factor
definition:
Power factor; usually as ratio.

The ratio between the rated electrical power and the product of the rated current and rated voltage

name: Power Factor History
definition: Power factor.

name: Power History
definition: The actual power consumption of the pump.

name: Power Loss
definition:
The power loss in [W].

The power loss in [W] of the fuse when the nominal current is flowing through the fuse.

name: Power Source
definition: Type of power driving the compressor.

name: Power State
definition: Indicates the power state of the device where True is on and False is off.

name: Power Supply Mode
definition: Power supply mode of the equipment or system.

name: Pressure
definition: The pressure of  fluid.

name: Pressure Class
definition:
Nominal pressure rating of the object.

The test or rated pressure classification of the fitting.

name: Pressure Curve
definition: Pressure rise = f (flow rate).

name: Pressure Drop
definition: Pressure drop.

name: Pressure Drop Curve
definition: Under certain dust holding weight, DelPressure = f (fluidflowRate)

name: Pressure Gauge Type
definition: Identifies the means by which pressure is displayed.

name: Pressure Hisotry
definition: The pressure of the fluid.

name: Pressure Loss Coefficient
definition: Pressure loss coefficient.

name: Pressure Range
definition: Allowable maximum and minimum working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

name: Pressure Rating
definition:
Pressure rating of the object.

Maximum pressure that the hydrant is manufactured to withstand.

name: Pressure Regulator Setting
definition: Pressure that is automatically maintained in the tank.

name: Pressure Rise
definition: The developed pressure.

name: Pre Tension Aim
definition: Line force that the winch is set to maintain (minimum load)

name: Prevailing Wind Direction
definition: The prevailing wind angle direction measured from True North (0 degrees) in a clockwise direction.

name: Prevailing Wind Velocity
definition: The design wind velocity coming from the direction specified by the PrevailingWindDirection attribute.

name: Primary Apparent Power
definition: The power in VA (volt ampere) that has been transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Primary Current
definition: The current that is going to be transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Primary Energy Consumption
definition: Boiler primary energy source consumption (i.e., the fuel consumed for changing the thermodynamic state of the fluid).

name: Primary Frequency
definition: The frequency that is going to be transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Primary Production Type
definition: Primary type of ship production of the facility

name: Primary Surface Area
definition: Primary heat transfer surface area of the tubes and headers.

name: Primary Voltage
definition: The voltage that is going to be transformed and that runs into the transformer on the primary side.

name: Process
definition: Reference number of the welding process according to ISO 4063, an up to three digits long code

name: Process Capacity
definition: The number of units that can be processed in the time defined in ProcessPerformance

name: Process Direction
definition: The direction of flow of the cargo within the process.

name: Process Item
definition: The type of item (and its measurement method) being modelled within a process. This can be cargo, passengers or vehicles that pass through the system.

name: Process Name
definition: Name of the welding process.  Alternative to the numeric Process property.

name: Process Performance
definition: Minimum time to accept or dispatch the entire item capacity.

name: Procurement Method
definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/IfcProduct is acquired and installed. The value provided shall be one of the following four character acronyms: “CFCI” (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), “OFCI” (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or “OFOI” (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

name: Product Description
definition: A textual description of the products that require the work.

name: Production Lot Id
definition: The manufacturer's production lot identifier.

name: Production Year
definition: The year of production of the manufactured item.

name: Projected Area
definition: Total gross area of the outer surfaces of the roof, projected tp the ground. It is the sum of all projected roof slab gross areas. Roof openings, like sky windows and other openings and cut-outs are not taken into account.

name: Project Investment Estimate
definition: Estimate of investment cost

name: Projector Type
definition: Indicates the type of projector.

name: Project Type
definition: Additional typing of a project

name: Propagation Speed Coefficient
definition: Indicates the propagation speed coefficient.

name: Property Name
definition: Addressing details of the property as stated within the agreement.

name: Proportional Constant
definition: The proportional gain factor of the controller (usually referred to as Kp).

name: Proportional Stress
definition: A measure of the proportional stress of the material. It describes the stress before the first plastic deformation occurs and is commonly measured at a deformation of 0.01%.

name: Protective Pore Ratio
definition: The protective pore ratio indicating the frost-resistance of the concrete.

name: Protocols
definition: For data ports, identifies the protocols used as defined by the Open System Interconnection (OSI) Basic Reference Model (ISO 7498).  Layers include: 1. Physical; 2. DataLink; 3. Network; 4. Transport; 5. Session; 6. Presentation; 7. Application.  Example: 3:IP, 4:TCP, 5:HTTP

name: Publicly Accessible
definition: Indication whether this space (in case of e.g., a toilet) is designed to serve as a publicly accessible space, e.g., for a public toilet (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Pull In Voltage
definition: Working voltage of relay in excitation state.

name: Pumper Connection Size
definition: The size of a connection to which a fire hose may be connected that is then linked to a pumping unit.

name: Purpose
definition:
Indication of the purpose of this object

E.g. 'ventilation' or 'access'

name: Put Into Operation Date
definition: Date on which the element is put into operation.

name: Pwave Velocity
definition: P-wave velocity of a rock or soil.

name: Quality
definition: Indicates the quality of measurement or failure condition, which may be further qualified by the Status.  True: measured values are considered reliable; False: measured values are considered not reliable (i.e. a fault has been detected); Unknown: reliability of values is uncertain.

name: Quality History
definition: Indicates the quality of measurement or failure condition, which may be further qualified by the Status.  True: measured values are considered reliable; False: measured values are considered not reliable (i.e. a fault has been detected); Unknown: reliability of values is uncertain.

name: Quality Of Components
definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the quality of components used.

name: Quay Section Type
definition: Whether the structure presents a solid/closed barrier to the passage of water or is open.

name: Radiant Frequency
definition: Indicates the radiant frequency of the leaky coaxial cable (radiating cable).

name: Radiation Pattern
definition: Indicates the radiation pattern of antenna.

name: Radiator Type
definition: Indicates the type of radiator.

name: Radioactive Waste
definition: Quantity of radioactive waste generated.

name: Radioactive Waste Per Unit
definition: Quantity of radioactive waste generated

name: Radius
definition: The radius of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Rail Condition
definition: Assessment of the condition of the rail at point of installation.

name: Rail Delivery State
definition: The delivery state of rail, which indicates the final treatment at the end in manufacturing.

name: Rail Elementary Length
definition: The standardised length of rail supplied from the manufacturer.

name: Rail Gap
definition: The gap between the rail profiles.

name: Rail Pad Stiffness
definition: Indicates the stiffness of a rail pad.

name: Railway Balise Type
definition: Type of the railway balise.

name: Railway Signal Type
definition: The type of railway signal, e.g. home signal, starting signal, shunting signal, level crossing signal.

name: Rain Measure Range
definition: Indicates the measuring range of rain gauge.

name: Rain Sensor Type
definition: Indicates the type of rain sensor or gauge.

name: Raised Compressive Strength
definition: Alternative value for compressive strength which may be used under material and code dependent conditions (e.g. if deformation is tolerable, or far from ends of the member); conditions should be stated in SELF\IfcProperty.Description.

name: Raised Comp Strength Perp
definition: Alternative value for compressive strength, α=90°, which may be used under material and code dependent conditions (e.g. if deformation is tolerable, or far from ends of the member); conditions should be stated in SELF\IfcProperty.Description.

name: Range
definition: The physical range of values supported by the device.

name: Range Angle
definition: Indicates the maximum rotation the actuator must traverse.

name: Rated Capacitance
definition: Capacitance value determined under specified conditions and declared by the manufacturer.

name: Rated Current
definition: The current that a device is designed to handle.

name: Rated Frequency
definition: Frequency of the AC electric power supply when the device or system reaches its optimum operating condition.

name: Rated Temperature
definition: The range of allowed temperature that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

name: Rated Voltage
definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

name: Rated Voltage Range
definition: Voltage range as declared by the manufacturer expressed by its lower and upper rated voltages [Source : IEC 62368-1:2010, 3.3.10.5].

name: Rate Of Temperature Rise
definition: The rate of temperature rise that is to be sensed as being hazardous.

name: Ratio Of Wire Tension
definition: The ratio of wire tension to tensioner weight.

name: Reactive Power
definition: Reactive power.

name: Read Out Type
definition: Indication of the form that readout from the meter takes. In the case of a dial read out, this may comprise multiple dials that give a cumulative reading and/or a mechanical odometer.

name: Real Impedance Ratio
definition:
The ratio between the real part of the zero sequence impedance and the real part of the positive impedance (i.e. real part of the short-circuit voltage) of the transformer.
Used for three-phase transformer which includes a N-conductor.

name: Real Power
definition: Real power.

name: Reason For Change
definition: A description of the problem for why a change is needed.

name: Receiver Type
definition: Indicates the type of receiver.

name: Receptacle Load Intensity
definition: Average power use intensity of appliances and other non-HVAC equipment in the space per unit area.(PowerMeasure/IfcAreaMeasure).

name: Recirculated Air
definition: Loads from recirculated air.

name: Recirculated Air History
definition: Loads from recirculated air.

name: Reference Air Relative Humidity
definition: Measurement of the ratio of water vapor in the air.

name: Reference Depth
definition: Depth in bending for which the mechanical properties are valid; provided as a means to check the integrity of material assignment.

name: Reference Distance Rope To Pulley
definition: The reference design criteria for distance from the end of the rope to the fixed pulley.It defines the nominal distance in relation to temperature.

name: Reference Distance Tensioner To Ground
definition: The reference design criteria distance from the last tensioner to the ground or the base surface (B value). It defines the nominal distance in relation to temperature.

name: Reference Environment Temperature
definition: Ideal temperature range.

name: Refresh Rate
definition: Indicates the display refresh frequency.

name: Refrigerant Class
definition:
Refrigerant class used by the object.
CFC: Chlorofluorocarbons.
HCFC: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons.
HFC: Hydrofluorocarbons.

name: Refrigerant Fouling Resistance
definition: Fouling resistance on the refrigerant side.

name: Regenerated Sound Curve
definition: Regenerated sound versus air flow rate.

name: Region
definition: The name of a region.EXAMPLE  The counties of the United Kingdom and the states of North America are examples of regions.

name: Reheat Type
definition: Terminal box reheat type.

name: Reinforcement
definition: The type of reinforcement, if any, used for the duct segment.

name: Reinforcement Area Ratio
definition: The required ratio of the effective area of the reinforcement to the effective area of the concrete At any section of a reinforced concrete structural element.

name: Reinforcement Bar Type
definition: Defines the type of the reinforcement bar.

name: Reinforcement Spacing
definition: The spacing between reinforcing elements.

name: Reinforcement Strength Class
definition: Classification of the reinforcement strength in accordance with the concrete design code which is applied in the project. The reinforcing strength class often combines strength and ductility.

name: Reinforcement Volume Ratio
definition: The required ratio of the effective mass of the reinforcement to the effective volume of the concrete of a reinforced concrete structural element.

name: Relative Humidity
definition: Loads from the relative humidity.

name: Relative Humidity History
definition: Loads from the relative humidity.

name: Relaxations
definition:
Measures of decrease in stress over long time intervals resulting from plastic flow. Different relaxation values for different initial stress levels for a material may be given. It describes the time dependent relative relaxation value for a given initial stress level at constant strain.
Relating values are the "RelaxationValue". Related values are the "InitialStress"

name: Release Current
definition: The release current in [x In] for the initial tripping of the S-function.

name: Release Current I2t End
definition:
The release current in [x In].

For the end point of the I2t tripping curve of the S-function, if any. The value of ReleaseCurrentI2tEnd shall be larger than ReleaseCurrentI2tStart.

name: Release Current I2t Start
definition:
The release current in [x In].

For the start point of the I2t tripping curve of the S-function, if any.

name: Release Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the tendon stress is released. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

name: Release Time
definition: The release time in [s] for the initial tripping of the relevant part. This time indicates that for current lower than the indicated release current, the tripping time will be longer than the indicated release time. The value is given as a mean value.

name: Release Time I2t End
definition:
The release time in [s].

For the end point of the I2 tripping curve of the S-function, if any. The value of ReleaseTimeI2tEnd shall be lower than ReleaseTimeI2tStart.

name: Release Time I2t Start
definition:
The release time in [s].

For the start point of the I2t tripping curve of the S-function, if any

name: Release Voltage
definition: The maximum voltage to guarantee the drop of the relay node.

name: Relief Pressure
definition: The pressure at which the spring or weight in the valve is set to discharge fluid.

name: Relief Valve Setting
definition: Pressure at which the relief valve activates.

name: Remote Reading
definition: Indicates whether the meter has a connection for remote reading through connection of a communication device (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE).

name: Renewable Energy Consumption
definition: Quantity of renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

name: Renewable Energy Consumption Per Unit
definition: Quantity of renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

name: Rental Rates In Category Future
definition: Range of the cost rates for property expected to be available in the future in the required category.

name: Rental Rates In Category Now
definition: Range of the cost rates for property currently available in the required category.

name: Repair Content
definition: Content of repair, reason and nature can be given, e.g. display faults, communication failure, display exchange.

name: Repair Date
definition: Date on which the last repair is done on the asset.

name: Replacement Level
definition: Performance level at which replacement takes place

name: Request Comments
definition: Comments that may be made on the request.

name: Request Source Label
definition: A specific name or label that further qualifies the identity of a request source. In the event of an email, this may be the email address.

name: Request Source Name
definition: The person making the request, where known.

name: Required Closure Spacing
definition: Required length of the closure spacing.

name: Required Display Distance
definition: The required distance that has to be displayed. The value relates only to the signal type, not to the circumstances at a special position.

name: Required Headroom
definition: Required headroom clearance for the passageway according to the applicable building code or additional requirements.

name: Required Slope
definition:
Required sloping angle of the object  - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).
Required maximum slope for the passageway according to the applicable building code or additional requirements.

name: Requires Banner Signal
definition: Indicates whether a banner repeater signal is required.

name: Requires OLEMesh
definition: Indicates whether an OLE mesh is required to protect the signal or maintainer.

name: Requires Safety Handrail
definition: Indicates whether a safety handrail is required.

name: Residual Flowing Pressure
definition: The residual flowing pressure in the pipeline at which the discharge flow rate is determined.

name: Resistance To Ground
definition: The resistance through earthing conductor to the ground. Real part of the impedance to earth [SOURCE IEC: 195-01-18]

name: Resistivity
definition: Electrical resistivity of a rock or soil (Ohm-m).

name: Resource Depletion
definition: Quantity of resources used calculated in equivalent antimony.

name: Resource Depletion Per Unit
definition: Quantity of resources used calculated in equivalent antimony

name: Response
definition: Identifies the predefined methods of sprinkler response from which that required may be set.

name: Restrictions
definition: Restrictions that may be placed by a  competent authority.

name: Return Air Fraction Range
definition: Allowable return air fraction range as a fraction of discharge airflow.

name: Return Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Return water temperature in cooling mode.

name: Return Water Temperature Heating
definition: Return water temperature in heating mode.

name: Riser Height
definition:
Vertical distance from tread to tread.
The riser height is supposed to be equal for all steps of a stair or stair flight.

name: Risk Assessment Methodology
definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

name: Risk Name
definition: A locally unique identifier for the risk entry that can be used to track the development and mitigation of the risk throughout the project life cycle

name: Risk Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

name: RMSWithstand Voltage
definition: Rms value of sinusoidal power frequency voltage that the insulation of the given equipment can withstand during tests made under specified conditions and for a specified duration. (IEV ref 614-03-22）

name: Road Design Class
definition: A road design class designator with content according to local standards.

name: Road Visible Distance Left
definition: Distance visible to the left of the access.

name: Road Visible Distance Right
definition: Distance visible to the right of the access.

name: Rock Volume
definition: Relative volume of rock stratum constituents.

name: ROI
definition: Return on Investment

name: Roll
definition:
Rotation against the longitudinal axis.

Relative to the global Z direction for all members that are non-vertical in regard to the global coordinate system (Profile direction equals global Z is Roll = 0.)
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Note: new property in IFC4.

name: Rotation Accommodated
definition: A list of exactly three boolean values representing an accommodated rotation (value TRUE or 1) or no rotation (value FALSE or 0) about the corresponding axis where the first value represents axis X, second value axis Y and third value axis Z.

name: Rotation Speed
definition: Pump rotational speed.

name: Roughness
definition: A measure of the vertical deviations of the surface.

name: Safety Document
definition: Manufacturer's safety document

name: Salt Mist Level
definition: Maximum level of salt mist that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

name: Sampling Frequency
definition: Indicates the sampling frequency of the device.

name: Sand Volume
definition: Relative volume of sand (typically smaller than 2mm) stratum constituents.

name: Saturation Efficiency
definition: Saturation efficiency: Ratio of leaving air absolute humidity to the maximum absolute humidity.

name: Saturation Efficiency Curve
definition: Saturation efficiency as a function of the air flow rate.

name: Scheduled Frequency
definition: The period of time between expected instantiations of a work order that may have been predefined.

name: Scrap Factor
definition: Sheet metal scrap factor.

name: Screen Diameter
definition: The diameter of the screen around an object (if present).

name: Seating Height
definition: The value of seating height if the chair height is not adjustable.

name: Secondary Apparent Power
definition: The power in VA (volt ampere) that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Secondary Current
definition: The current that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Secondary Current Type
definition: A list of the secondary current types that can result from transformer output.

name: Secondary Frequency
definition: The frequency that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Secondary Surface Area
definition: Secondary heat transfer surface area created by fins.

name: Secondary Voltage
definition: The voltage that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on the secondary side.

name: Second Curvature Radius
definition: SecondCurvatureRadius should be defined as the top or right side radius of curvature value.

name: Second Mullion Offset
definition: Offset of the mullion centerline for the second mullion, measured along the x-axis of the window placement co-ordinate system. An offset value = 0.666 indicates that the second mullion is positioned at two/third of the window.

name: Second Transom Offset
definition: Offset of the transom centerline for the second transom, measured along the x-axis of the window placement co-ordinate system. An offset value = 0.666 indicates that the second transom is positioned at two/third of the window.

name: Sectioning Device Type
definition: Indicates the sectioning device type.

name: Section Length
definition: The length of a section used in the construction of the tank.

name: Section Width
definition: The width of a section used in the construction of the tank.

name: Security Lighting Type
definition: The type of security lighting.

name: Security Rating
definition:
Index based rating system indicating security level.
It is giving according to the national building code.

name: Seiche Range
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range between peaks and troughts of seiche (resonant) waves.

name: Seismic Resistance
definition: Maximum magnitude of earthquake that the equipment complies with. The value indicates earthquake intensity measured in Richter scale.

name: Selector Type
definition: A list of the available types of selector switch from which that required may be selected.

name: Self Closing
definition: Indication whether this object is designed to close automatically after use (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Self Extinguishing60332_1
definition: Self Extinguishing cable/core according to IEC 60332.1.

name: Self Extinguishing60332_3
definition: Self Extinguishing cable/core according to IEC 60332.3.

name: Self Test Function
definition: The type of self test function.

name: Sensible Cooling Capacity
definition: Sensible cooling capacity.

name: Sensible Effectiveness
definition: Sensible heat transfer effectiveness, where effectiveness is defined as the ratio of heat transfer to maximum possible heat transfer.

name: Sensible Effectiveness Table
definition: Sensible heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary and secondary air flow rate.

name: Sensible Heat Gain
definition: The  sensible heat or energy gained by the space during the peak conditions.

name: Sensible Heat Ratio
definition: Air-side sensible heat ratio, or fraction of sensible heat transfer to the total heat transfer.

name: Sensible Heat Transfer Rate
definition:
Sensible heat transfer rate.

Sensible heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

name: Sensible Load To Radiant
definition: Percent of sensible thermal load to radiant heat.

name: Sensitivity
definition:
Sensitivity.

Current leakage to an unwanted leading path during normal operation (IEC 151-14-49).

name: Separation Type
definition: Air particulate filter media separation type.

name: Sequence In Track Panel
definition: Sequence of the sleeper within the track panel.

name: Sequential Code
definition: Indicates the sequential code of the cable or wire.

name: Serial Interface Type
definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

name: Serial Number
definition: The manufacturer's serial number assigned to an occurrence of a product.

name: Service Life Duration
definition: The length or duration of a service life.The lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

name: Setback Distance
definition: Setback distance from the point of connection on the major element along the axis of the minor element (e.g. distance from a public road at which the line of sigfht is measured.

name: Set Point
definition:
Indicates the setpoint and label.

Indicates the temperature setpoint.  For thermostats with setbacks or separate high and low setpoints, then the time series may contain a pair of values at each entry where the first value is the heating setpoint (low) and the second value is the cooling setpoint (high).

name: Set Point CO2 Concentration
definition: The carbon dioxide concentration to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Concentration
definition: The concentration to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Conductance
definition: The fill level value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Contact
definition: The contact value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Flow
definition: The volumetric flow value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Frost
definition: The detection of frost.

name: Set Point History
definition: Indicates the switch position over time according to Pset_SwitchingDeviceTypeCommon.SetPoint.

name: Set Point Humidity
definition: The humidity value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Identifier
definition: The detected tag value.

name: Set Point Illuminance
definition: The illuminance value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Ion Concentration
definition: The ion concentration value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Level
definition: The fill level value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Moisture
definition: The moisture value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Movement
definition: The movement to be sensed.

name: Set Point PH
definition: The fill level value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Pressure
definition: The pressure value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Radiation
definition: The radiation power value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Radioactivity
definition: The radioactivity value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Sound
definition: The sound pressure value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Speed
definition: The wind speed value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Set Point Temperature
definition: The temperature value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

name: Settlement Behaviour
definition: Estimate of the settlement/compaction behaviour of the stratum.

name: Severity
definition: Indicates alarm severity over time, where the scale of values is determined by the control system configuration.  A zero value indicates no present alarm.

name: Shading Coefficient
definition: (SC): The measure of the ability of a glazing to transmit solar heat, relative to that ability for 3 mm (1/8-inch) clear, double-strength, single glass. Shading coefficient is being phased out in favor of the solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC), and is approximately equal to the SHGC multiplied by 1.15. The shading coefficient is expressed as a number without units between 0 and 1.

name: Shading Device Type
definition: Specifies the type of shading device.

name: Shaft Power
definition: The actual shaft power input to the compressor.

name: Shaft Power Rate
definition: Fan shaft power.

name: Shape Description
definition: A description of the shape of the work surface e.g. corner square, rectangle, etc.

name: Shape Type
definition: Shape of the junction box.

name: Shear Modulus
definition: A measure of the shear modulus of elasticity of the material.

name: Shear Modulus Min
definition: Shear modulus, minimal value.

name: Shear Strength
definition: Defining values: α; defined values: shear strength.

name: Sheath Colours
definition: Colour of the core (derived from IEC 60757). Note that the combined color 'GreenAndYellow' shall be used only as Protective Earth (PE) conductors according to the requirements of IEC 60446.

name: Shield Conductor Diameter
definition: Indicates the shielded conductor diameter. It is only used for coaxial wire pair.

name: Ship Loading
definition: Ship loading force

name: Ship Method
definition: Method of shipping that will be used for goods or services.

name: Short Circuit1 Pole Maximum State
definition: Maximum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

name: Short Circuit1 Pole Minimum State
definition: Minimum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

name: Short Circuit1 Pole Power Factor Maximum State
definition: Power factor of the maximum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

name: Short Circuit1 Pole Power Factor Minimum State
definition: Power factor of the minimum 1 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply i.e. the fault between 1 phase and N.

name: Short Circuit2 Pole Minimum State
definition: Minimum 2 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

name: Short Circuit2 Pole Power Factor Minimum State
definition: Power factor of the minimum 2 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

name: Short Circuit3 Pole Maximum State
definition: Maximum 3 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

name: Short Circuit3 Pole Power Factor Maximum State
definition: Power factor of the maximum 3 pole short circuit current provided at the point of supply.

name: Short Circuit Voltage
definition: A complex number that specifies the real and imaginary parts of the short-circuit voltage at rated current of a transformer given in %.

name: Shortening
definition: The ratio of the distance by which a precast piece is shortened after release from its form (due to compression induced by prestressing) to its original (nominal) length.

name: Short Inside Center Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside center lower bar.

name: Short Inside Center Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside center top bar.

name: Short Inside End Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside end lower bar.

name: Short Inside End Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short inside end top bar.

name: Short Outside Lower Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short outside lower bar.

name: Short Outside Top Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the short outside top bar.

name: Short Time Current Set Value
definition: Short time current set value. The set value of the long time tripping current if adjustable.

name: Short Time Function
definition: Applying short time function A flag indicating that the short time function of the device is used. The value should be set to FALSE for devices not having a short time function, or if the short time function is not selected to be used.

name: Short Timei2t Function
definition: Applying short time i2t function. A flag indicating that the I2t short time function of the device is used. The value should be set to TRUE only if the I2t function  is explicitly selected for the device.

name: Short Time Tripping Time
definition: Short time tripping time. The set value of the short time tripping time if adjustable.

name: Shower Head Description
definition: A description of the shower head(s) that emit the spray of water.

name: Shower Type
definition:
Selection of the type of shower from the enumerated list of types where:-Drench:     Shower that rapidly gives a thorough soaking in an emergency.
Individual:     Shower unit that is typically enclosed and is for the use of one person at a time.
Tunnel:     Shower that has a succession of shower heads or spreaders that operate simultaneously along its length.

name: Side
definition: Specifies if the width is measured to the RIGHT or to the LEFT of the curve referenced by the placement, or if the same value is applied to BOTH sides.

name: Side Flatness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the side surface in YZ, if different to the overall flatness.

name: Signal Aspect Symbol
definition: Content which is shown on the signal or sign, e.g. text, number, arrow or icon.

name: Signal Aspect Type
definition: The type of aspect, e.g. 2-display aspect for distant signal, 3-display aspect for block signal.

name: Signal Factor
definition: Factor multiplied onto offset signal.

name: Signal Frame Backboard Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the signal frame backboard.

name: Signal Frame Backboard Height
definition: The nominal height of the signal frame backboard.

name: Signal Frame Type
definition: Type of frame, e.g. main frame, route indicator, speed indicator, direction indicator, etc.

name: Signal Hood Length
definition: Nominal length of the signal hood, which is the signal lamp cover against glaring sun.

name: Signal Indicator Type
definition: Type of the indicators on a signal, e.g. route indicator, speed restriction indicator etc.

name: Signal Message
definition: All possible message available at this signal, e.g. "3/4- display automatic blocking".

name: Signal Offset
definition: Offset constant added to modified signal.

name: Signal Post Telephone ID
definition: The identifier of the signal post telephone attached to the signal.

name: Signal Post Telephone Type
definition: Indicates the type of the signal post telephone, e.g. locked, direct line, dial phone.

name: Signal Sighting Achievable Distance
definition: Reading distance of the signal, which is achievable with the help of mitigation works.

name: Signal Sighting Available Distance
definition: Reading distance of the signal without having any mitigation works.

name: Signal Sighting Combined With Repeater
definition: Combined reading distance for the signal and any associated repeaters.

name: Signal Sighting Minimum
definition: Minimal distance in which the signal has to be readable.

name: Signal Sighting Preferred
definition: Preferred distance in which the signal shall be readable.

name: Signal Sighting Route Indicator
definition: Required reading distance for the route indicator.

name: Signal Time
definition: Time factor used for integral and running average controllers.

name: Signal Time Decrease
definition: Time factor used for exponential decrease.

name: Signal Time Increase
definition: Time factor used for exponential increase.

name: Signal Viewing Minimum In Front
definition: Smallest distance where the signal has to be readable (for train very close to the signal).

name: Signal Walkway Length
definition: Indicates the length of the walkway from signal to signal post telephone.

name: Sign Area
definition: Sign Area

name: Sign Legend
definition: Text information written on the signal or sign.

name: Silt Volume
definition: Relative volume of silt (typically smaller than 0.063mm) stratum constituents.

name: Single Channel Average Power
definition: Indicates the average power of a single channel of the transport equipment.

name: Single Channel Power
definition: Indicates the power range of a single channel of the transport equipment.

name: Single Wave Transmission Rate
definition: Indicates the single wave transmission rate of the transport equipment.

name: Sink Type
definition:
Selection of the type of sink from the enumerated list of types where:-Belfast:    Deep sink that has a plain edge and a weir overflow
.
Bucket:     Sink at low level, with protected front edge, that facilitates filling and emptying buckets, usually with a hinged grid on which to stand them.
Cleaners:    Sink, usually fixed at normal height (900mm), with protected front edge.
Combination_Left:    Sink with integral drainer on left hand side
.
Combination_Right: Sink with integral drainer on right hand side
.
Combination_Double:     Sink with integral drainer on both sides
.
Drip: Small sink that catches drips or flow from a faucet
.
Laboratory: Sink, of acid resisting material, with a top edge shaped to facilitate fixing to the underside of a desktop
.
London: Deep sink that has a plain edge and no overflow
.
Plaster: Sink with sediment receiver to prevent waste plaster passing into drains
.
Pot: Large metal sink, with a standing waste, for washing cooking utensils
.
Rinsing: Metal sink in which water can be heated and culinary utensils and tableware immersed at high temperature that destroys most harmful bacteria and allows subsequent self drying.
.
Shelf: Ceramic sink with an integral back shelf through which water fittings are mounted
.
VegetablePreparation:   Large metal sink, with a standing waste, for washing and preparing vegetables
.

name: Site Coverage Ratio
definition: The ratio of the utilization,  TotalArea / BuildableArea, expressed as a maximum value. The ratio value may be used to derive BuildableArea.

name: Size
definition: The size of the connection to the valve (or to each connection for faucets, mixing valves, etc.).

name: Sizing Method
definition:
Identifies whether the damper is sized nominally or with exact measurements:NOMINAL: Nominal sizing method.
EXACT: Exact sizing method.

name: Skill Level
definition: Skill level exhibited by the actor and which indicates an extent of their capability to perform actions on the artefacts upon which they can act.

name: Skirting Board
definition: Label to indicate the material or construction of the skirting board around the space flooring. The label is used for room book information.The material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=SKIRTINGBOARD) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Skirting Board Height
definition: Height of the skirting board.The height information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=SKIRTINGBOARD) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the height assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Sleeper Arrangement
definition: Define the rail joint sleeper method of assembly ("twin sleeper" type or "between sleepers" type).

name: Sleeper Type
definition: Indicates the sleeper type.

name: Slope
