definition: Slope angle - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.  For geometry editing applications, like CAD: this value should be write-only.

name: Slot Length
definition: Slot length.

name: Slot Width
definition: Slot width.

name: Smoke Level
definition: Maximum level of smoke that the equipment complies with. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

name: Smoke Stop
definition: Indication whether the object is designed to provide a smoke stop (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Snow Sensor Measure Range
definition: Indicates the measuring range of snow depth meter.

name: Snow Sensor Type
definition: Indicates the type of snow depth meter.

name: Soffit Level
definition: Level of the highest internal part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

name: Softness Coefficient
definition: Vessel flexibility factor - proportion of impact energy absorbed by the hull.

name: Software Version
definition: Indicates version of application software according to systems integrator.

name: Soil Conductivity
definition: Thermal conductivity of soil. Generally, within standards such as IEC 60364-5-52, table 52A-16, the resistivity of soil is required (measured in [SI] units of degK.m /W). This is the reciprocal of the conductivity value and needs to be calculated accordingly.

name: Solar Absorption
definition: (Asol) The ratio of incident solar radiation that is absorbed by a glazing system. It is the sum of the absorption distributed to the exterior (a) and to the interior (qi). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

name: Solar Heat Gain Transmittance
definition: (SHGC): The ratio of incident solar radiation that contributes to the heat gain of the interior, it is the solar radiation that directly passes (Tsol or τe) plus the part of the absorbed radiation that is distributed to the interior (qi). The SHGC is referred to also as g-value (g = τe + qi).

name: Solar Reflectance
definition: (Rsol): The ratio of incident solar radiation that is reflected by a glazing system (also named ρe). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

name: Solar Reflectance Back
definition: Reflectance at normal incidence (solar): back side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "back" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

name: Solar Reflectance Front
definition: Reflectance at normal incidence (solar): front side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "front" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

name: Solar Refraction Index
definition: Index of refraction (solar) defines the "bending" of the solar ray when it passes from one medium into another.

name: Solar Transmittance
definition: The ratio of incident solar radiation that directly passes through a system (also named τe). Note the following equation Asol + Rsol + Tsol = 1

name: Sound
definition: Sound performance.

name: Sound Absorption Limit
definition: Mandatory limit values in sound absorption.

name: Sound Curve
definition:
Sound curve.

Table of sound frequencies and sound power measured in decibels at a reference power of 1 picowatt(10\^(-12) watt) for the referenced octave band frequency.

name: Sound Curve History
definition: Regenerated sound versus air-flow rate.

name: Sound Frequency
definition: List of nominal sound frequencies, correlated to the SoundPressure time series values (IfcTimeSeries.ListValues)

name: Sound Pressure
definition: A time series of sound pressure values measured in decibels at a reference pressure of 20 microPascals for the referenced octave band frequency.  Each value in IfcTimeSeries.ListValues is correlated to the sound frequency at the same position within SoundFrequencies.

name: Sound Scale
definition:
The reference sound scale.DBA: Decibels in an A-weighted scale
DBB: Decibels in an B-weighted scale
DBC: Decibels in an C-weighted scale
NC: Noise criteria
NR: Noise rating

name: Space Air Temperature
definition: Dry bulb temperature in the space.

name: Space Heater Placement
definition: Indicates how the space heater is designed to be placed.

name: Space Mean Radiant Temperature
definition: Mean radiant temperature in the space.

name: Space Relative Humidity
definition: The relative humidity of the space.

name: Space Temperature History
definition: Temperature of the space.

name: Spacing
definition: Distance between fins on a tube in the tube bundle.

name: Spacing Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the spacing bar.

name: Span
definition: Clear span for this object.The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence. For geometry editing applications, like CAD: this value should be write-only.

name: Spark Gap Type
definition: Type of Spark gap.

name: Speaker Driver Size
definition: Indicates the number of drivers and their sizes.

name: Speaker Mounting
definition: Indicates how the speaker is designed to be mounted.

name: Speaker Type
definition: Indicates the type of speaker.

name: Special Construction
definition: Special construction capabilities like self-supporting, flat devidable cable or bus flat non devidable cable or bus supporting elements inside (steal, textile, concentric conductor). Note that materials used should be agreed between exchange participants before use.

name: Special Instructions
definition: Special instructions.

name: Special Position Arrangement
definition: Type of special position at which the signal is placed.

name: Special Requirements
definition: Any additional special requirements that need to be included in the permit to work.NOTE - Additional permit requirements may be imposed according to the nature of the facility at which the work is carried out. For instance, in clean areas, special clothing may be required whilst in corrective institutions, it may be necessary to check in and check out tools that will be used for work as a safety precaution.

name: Species
definition: Wood species of a solid wood or laminated wood product.

name: Specification Section Number
definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/IfcProduct or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/IfcProduct made for this project.

name: Specific Heat Capacity
definition:
Defines the specific heat capacity of a material.

Defines the specific heat of the material: heat energy absorbed per temperature unit.

name: Specific Heat Temperature Derivative
definition: Specific heat temperature derivative.

name: Spectrum
definition: The spectrum of radiation describes its composition with regard to wavelength. Light, for example, as the portion of electromagnetic radiation that is visible to the human eye, is radiation with wavelengths in the range of approx. 380 to 780 nm (1 nm = 10 m). The corresponding range of colours varies from violet to indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, and red. These colours form a continuous spectrum, in which the various spectral sectors merge into each other.

name: Spillover Level
definition: The level at which water spills out of the object.

name: Spray Type
definition:
SprayFilled: Water is sprayed into airflow.
SplashTypeFill: water cascades over successive rows of splash bars.
FilmTypeFill: water flows in a thin layer over closely spaced sheets.

name: Spreading Rate
definition: The nominal overall mass of material per area covered by the course.

name: Sprinkler Protection
definition: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: Sprinkler Protection Automatic
definition:
Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

name: Sprinkler Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of sprinkler  from which the type required may be set.

name: Staggered
definition: If intermittent weld, staggered or not

name: Staggered Row Spacing
definition: Staggered tube row spacing.

name: Standard
definition:
The designation of the standard applicable for the definition of the object used.

The designation of the standard applicable for the definition of the characteristics of the
tripping_unit.

name: Standard Fixing Plate Depth
definition: The depth of the standard fixing plate.

name: Standard Fixing Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the standard fixing plate.

name: Standard Fixing Plate Width
definition: The width of the standard fixing plate.

name: Start Current Factor
definition: IEC. Start current factor defines how large the peak starting current will become on the engine. StartCurrentFactor is multiplied to NominalCurrent and to give the start current.

name: Start Date
definition: Date and time from which the permit becomes valid.

name: Starter Type
definition:
A list of the available types of starter from which that required may be selected where:AutoTransformer: A starter for an induction motor which uses for starting one or more reduced voltages derived from an auto transformer. (IEC 441-14-45)
Manual: A starter in which the force for closing the main contacts is provided exclusively by manual energy. (IEC 441-14-39)
DirectOnLine: A starter which connects the line voltage across the motor terminals in one step. (IEC 441-14-40)
Frequency: A starter in which the frequency of the power supply is progressively increased until the normal operation frequency is attained.
nStep: A starter in which there are (n-1) intermediate accelerating positions between the off and full on positions. (IEC 441-14-41)
Rheostatic: A starter using one or several resistors for obtaining, during starting, stated motor torque characteristics and for limiting the current. (IEC 441-14-425)
StarDelta: A starter for a 3 phase induction motor such that in the starting position the stator windings are connected in star and in the final running position they are connected in delta. (IEC 441-14-44)

name: Starting Time
definition: The time (in s) needed for the motor to reach its rated speed with its driven equipment attached, starting from standstill and at the nominal voltage applied at its terminals.

name: Starting Wind Speed
definition: Indicates the starting wind speed of the wind sensor.

name: Station
definition: The station value at this location.

name: Status
definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

name: Status History
definition: Indicates an error code or identifier, whose meaning is specific to the particular automation system.  Example values include: 'ConfigurationError', 'NotConnected', 'DeviceFailure', 'SensorFailure', 'LastKnown, 'CommunicationsFailure', 'OutOfService'.

name: Steady Device Type
definition: Type of Steady Device: To indicate the mode of registration.

name: Steam
definition: The amount of steam consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Stirrup Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the stirrup bar.

name: Stock Rail Radius
definition: The radius of the stock rail bend defined as design parameter.

name: Stone Finishes
definition: Eg. 'Polished', 'Bush Hammered', 'Split', 'Sawn', 'Flamed'

name: Storage Capacity
definition: Indicates the total data storage capacity of the device. It is defined by bytes.

name: Storage Temperature Range
definition: Allowed storage temperature range that the element complies with.

name: Storage Type
definition: Defines the general material category intended to be stored.

name: Stranding Method
definition: Specifies the method used to strand the cable. Stranding is the process where a particular number of stranding elements are joined together while winding them round a common axis.

name: Stratospheric Ozone Layer Destruction
definition: Quantity of gases destroying the stratospheric ozone layer calculated in equivalent CFC-R11.

name: Stratospheric Ozone Layer Destruction Per Unit
definition: Quantity of gases destroying the stratospheric ozone layer calculated in equivalent CFC-R11

name: Stratum Colour
definition: Stratum colour

name: Strength Class
definition: Classification of the concrete strength in accordance with the concrete design code which is applied in the project.

name: Strength Grade
definition: Grade with respect to mechanical strength and stiffness.

name: Stroke
definition: Indicates the maximum distance the actuator must traverse.

name: Structural Class
definition: The structural class defined for the concrete structure (e.g. '1').

name: Structural Grade
definition: Classification label to define mechanical properties according to structural grades defined in published standards; designated by numbers, letters, or a combination of both.

name: Structural Slope
definition: The nominal side slope (allowable steepness) of the pavement structure (not including side slope fill) as a positive ratio measure. The slope  information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters take precedence. Value is typically less than 1.0 (1:1) but may be greater than that for steeper slopes.

name: Structural Slope Type
definition: User defined description on the type of slope used for the pavement structure (not including side slope fill) . Examples are "Even" or "Stepped".

name: Structural Style
definition: Structural style of the element

name: Structural Type
definition: Structural type of the object

name: Structure
definition: State if marking is Structured or not, and what type... e.g. Kamflex, Longflex, Dropflex

name: Structure Indicator
definition: The type of bridge structure (composite, coated, homogeneous or other)

name: Style
definition: Description of the furniture style.

name: Submittal Identifer
definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/IfcProduct selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced SpecificationSectionNumber.

name: Substance Detected
definition: Identification of the substance that is being detected according to chemical formula.  For example, calcium carbonate is 'CaCO3'

name: Sulphur Dioxide Emissions
definition: Rate of emission of sulphur dioxide

name: Sump Heater Power
definition: Electrical heat power of sump heater.

name: Sump Invert Level
definition: The lowest point in the cross section of the sump.

name: Superelevation
definition: Specifies the superelevation as a ratio measure (slope) at the location of the event.

name: Supply Air Connection Type
definition: The manner in which the pipe connection is made to the cooled beam.

name: Supply Air Temperature Cooling
definition: Supply air temperature in cooling mode.

name: Supply Air Temperature Heating
definition: Supply air temperature in heating mode.

name: Supply Water Temperature Cooling
definition: Supply water temperature in cooling mode.

name: Supply Water Temperature Heating
definition: Supply water temperature in heating mode.

name: Support During Transport Description
definition: Textual description of how the concrete element is supported during transportation.

name: Support During Transport Doc Reference
definition: Reference to an external document defining how the concrete element is supported during transportation.

name: Supported Protocol
definition: Indicates the protocol supported by the IP network equipment.

name: Support Type
definition: Available support types from which that required may be selected.

name: Surface1
definition: Aspect of weld seam surface, i.e. 'plane', 'curved' or 'hollow'.  Combined welds are given by two corresponding symbols analogous to Type1 and Type2.

name: Surface2
definition: See Surface1.

name: Surface Colour
definition: The colour of the surface.

name: Surface Galling Area
definition: The galling area of the object surface.

name: Surface Genus After Features
definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items after applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of "holes" or "handles" on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.Computed using the Euler characteristic:$$\chi=V-E+F$$With the numbers of vertices (V), edges (E) and faces (F)$$\chi=2−2g−b$$With surface genus (g) and the number of boundaries (b) the latter zero in case of an enclosed volume.

name: Surface Genus Before Features
definition: The Surface Genus of the evaluated representation items before applying product-level geometric features such as openings and projections.Surface Genus is a topological measure that represents the number of "holes" or "handles" on a surface. For example, a sphere has genus 0, and a torus has genus 1.Computed using the Euler characteristic:$$\chi=V-E+F$$With the numbers of vertices (V), edges (E) and faces (F)$$\chi=2−2g−b$$With surface genus (g) and the number of boundaries (b) the latter zero in case of an enclosed volume.

name: Surface Spread Of Flame
definition:
Indication on how the flames spread around the surface,
It is given according to the national building code that governs the fire behaviour for materials.

name: Surface Temperature
definition: Average surface temperature of the component.

name: Swave Velocity
definition: S-wave velocity of a rock or soil.

name: Switch Activation
definition: A list of the available activations for switches from which that required may be selected.

name: Switch Disconnector Type
definition:
A list of the available types of switch disconnector from which that required may be selected where:CenterBreak: A disconnector in which both contacts of each pole are movable and engage at a point substantially midway between their supports. (IEC 441-14-08)
DividedSupport: A disconnector in which the fixed and moving contacts of each pole are not supported by a common base or frame. (IEC 441-14-06)
DoubleBreak: A disconnector that opens a circuit at two points. (IEC 441-14-09)
EarthingSwitch: A disconnector in which the fixed and moving contacts of each pole are not supported by a common base or frame. (IEC 441-14-07)
Isolator: A disconnector which in the open position satisfies isolating requirements. (IEC 441-14-12)

name: Switch Function
definition: Indicates types of switches which differs in functionality.

name: Switch Operation
definition: Indicates operation of emergency stop switch.

name: Switch Usage
definition: A list of the available usages for switches from which that required may be selected.

name: Symbol
definition: Content which is shown on the sign, e.g. text, number, arrow or icon. The string can also be a pointer to a symbol catalog.

name: System
definition:
The building service system that requires the provision for voids, e.g. 'Air Conditioning', 'Plumbing', 'Electro', etc.

Reference to the building service is done using the Name attribute.

name: System Height
definition: Vertical distance between the main catenary wire and the contact wire measured at a support point.

name: T2
definition: The (thermal) testing time in [s] associated with the testing currents I1 and I2.

name: Tactile Marking
definition: The kind of Tactile Marking of the element.

name: Tag
definition: The tag (or label) identifier at the particular instance of a product, e.g. the serial number, or the position number. It is the identifier at the occurrence level.

name: Tag Number
definition: Tag number.

name: Tail Diameter
definition: Diameter of the tail

name: Tail Length
definition: Length of the tail

name: Tail Strength
definition: Breaking load of the tail (note that ultimate stress is not part of any of the material Psets)

name: Tail Type
definition: Mooring tail type

name: Tank Composition
definition:
Defines the level of element composition where.COMPLEX: A set of elementary units aggregated together to fulfill the overall  required purpose.
ELEMENT: A single elementary unit that may exist of itself or as an aggregation of partial units..
PARTIAL: A partial elementary unit.

name: Tank Nominal Capacity
definition: The total nominal or design volumetric capacity of the tank.

name: Target Performance
definition: Target capacity or performance of the asset. Units of the performance value are specified through the propertyValue units attribute.

name: Technical Standard
definition: The technical standard which the element should comply with.

name: Telephone Numbers
definition: The list of telephone numbers at which telephone messages may be received.

name: Temperature
definition:
Temperature of the fluid.

Indicates the current measured temperature.

name: Temperature Classification
definition:
Enumeration defining the temperature classification of the space heater surface temperature.
low temperature - surface temperature is relatively low, usually heated by hot water or electricity.
high temperature - surface temperature is relatively high, usually heated by gas or steam.

name: Temperature During Installation
definition: Normalised working temperature.

name: Temperature Effectiveness
definition: Temperature heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of primary airflow temperature changes to maximum possible temperature changes.

name: Temperature Factor
definition: The correction factor (typically measured as %/deg K) for adjusting the thermal current/time to an ambient temperature different from the value given by the defined temperature.

name: Temperature History
definition: Temperature of the fluid. For air this value represents the dry bulb temperature.

name: Temperature Max
definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point.  If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Temperature Min
definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone, that is required from user/designer view point. If no summer or winter space temperature requirements are given, it applies all year, otherwise for the intermediate period.

name: Temperature Range
definition:
Allowable maximum and minimum temperature.

Allowable operational range of the fluid temperature.

name: Temperature Rating
definition: Temperature rating.

name: Temperature Sensor Type
definition: Enumeration that Identifies the types of temperature sensor that can be specified.

name: Temperature Set Point
definition: The temperature setpoint range and default setpoint.

name: Temperature Summer Max
definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

name: Temperature Summer Min
definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the hot (summer) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for cooling.

name: Temperature Winter Max
definition: Maximal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.

name: Temperature Winter Min
definition: Minimal temperature of the space or zone for the cold (winter) period, that is required from user/designer view point and provided as requirement for heating.

name: Tendon Relaxation
definition: The maximum allowable relaxation of the tendon (usually expressed as %/1000 h).This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

name: Tensile Strength
definition: Indicates the ability to withstand breakage apart under applied force.

name: Tensile Strength Perp
definition: Tensile strength, α=90°.

name: Tensioning Working Range
definition: The working range of the tensioning equipment under normal operation.

name: Tenure Modes Available Future
definition: A list of the tenure modes that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

name: Tenure Modes Available Now
definition: A list of the tenure modes that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel.

name: Terminal Type
definition: Specifies the kind of terminal if IsTerminal is true.

name: Termination Date
definition: Date on which the agreement terminates.

name: Test Pressure
definition: The maximum pressure to which the valve has been subjected under test.

name: Te Time
definition: The maximum time (in s) at which the motor could run with locked rotor when the motor is used in an EX-environment. The time indicates that a protective device should trip before this time when the starting current of the motor is slowing through the device.

name: Text
definition: Text content

name: Texture
definition: Stratum texture

name: Thermal Conductivity
definition: The thermal conductivity of the object.

name: Thermal Conductivity Temperature Derivative
definition: Thermal conductivity temperature derivative.

name: Thermal Efficiency
definition: Overall Thermal Efficiency is defined as gross energy output of the heat transfer device divided by the energy input.

name: Thermal Expansion Coefficient
definition: Quantity characterizing the variation with thermodynamic temperature T of the distance l between two points of a body, under given conditions (IEC 113-04-27). The ratio is defined per Kelvin.

name: Thermal Ir Emissivity Back
definition: Thermal IR emissivity: back side. Defines the fraction of thermal energy emitted per unit area to "blackbody" at the same temperature, through the "back" side of the material.

name: Thermal Ir Emissivity Front
definition: Thermal IR emissivity: front side. Defines the fraction of thermal energy emitted per unit area to "blackbody" at the same temperature, through the "front" side of the material.

name: Thermal Ir Transmittance
definition: Thermal IR transmittance at normal incidence. Defines the fraction of thermal energy that passes through per unit area, perpendicular to the surface.

name: Thermal Mass Heat Capacity
definition: Product of component mass and specific heat.

name: Thermal Transmittance
definition: Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of an element, within the direction of the thermal flow (including all materials).

name: Thermal Transmittance Summer
definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
Summer thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value).

name: Thermal Transmittance Winter
definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
Winter thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value).

name: Thermal Tripping Unit Type
definition: A list of the available types of thermal tripping unit  from which that required may be selected.

name: Thermometer Type
definition: Identifies the means by which temperature is displayed.

name: Thickness
definition: The geometric thickness of the object.

name: Thickness1
definition: First thickness parameter of a surface member with varying thickness

name: Thickness2
definition: Second thickness parameter of a surface member with varying thickness

name: Thickness3
definition: Third thickness parameter of a surface member with varying thickness

name: Thickness Swelling
definition: Swelling ratio relative to board depth.

name: Thread Diameter
definition: Nominal diameter of the thread, if different from the bolt's overall nominal diameter

name: Thread Length
definition: Nominal length of the thread

name: Threshold Depth
definition: Depth (dimension in plane perpendicular to door leaf) of the door threshold. Only given if the door lining includes a threshold. If omitted (and with a given value to threshold thickness) it indicates an adjustable depth (i.e. a depth that adjusts to the thickness of the wall into which the occurrence of this door style is inserted).

name: Threshold Offset
definition: Offset (dimension in plane perpendicular to door leaf) of the door threshold. The offset is given as distance to the x axis of the local placement. Only given if the door lining includes a threshold and the parameter is known.

name: Threshold Thickness
definition: Thickness of the door threshold as explained in the figure above. If ThresholdThickness value is 0. (zero) it denotes a door without a threshold (ThresholdDepth shall be set to NIL in this case). If the ThresholdThickness is NIL it denotes that the information about a threshold is not available.

name: Throw
definition: Distance cooled beam throws the air.

name: Throw Length
definition: The horizontal or vertical axial distance an airstream travels after leaving an AirTerminal before the maximum stream velocity is reduced to a specified terminal velocity under isothermal conditions at the upper value of the AirFlowrateRange.

name: Ticket Processing Time
definition: Indicates the processing time of a ticket.

name: Ticket Production Speed
definition: Indicates the production speed of the ticket. It is measured by counting the number of tickets that can be produced per hour.

name: Ticket Stuck Ratio
definition: Indicates the ratio of tickets being stuck or jammed in the appliance.

name: Ticket Vending Machine Type
definition: Indicates the type of ticket vending machine.

name: Tidal Range
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range between high and low tide levels.

name: Tile Length
definition: Length of ceiling tiles. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Tile Width
definition: Width of ceiling tiles. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Tilt Angle
definition: The angle of tilt defined in the plane perpendicular to the extrusion axis (X-Axis of the local placement). The angle shall be measured from the orientation of the Z-Axis in the local placement.

name: Tilt Horizontal
definition: Indicates horizontal range for pivoting, where positive values indicate the camera rotating clockwise,

name: Tilt Vertical
definition: Indicates vertical range for pivoting, where 0.0 is level, +90 degrees is looking up, -90 degrees is looking down.

name: Time Adjustment Range
definition: Upper and lower time adjustment limits for an AdjustmentValueType = RANGE. Note that this property should not have a value for an  AdjustmentValueType = LIST.

name: Time Adjustment Range Step Value
definition: Step value of time adjustment for an AdjustmentValueType = RANGE. Note that this property should not have a value for an  AdjustmentValueType = LIST.

name: Time Adjustment Values
definition: A list of time adjustment values that may be applied to a tripping unit for an AdjustmentValueType = LIST. A minimum of 1 and a maximum of 16 adjustment values may be specified. Note that this property should not have a value for an  AdjustmentValueType = RANGE.

name: Time Constant
definition: The time constant of the sensor.

name: Time Tolerance1
definition: The tolerance for the time of time/current-curve in [%].

name: Time Tolerance2
definition: The tolerance for the time of the time/current-curve in [%] valid for currents above TimeToleranceLimit1.

name: Time Tolerance Limit1
definition: The current limit in [x In] limiting the application of TimeTolerance1, if any. If the value is set to 0, the value of the TimeTolerance1 is valid for the whole time/current-curve.

name: Toggle Switch Type
definition: A list of the available types of toggle switch from which that required may be selected.

name: Toilet Pan Type
definition:
The property enumeration Pset_ToiletPanTypeEnum defines the types of toilet pan that may be specified within the property set Pset_Toilet:-Siphonic:   Toilet pan in which excrement is removed by siphonage induced by the flushing water.
Squat:  Toilet pan with an elongated bowl installed with its top edge at or near floor level, so that the user has to squat.
WashDown:   Toilet pan in which excrement is removed by the momentum of the flushing water.
WashOut:    A washdown toilet pan in which excrement falls first into a shallow water filled bowl.

name: Toilet Type
definition:
Enumeration that defines the types of toilet (water closet) arrangements that may be specified where:-BedPanWasher: Enclosed soil appliance in which bedpans and urinal bottles are emptied and cleansed.
Chemical: Portable receptacle or soil appliance that receives and retains excrement in either an integral or a separate container, in which it is chemically treated and from which it has to be emptied periodically.
CloseCoupled:   Toilet suite in which a flushing cistern is connected directly to the water closet pan.
LooseCoupled:   Toilet arrangement in which a flushing cistern is connected to the water closet pan through a flushing pipe.
SlopHopper:     Hopper shaped soil appliance with a flushing rim and outlet similar to those of a toilet pan, into which human excrement is emptied for disposal.

name: Tolerance Basis
definition: Indication of the basis of the tolerance requirement

name: Tolerance Description
definition: General description of the tolerance associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

name: Topping Type
definition: Defines if a topping is applied and what kind. Values are “Full topping”, “Perimeter Wash”, “None”

name: Torque
definition: Indicates the maximum close-off torque for the actuator.

name: Torque Range
definition: Torque range: minimum operational torque to maximum allowable torque.

name: Torsional Strength
definition: Shear strength in torsion.

name: Total Area
definition: Total planned area for the site. Used for programming the site space.

name: Total Cooling Capacity
definition: Total cooling capacity. This includes cooling capacity of beam and cooling capacity of supply air.

name: Total Cooling Load
definition: The peak total cooling load for the building, zone or space.

name: Total Effectiveness
definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of heat transfer to the maximum possible heat transfer.

name: Total Effectiveness Table
definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary and secondary air flow rate.

name: Total Heat Gain
definition: The total (sensible+latent) amount of heat or energy gained by the space at the time of the space's peak cooling conditions.

name: Total Heating Capacity
definition: Total heating capacity. This includes heating capacity of beam and heating capacity of supply air.

name: Total Heating Load
definition: The peak total heating load for the building, zone or space.

name: Total Heat Loss
definition: The total amount of heat or energy lost by the space at the time of the space's peak heating conditions.

name: Total Heat Transfer Rate
definition: Total heat transfer rate.

name: Total Latent Load
definition: Total energy added or removed from air that affects its humidity or concentration of water vapor.  If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

name: Total Latent Load History
definition: Total energy added or removed from air that affects its humidity or concentration of water vapor.  If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

name: Total Primary Energy Consumption
definition: Quantity of energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007.

name: Total Primary Energy Consumption Per Unit
definition: Quantity of energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007.

name: Total Radiant Load
definition: Total electromagnetic energy added or removed by emission or absorption.  If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

name: Total Radiant Load History
definition: Total electromagnetic energy added or removed by emission or absorption.  If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

name: Total Sensible Load
definition: Total energy added or removed from air that affects its temperature.  If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

name: Total Sensible Load History
definition: Total energy added or removed from air that affects its temperature.  If a value is less than zero (negative), then the thermal load is lost from the space. If a value is greater than zero (positive), then the thermal load is a gain to the space.

name: Total Surface Area
definition: Total surface area of the element.

name: Total UACurves
definition: Total UA curves, UA - air and water velocities, UA = [(C1 * AirFlowRate\^0.8)\^-1 + (C2 * WaterFlowRate\^0.8)\^-1]\^-1.  Note: as two variables are used, DefiningValues and DefinedValues are null, and values are stored in IfcTable in the following order: AirFlowRate,WaterFlowRate,UA.  The IfcTable is related to IfcPropertyTableValue using IfcMetric and IfcResourceConstraintRelationship.

name: Total Wattage
definition: Wattage on whole lightfitting device with all sources intact.

name: Touch Screen
definition: Indicates touchscreen support.

name: Town
definition: The name of a town.

name: Track Characteristic
definition: Indicates the characteristic of the track.

name: Track Element Orientation
definition: Turnout panels can be placed in 2 mirror-symmetric directions in the field. To distinguish both ends of the turnout panel, a definition of an orientation system with respect to the panel is necessary. The orientation defines, if the panel is oriented in a way or opposite with respect to the direction of the alignment/stationing.

name: Track Expansion
definition: In curvature context, bounded value of the expansion distance that can be added to rail gauge.

name: Track Fastening Elasticity Type
definition: Track fastening elasticity type.

name: Track Gauge Length
definition: Basic track gauge of permanent way.

name: Track ID
definition: The unique identification number of the track.

name: Tracking Identifier
definition: The identifier assigned to the agreement for the purposes of tracking.

name: Track Number
definition: Indicates the local identification number of the track.

name: Track Supporting Structure
definition: Indicates the supporting structure for track part.

name: Track Usage
definition: The expected primary usage of the track.

name: Traction Force
definition: Traction force of the point machine in turnout conversion.

name: Traffic Interface Type
definition: Indicates the type of the device traffic interfaces.

name: Transformation Ratio
definition: The ratio of the actual primary current or voltage to the actual secondary current or voltage.

name: Transformer Vector Group
definition:
List of the possible vector groups for the transformer from which that required may be set. Values in the enumeration list follow a standard international code where the first letter  describes how the primary windings are connected,
the second letter describes how the secondary windings are connected, and the numbers describe the rotation of voltages and currents from the primary to the secondary side in multiples of 30 degrees.D: means that the windings are delta-connected.
Y: means that the windings are star-connected.
Z: means that the windings are zig-zag connected (a special start-connected providing low reactance of the transformer);
The connectivity is only relevant for three-phase transformers.

name: Transition Superelevation
definition: The type of transition of superelevation from previous event to this one.

name: Transition Width
definition: The type of transition of width used between the previous event and this event.

name: Transmission Efficiency
definition: Transmission efficiency of the tensioning equipment.

name: Transmission Loss
definition: Indicates the transmission loss of the leaky coaxial cable (radiating cable).

name: Transmission Rate
definition: Data transmission rate between the device and the receiving module in bits per second.

name: Transom Offset
definition: Offset of the transom (if given) which divides the door leaf from a glazing (or window) above. The offset is given from the bottom of the door opening.

name: Transom Thickness
definition:
Thickness of the transom.

For a window, it is the thickness of the transom (horizontal separator of window panels within a window), measured parallel to the window elevation plane. The transom is part of the lining and the transom depth is assumed to be identical to the lining depth. If the TransomThickness is set to zero (and the TransomOffset set to a positive length), then the window is divided vertically without a physical divider.

name: Transportation Strength
definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete required for transportation.

name: Transport Equipment Assembly Type
definition: Indicates the type of transport equipment assembly.

name: Transport Equipment Type
definition: Indicates the type of transport equipment.

name: Transverse Sensitivity Ratio
definition: Indicates the transverse sensitivity ratio of the sensor.

name: Trap Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of trap from which the type required may be set.

name: Tread Length
definition:
Horizontal distance from the front of the thread to the front of the next tread.
The tread length is supposed to be equal for all steps of the stair or stair flight at the walking line.

name: Tread Length At Inner Side
definition:
Minimum length of treads at the inner side of the winder.
Only relevant in case of winding flights, for straight flights it is identical with IfcStairFlight.TreadLength. It is a pre-calculated value, in case of inconsistencies, the value derived from the shape representation shall take precedence.

name: Tread Length At Offset
definition:
Length of treads at a given offset.
Walking line position is given by the 'WalkingLineOffset'. The resulting value should normally be identical with TreadLength, it may be given in addition, if the walking line offset for building code calculations is different from that used in design.

name: Tripping Curve
definition:
A curve that establishes the release time of a tripping unit when a particular prospective current is applied.  Note that the tripping curve is defined within a Cartesian coordinate system and this fact must be asserted within the property set:(1) Defining value is the Prospective Current which is a list of minimum 2 and maximum 16 numbers providing the currents in [x In] for points in the current/time log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points.
(2) Defined value is a list of minimum 2 and maximum 16 numbers providing the release_time in [s] for points in the current/time log/log coordinate space. The curve is drawn as a straight line between two consecutive points. Note that a defined interpolation.

name: Tripping Curve Type
definition: The type of tripping curve that is represented by the property set.

name: Tube Diameter
definition: Indicates the diameter of the fiber tubes that are used in the fan out.

name: Tubing Length
definition: Water tube length inside the component.

name: Tuner Channel
definition: Indicates the tuner channels, if applicable.

name: Tuner Frequency
definition: Indicates the tuner frequencies, if applicable.

name: Tuner Mode
definition: Indicates the tuner modes (or bands).  For example, 'AnalogCable', 'DigitalAir', 'AM', 'FM'.

name: Tuner Type
definition: Indicates the tuner type.

name: Turnout Curved Radius
definition: If turnout is curved, the main branch radius of curvature.

name: Turnout Heater Type
definition: Defines the kind of turnout heater installed.

name: Turnout Point Machine Count
definition: Count of point machines inside turnout panel.

name: Turnstile Type
definition: Indicates the type of turnstile gate.

name: Twisting
definition: The angle, in radians, through which the end face of a precast piece is rotated with respect to its starting face, along its longitudinal axis, as a result of non-aligned supports. This measure is also termed the ‘warping’ angle.

name: Type
definition: Defines the allowed values for selection of the flow meter operation type.

name: Type1
definition: Type of weld seam according to ISO 2553.  Note, combined welds are given by two corresponding symbols in the direction of the normal axis of the coordinate system.  For example, an X weld is specified by Type1 = 'V' and Type2 = 'V'.

name: Type2
definition: See Type1.

name: Type Designation
definition: Type designator for the element. The content depends on local standards. Eg. 'Bull nose', 'Half batter', 'Dropper', 'Chamfer' etc

name: Type Of Curved Turnout
definition: Turnouts that are positioned in the curved part of the alignment.

name: Type Of Driving Device
definition: Type of the driving device used for the turnout.

name: Type Of Junction
definition: The turnout part of the continuous welded rail.

name: Type Of Shaft
definition: Additional information on the purpose of the shaft.

name: Type Of Supporting System
definition: Type of foundation in the OCS supporting system.

name: Type Of Turnout
definition: Type of turnout.

name: UACurve
definition:
UA value.

As a function of ambient temperature and surface temperature; UA = f (Tambient, Tsurface)

name: UAcurves
definition: UV = f (VExterior, VInterior), UV as a function of interior and exterior fluid flow velocity at the entrance.

name: Ultimate Strain
definition: A measure of the (engineering) strain at the state of ultimate stress of the material.

name: Ultimate Stress
definition: A measure of the ultimate stress of the material.

name: Ultimate Tensile Strength
definition: Indicates the maximum stress that a material or element can withstand before breaking while being stretched or pulled.

name: Uncertainty Basis
definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

name: Uncertainty Description
definition: General description of the uncertainty associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

name: Under Sleeper Pad Stiffness
definition: Indicates the stiffness of the under-sleeper pad as design reference for the sleeper.

name: Undisturbed Volume
definition: Undisturbed Volume

name: Uniformly Distributed Load
definition: Uniformly Distributed Load

name: Unitary Application
definition: The application of the unitary control element.

name: Unmitigated Risk Consequence
definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

name: Unmitigated Risk Likelihood
definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

name: Unmitigated Risk Significance
definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the likelihood and consequence prior to any specific mitigation.

name: Upper Current1
definition: The current in [x In], indicating that for currents larger than UpperCurrent1 the I2t part of the L-function will trip the current.

name: Upper Current2
definition: The current in [x In], indicating the upper current limit of the upper time/current curve of the I2t part of the L-function.

name: Upper Time1
definition: The time in [s], indicating that tripping times of the upper time/current curve lower than UpperTime1 is determined by the I2t part of the L-function.

name: Upper Time2
definition: The time in [s], indicating the tripping times of the upper time/current curve at the UpperCurrent2.

name: Upper Vapor Resistance Factor
definition: The vapor permeability relationship of air/material (typically value > 1), measured in high relative humidity (typically in 95/50 % RH).

name: Upstand
definition: The height difference between the two separated surfaces.

name: Upstream Connections
definition: Names of upstream connected equipment and spaces, if not otherwise represented

name: Upstream Flood Water Level
definition: Design maximum upstream water level for the lock complex

name: Upstream Maintenance Water Level
definition: Design maximum upstream water level for the lock complex

name: Upstream Pressure
definition: The operating pressure of the fluid upstream of the pressure reducing valve.

name: Urinal Type
definition:
Selection of the type of urinal from the enumerated list of types where:-Bowl: Individual wall mounted urinal.
Slab: Urinal that consists of a slab or sheet fixed to a wall and down which urinal flows into a floor channel.
Stall: Floor mounted urinal that consists of an elliptically shaped sanitary stall fixed to a wall and down which urine flows into a floor channel.
Trough: Wall mounted urinal of elongated rectangular shape on plan, that can be used by more than one person at a time.

name: Usage Purpose
definition: The purpose of usage of the cess between rails, e.g. maintenance, rescue services.

name: Use In Discrimination
definition:
An indication whether the time/current tripping information can be applied in a discrimination
analysis or not.

name: Use Purpose
definition: The principal purpose for which the work surface is intended to be used e.g. writing/reading, computer, meeting, printer, reference files, etc.

name: User Capacity
definition: Indicates the user capacity of the device, defined as the maximum number of users that can be active at the same time.

name: User Correction Factor
definition: An arbitrary correction factor that may be applied by the user.

name: User Defined LRMType
definition: Gives the user defined type of this Linear Referencing Method when property LRMType is LRM_USERDEFINED.

name: User Defined Operation Type
definition: Designator for the user defined operation type, shall only be provided, if the value of OperationType is set to USERDEFINED.

name: User Defined Partitioning Type
definition: Designator for the user defined partitioning type, shall only be provided, if the value of PartitioningType is set to USERDEFINED.

name: User Defined Purpose
definition: Allows for specification of user specific purpose of the address beyond the enumeration values provided by Purpose attribute of type IfcAddressTypeEnum. When a value is provided for attribute UserDefinedPurpose, in parallel the attribute Purpose shall have enumeration value USERDEFINED.

name: User History
definition: Indicates acknowledging user over time by identification corresponding to IfcPerson.Identification on an IfcActor.

name: User Interface Type
definition: Indicates the user interface of the computer.

name: Vacancy Rate In Category Future
definition: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category expected in the future.

name: Vacancy Rate In Category Now
definition: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category currently.

name: Value
definition:
The expected range and default value.

Indicates sensed values over time which may be recorded continuously or only when changed beyond a particular deadband.  The range of possible values is defined by the SetPoint property of the corresponding sensor type property set.

name: Value History
definition: Indicates values over time which may be recorded continuously or only when changed beyond a particular deadband.  The range of possible values is defined by the Value property on the corresponding occurrence property set (Pset_ControllerTypeFloating, Pset_ControllerTypeProportional, Pset_ControllerTypeMultiPosition, or Pset_ControllerTypeTwoPosition).

name: Valve Mechanism
definition:
The mechanism by which the valve function is achieved where:BALL: Valve that has a ported ball that can be turned relative to the body seat ports.
BUTTERFLY: Valve in which a streamlined disc pivots about a diametric axis.
CONFIGUREDGATE: Screwdown valve in which the closing gate is shaped in a configured manner to have a more precise control of pressure and flow change across the valve.
GLAND: Valve with a tapered seating, in which a rotatable plug is retained by means of a gland and gland packing.
GLOBE: Screwdown valve that has a spherical body.
LUBRICATEDPLUG: Plug valve in which a lubricant is injected under pressure between the plug face and the body.
NEEDLE: Valve for regulating the flow in or from a pipe, in which a slender cone moves along the axis of flow to close against a fixed conical seat.
PARALLELSLIDE: Screwdown valve that has a machined plate that slides in formed grooves to form a seal.
PLUG: Valve that has a ported plug that can be turned relative to the body seat ports.
WEDGEGATE: Screwdown valve that has a wedge shaped plate fitting into tapered guides to form a seal.

name: Valve Operation
definition:
The method of valve operation where:DROPWEIGHT: A valve that is closed by the action of a weighted lever being released, the weight normally being prevented from dropping by being held by a wire, the closure normally being made by the action of heat on a fusible link in the wire
FLOAT: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a float that rises and falls with water level. The float may be a ball attached to a lever or other mechanism
HYDRAULIC: A valve that is opened and closed by hydraulic actuation
LEVER: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a lever rotating the gate within the valve.
LOCKSHIELD: A valve that requires the use of a special lockshield key for opening and closing, the operating mechanism being protected by a shroud during normal operation.
MOTORIZED: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of an electric motor on an actuator
PNEUMATIC: A valve that is opened and closed by pneumatic actuation
SOLENOID: A valve that is normally held open by a magnetic field in a coil acting on the gate but that is closed immediately if the electrical current generating the magnetic field is removed.
SPRING: A valve that is normally held in position by the pressure of a spring on a plate but that may be caused to open if the pressure of the fluid is sufficient to overcome the spring pressure.
THERMOSTATIC: A valve in which the ports are opened or closed to maintain a required predetermined temperature.
WHEEL: A valve that is opened and closed by the action of a wheel moving the gate within the valve.

name: Valve Pattern
definition:
The configuration of the ports of a valve according to either the linear route taken by a fluid flowing through the valve or by the number of ports where:SINGLEPORT: Valve that has a single entry port from the system that it serves, the exit port being to the surrounding environment.
ANGLED_2_PORT: Valve in which the direction of flow is changed through 90 degrees.
STRAIGHT_2_PORT: Valve in which the flow is straight through.
STRAIGHT_3_PORT: Valve with three separate ports.
CROSSOVER_4_PORT: Valve with 4 separate ports.

name: Vapor Permeability
definition: The rate of water vapor transmission per unit area per unit of vapor pressure differential under test conditions.

name: Varistor Type
definition: A list of the available types of varistor  from which that required may be selected.

name: Vehicle Availability
definition: Vehicle or Plant availability

name: Velocity
definition: The velocity of the fluid.

name: Velocity Factor Energy
definition: Deviation in energy absorption performance due to strain rate

name: Velocity Factor Reaction
definition: Deviation in reaction due to strain rate

name: Velocity History
definition: The velocity of the fluid.

name: Vending Machine User Interface
definition: Indicates the type of vending machine user interface.

name: Ventilating Pipe Size
definition: Size of the ventilating pipe(s).

name: Ventilation
definition: Required outside air ventilation.

name: Ventilation Air Flow Rate History
definition: Ventilation air flow rate in the space.

name: Ventilation Design Air Flow
definition: Ventilation outside air requirement for the space.

name: Ventilation Indoor Air
definition: Ventilation loads from indoor air.

name: Ventilation Indoor Air History
definition: Ventilation loads from indoor air.

name: Ventilation Outdoor Air
definition: Ventilation loads from outdoor air.

name: Ventilation Outdoor Air History
definition: Ventilation loads from outdoor air.

name: Vertical Bar Pitch
definition: The pitch length of the vertical bar.

name: Vertical Orthogonality
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the vertical shape and orientation in Z, if different to the overall orthogonality.

name: Vertical Spacing
definition: Vertical spacing between tubes in the tube bundle.

name: Vertical Straightness
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the vertical shape in Z, if different to the overall straightness.

name: Vertical Tolerance
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the overall tolerance.

name: Vertical Uncertainty
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the linear uncertainty.

name: Vessel Depth
definition: Depth of the vessel from the main deck to the keel.

name: Vessel Draft
definition: Depth of vessel from the waterline to the keel (LightShip, Ballasted, Maximum)

name: Vibration Transmissibility
definition: The vibration transmissibility percentage.

name: Video Caption Mode
definition: Indicates video closed captioning modes.

name: Video Capture Interval
definition: Indicates video frame capture time intervals.

name: Video Resolution Height
definition: Indicates the number of vertical pixels (the largest native video resolution height).

name: Video Resolution Mode
definition: Indicates video resolution modes.

name: Video Resolution Width
definition: Indicates the number of horizontal pixels (the largest native video resolution width).

name: Video Scale Mode
definition: Indicates video scaling modes.

name: Viscosity Temperature Derivative
definition: Viscosity temperature derivative.

name: Visible Angle Left
definition: Angle of visibility to the left of the access.

name: Visible Angle Right
definition: Angle of visibility to the right of the access.

name: Visible Light Reflectance
definition: Fraction of the visible light that is reflected by the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

name: Visible Light Transmittance
definition: Fraction of the visible light that passes the object at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

name: Visible Reflectance Back
definition: Reflectance at normal incidence (visible): back side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray in the visible spectrum that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "back" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

name: Visible Reflectance Front
definition: Reflectance at normal incidence (visible): front side. Defines the fraction of the solar ray in the visible spectrum that is reflected and not transmitted when the ray passes from one medium into another, at the "front" side of the other material, perpendicular to the surface. Dependent on material and surface characteristics.

name: Visible Refraction Index
definition: Index of refraction (visible) defines the "bending" of the sola! r ray in the visible spectrum when it passes from one medium into another.

name: Visible Transmittance
definition: Transmittance at normal incidence (visible). Defines the fraction of the visible spectrum of solar radiation that passes through per unit area, perpendicular to the surface.

name: Void Shape
definition: The shape form of the provision for void, the minimum set of agreed values includes 'Rectangle', 'Round', and 'Undefined'.

name: Voltage
definition: The actual voltage and operable range.

name: Voltage History
definition: Log of electrical voltage.

name: Voltage Level
definition: The voltage levels for which the data of the instance is valid. More than one value may be selected in the enumeration.

name: Voltage Regulation Rate
definition: When the input side voltage changes from the lowest allowable input value to the specified maximum value, the relative change value of the output voltage is the percentage of the rated output voltage.

name: Volume
definition:
Volume of the element.

Volume represented, if lower surface of stratum known.

name: Volumetric Efficiency
definition: Ratio of the actual volume of gas entering the compressor to the theoretical displacement of the compressor.

name: Volumetric Flow Rate
definition: The volumetric flow rate of the fluid.

name: Volumetric Flow Rate History
definition: The volumetric flow rate of the fluid.

name: Waist Thickness
definition: Minimum thickness of the stair flight, measured perpendicular to the slope of the flight to the inner corner of riser and tread. It is a pre-calculated value, in case of inconsistencies, the value derived from the shape representation shall take precedence.

name: Walking Line Offset
definition:
Offset of the walking line from the inner side of the flight.
Note: the walking line may have a own shape representation (in case of inconsistencies, the value derived from the shape representation shall take precedence).

name: Wall Covering
definition: Label to indicate the material or finish of the space cladding. The label is used for room book information and often displayed in room stamp.The material information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CLADDING) object with own shape representation and material assignment. In case of inconsistency the material assigned to IfcCovering elements takes precedence.

name: Wall Covering Thickness
definition: Thickness of the material layer(s) for the space cladding.The thickness information is provided in absence of an IfcCovering (type=CLADDING) object with own shape representation. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters of an assigned IfcCovering and this attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

name: Wall Material
definition:
The material from which the wall of the chamber is constructed.
NOTE: It is assumed that chamber walls will be constructed of a single material.

name: Wall Thickness
definition:
The thickness of the wall construction.
NOTE: It is assumed that walls will be constructed at a single thickness.

name: Warranty Content
definition: The content of the warranty.

name: Warranty Identifier
definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

name: Warranty Period
definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

name: Warranty Start Date
definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

name: Washers Count
definition: Count of washers to be mounted on one bolt

name: Washer Shape
definition: Shape of the washers, e.g. 'Standard', 'Square'

name: Wash Hand Basin Type
definition:
Defines the types of wash hand basin that may be specified where:DentalCuspidor: Waste water appliance that receives and flushes away mouth washings
.
HandRinse: Wall mounted wash hand basin that has an overall width of 500mm or less
.
Hospital: Wash hand basin that has a smooth easy clean surface without tapholes or overflow slot for use where hygiene is of prime importance.Tipup: Wash hand basin mounted on pivots so that it can be emptied by tilting.Vanity: Wash hand basin for installation into a horizontal surface.Washfountain: Wash hand basin that is circular, semi-circular or polygonal on plan, at which more than one person can wash at the same time.
WashingTrough: Wash hand basin of elongated rectangular shape in plan, at which more than one person can wash at the same time.

name: Waste Trap Type
definition: Identifies the predefined types of trap from which the type required may be set.

name: Water
definition: The amount of water consumed during the period specified in the time series.

name: Water Consumption
definition: Quantity of water used.

name: Water Consumption Per Unit
definition: Quantity of water used.

name: Water Content
definition: Weight of water content within the heater.

name: Water Delivery System Type
definition: Type of water delivery system

name: Water Delivery Valve Type
definition: Type of water delivery valve

name: Water Filter Type
definition: Further qualifies the type of water filter.  Filtration removes undissolved matter; Purification removes dissolved matter; Softening replaces dissolved matter.

name: Water Flow Control System Type
definition: Factory fitted waterflow control system.

name: Water Fouling Resistance
definition: Fouling resistance on water/air side.

name: Water Impermeability
definition: Description of the water impermeability denoting the water repelling properties.

name: Water Inlet Temperature Range
definition: Allowable water inlet temperature range.

name: Water Is Potable
definition: Indication of whether the water flow from the hydrant is potable (set TRUE) or non potable (set FALSE).

name: Water Press Drop Curve
definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate.

name: Water Pressure Drop Curve
definition: Water pressure drop curve, pressure drop – flow rate curve, WaterPressureDrop = f(WaterflowRate).

name: Water Pressure Drop Curves
definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate.

name: Water Pressure Range
definition: Allowable water circuit working pressure range.

name: Water Requirement
definition: Make-up water requirement.

name: Water Storage Capacity
definition: Water storage capacity.

name: Water Sump Temperature
definition: Water sump temperature.

name: Water Tightness Rating
definition:
Water tightness rating for this object.
It is provided according to the national building code.

name: Water Volume
definition: Relative volume of water stratum constituents.

name: Wave Loading
definition: Wave loading force

name: Wave Range
definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range between peaks and troughs of waves

name: Weather Conditions
definition: Indicates the weather conditions during the application of the course

name: Weather Data Date
definition: The date for which the weather data was gathered.

name: Weather Data Station
definition: The site weather data station description or reference to the data source from which weather data was obtained for use in calculations.

name: Weather Downtime
definition: Weather downtime proportion

name: Weight
definition: Total weight of object

name: Weighted Efficiency
definition: Filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

name: Weighted Efficiency Curve
definition: Weighted efficiency curve as a function of dust holding weight, efficiency = f (dust holding weight).

name: Weld Diameter
definition: Dimension of the required hole diameter at the faying surface, or required spot weld diameter at the faying surface, or required stud diameter.REFERENCE Symbol d according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Weld Element Length
definition: Length of each weld element.REFERENCE Symbol l according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Weld Element Spacing
definition: Spacing between weld elements (centre to centre)REFERENCE Symbol e according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Weld Leg Length
definition: Distance from the actual or projected intersection of the fusion faces and the toe of a fillet weld, measured across the fusion face.REFERENCE Symbol z according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Weld Width
definition: Required elongated hole width at the faying surface or seam weld width at the faying surface.REFERENCE Symbol c according to ISO 2553:2019.

name: Wet Bulb Temperature
definition: Wet bulb temperature of the air.

name: Wet Bulb Temperature History
definition: Wet bulb temperature of the fluid; only applicable if the fluid is air.

name: Wet Coil Fraction
definition: Fraction of coil surface area that is wet (0-1).

name: Wheel Tip Speed
definition: Fan blade tip speed, typically defined as the linear speed of the tip of the fan blade furthest from the shaft.

name: Wide Channel Width
definition: Indicates the width of the wide channel.

name: Width
definition:
The width of the object. Only given, if the object has constant thickness (prismatic).

Total outer width of the window lining. It should only be provided, if it is a rectangular window.

name: Winch Break Limit
definition: Line force at which the winch starts to release the line (maximum load)

name: Wind Angle Range
definition: Indicates the wind angle range the sensor can monitor.

name: Wind Load Rating
definition:
Wind load resistance rating for this object.
It is provided according to the national building code.

name: Wind Sensor Type
definition: Enumeration that Identifies the types of wind sensors that can be specified.

name: Wind Speed Range
definition: Indicates the range of wind speed the sensor can monitor.

name: Wire Diameter
definition: The nominal diameter of the wire.

name: Wire Embedding Length
definition: The length of the part of wire which is embedded in the precast concrete element.

name: Wire Loop Base Plate Length
definition: The length of the base plate.

name: Wire Loop Base Plate Thickness
definition: The thickness of the base plate.

name: Wire Loop Base Plate Width
definition: The width of the base plate.

name: Wire Loop Length
definition: The length of the fastening loop part of the wire.

name: Wire Pair Type
definition: Indicates the type of wire pair, i.e., twisted, untwisted or coaxial pair.

name: With Backdrop
definition: Indicates whether the chamber has a backdrop or tumbling bay (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: With Lightning Rod
definition: Indicates whether the element is equipped with a lightning rod (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

name: With Lock
definition: Indicates whether the file cabinet is lockable (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

name: Workability
definition: Description of the workability of the fresh concrete defined according to local standards.

name: Work Day Duration
definition: The elapsed time within a worktime-based day. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display IfcTask durations in work days where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 24 hours (an elapsed day); if omitted then 8 hours is assumed.

name: Work Execution Level
definition: Adjustment of the service life resulting from the effect of the quality of work executed.

name: Work Finish Time
definition: The default time of day a task is scheduled to finish. For presentation purposes, if the finish time of a task matches the WorkFinishTime, then applications may choose to display the date only. Conversely when entering dates without specifying time, applications may automatically append the WorkFinishTime.

name: Working Pressure
definition:
Working pressure.

The normally expected maximum working pressure of the valve.

name: Working Pressure History
definition: Boiler working pressure.

name: Working Pressure Range
definition: Allowable minimum and maximum  working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

name: Working State
definition: Indicates the working state of device or system.

name: Work Month Duration
definition: The elapsed time within a worktime-based month. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display IfcTask durations in work months where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 744 hours (an elapsed month of 31 days); if omitted then 160 hours is assumed.

name: Work Start Time
definition: The default time of day a task is scheduled to start. For presentation purposes, if the start time of a task matches the WorkStartTime, then applications may choose to display the date only. Conversely when entering dates without specifying time, applications may automatically append the WorkStartTime.

name: Worksurface Area
definition: The value of the work surface area of the desk.

name: Work Type Requested
definition: Work type requested in circumstances where there are categorizations of types of work task. It could be used to identify a remedial task, minor work task, electrical task etc.

name: Work Week Duration
definition: The elapsed time within a worktime-based week. For presentation purposes, applications may choose to display IfcTask durations in work weeks where IfcTaskTime.DurationType=WORKTIME. This value must be less than or equal to 168 hours (an elapsed week); if omitted then 40 hours is assumed.

name: Wrapping Material
definition: Special requirements for material used to wrap an artefact.

name: WWWHome Page URL
definition: The world wide web address at which the preliminary page of information for the person or organization can be located.NOTE  Information on the world wide web for a person or organization may be separated into a number of pages and across a number of host sites, all of which may be linked together. It is assumed that all such information may be referenced from a single page that is termed the home page for that person or organization.

name: XDirection Lower Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with X direction lower bar.

name: XDirection Tie Hoop Bar Pitch
definition: The X direction pitch length of the tie hoop.

name: XDirection Tie Hoop Count
definition: The number of bars with X direction tie hoop bars.

name: XDirection Upper Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with X direction upper bar.

name: YDirection Lower Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with Y direction lower bar.

name: YDirection Tie Hoop Bar Pitch
definition: The Y direction pitch length of the tie hoop.

name: YDirection Tie Hoop Count
definition: The number of bars with Y direction tie hoop bars.

name: YDirection Upper Bar Count
definition: The number of bars with Y direction upper bar.

name: Year Of Construction
definition: Year of construction of this building, including expected year of completion.

name: Year Of Last Refurbishment
definition: Year of last major refurbishment, or reconstruction, of the building (applies to reconstruction works).

name: Yield Stress
definition: A measure of the yield stress (or characteristic 0.2 percent proof stress) of the material.

name: Young Modulus
definition: A measure of the Young's modulus of elasticity of the material.

name: Young Modulus Bending
definition: Defining values: α; defined values: elastic modulus in bending.

name: Young Modulus Compression
definition: Elastic modulus in compression.

name: Young Modulus Min
definition: Elastic modulus, minimal value, α=0°.

name: Young Modulus Perp
definition: Elastic modulus, mean value, α=90°.

name: Young Modulus Perp Min
definition: Elastic modulus, minimal value, α=90°.

name: Young Modulus Tension
definition: Defining values: α; defined values: elastic modulus in tension.

name: Zoom
definition: Indicates the zoom range.

name: Reference
definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

name: Cant Deficiency
definition: Difference between applied cant and a higher equilibrium cant.

name: Cant Equilibrium
definition: Cant at a particular speed at which the vehicle will have a resultant force perpendicular to the running plane.

name: Start Smoothing Length
definition: Length for the circular transition change of curvature at the start of the cant segment, measured from the start of the cant segment to the end of the circular transition change of curvature.

name: End Smoothing Length
definition: Length for the circular transition change of curvature at the end of the cant segment, measured from the start of the circular transition change of curvature to the end of the cant segment.

name: Start Elevation
definition: Elevation of the start point relative to the mean sea level.

name: End Elevation
definition: Elevation of the end point relative to the mean sea level.

name: Railway Communication Terminal Type
definition: Indicates the type of railway communication terminal.

name: Schedule Work Progression
definition: The scheduled work on behalf of the resource allocation.

name: Actual Work Time
definition: The actual work on behalf of the resource allocation.

name: Remaining Work Progression
definition: The remaining work on behalf of the resource allocation.

name: Schedule Cost
definition: The budgeted cost on behalf of the resource allocation.

name: Actual Cost
definition: The actual cost on behalf of the resource allocation.

name: Remaining Cost
definition: The remaining cost on behalf of the resource allocation.

name: Schedule Completion
definition: The scheduled completion percentage of the allocation.

name: Actual Completion
definition: The actual completion percentage of the allocation.

name: Is Main
definition: Identifies if the current instance is a main distribution point or topmost level in an electrical distribution hierarchy (= TRUE) or a sub-main distribution point (= FALSE).

name: Is Skilled Operator
definition: Identifies if the current instance requires a skilled person or instructed person to perform operations on the distribution board (= TRUE) or whether operations may be performed by a person without appropriate skills or instruction (= FALSE).

name: Inspection Chamber Invert Level
definition: Level of the lowest part of the cross section as measured from ground level.

name: Span Nominal Length
definition: The length of span as a design parameter for the overhead contactline system.

name: Contact Wire Nominal Drop
definition: Vertical distance between the main catenary wire and the contact wire measured at a support point.

name: Contact Wire Nominal Height
definition: Nominal distance from the top of the rail to the lower face of the contact wire, measured perpendicular to the track.

name: Contact Wire Uplift
definition: Vertical upward movement of the contact wire due to the force produced from the pantograph.
