name: Electrical Clearance
definition: The recommended air clearances between earth and the live parts of the overhead contactline system.

name: Number Of Overlapping Spans
definition: Number of overlapping spans in the overhead contactline system.

name: Pantograph Type
definition: Indicates the type of pantograph as a design parameter for the overhead contactline system.

name: Tension Length
definition: Length of overhead contactline between two terminating points. It is a design parameter for the overhead contactline system.

name: OCSType
definition: Indicates the type of overhead contactline system (OCS).

name: Electronic Filter Type
definition: Type of electronic filter.

name: Band Width
definition: Indicates the bandwidth for telecommunication of the device.

name: Data Encryption Type
definition: Indicates the type of security protocols that can be used in the access point to protect the wireless network.

name: Data Exchange Rate
definition: Indicates the data transfer rate of the access point in bit per second (bps).

name: Number Of Antennas
definition: Indicates the number of antennas integrated in the device.

name: Number Of Carriers
definition: Indicates how many carrier frequencies can be managed by the device.

name: Number Of Emergency Transceivers
definition: Indicates the number of emergency transceivers in the base band unit.

name: Maximum Number Of RRUs
definition: Indicates the maximum number of remote radio units (RRU) which can be connected to the baseband unit.

name: Downlink Radio Band
definition: Indicates the frequency range, delimited by a lower frequency and an upper frequency, allocated for downlink transmission.

name: Uplink Radio Band
definition: Indicates the frequency range, delimited by a lower frequency and an upper frequency, allocated for uplink transmission.

name: Exchange Capacity
definition: Indicates how many simultaneous calls the base transceiver station can handle.

name: Number Of Transceivers Per Antenna
definition: Indicates the number of transceivers per antenna.

name: Radiated Output Power Per Antenna
definition: Indicates the power of radio waves emitted by each antenna of the base transceiver station.

name: Maximum Number Of Connected RUs
definition: Indicates the maximum number of remote units (RUs) which can be connected to the master unit.

name: Transmission Type
definition: Indicates the data transmission type of the master unit.

name: Transmitted Bandwidth
definition: Indicates the transmitted bandwidth of the master unit.

name: Transmitted Frequency
definition: Indicates the transmitted frequency used by the master unit.

name: Transmitted Signal
definition: Indicates the type or standard of signal transmitted by the master unit.

name: Master Unit Type
definition: Indicates the master unit type.

name: Maximum Number Of Managed BSCs
definition: Indicates the maximum number of base station controller (BSC) that can be managed simultaneously by the mobile switching center (MSC).

name: RRUConnection Type
definition: Indicates the connection type between the remote radio unit and baseband unit.

name: RUConnection Type
definition: Indicate the connection type between the remote unit and the master unit.

name: Left Flange Width
definition: Left flange width of the profile.

name: Right Flange Width
definition: Right flange width of the profile.

name: Overall Depth
definition: Overall depth of the profile.

name: Flange Depth
definition: Flange depth of the profile.

name: Flange Draft
definition: Flange draft of the profile.

name: Flange Chamfer
definition: Flange chamfer of the profile.

name: Flange Base Fillet
definition: Flange base fillet of the profile.

name: Flange Top Fillet
definition: Flange top fillet of the profile.

name: Stem Base Width
definition: Stem base width of the profile.

name: Stem Top Width
definition: Stem top width of the profile.

name: Stem Base Chamfer
definition: Stem base chamfer of the profile.

name: Stem Top Chamfer
definition: Stem top chamfer of the profile.

name: Stem Base Fillet
definition: Stem base fillet of the profile.

name: Stem Top Fillet
definition: Stem top fillet of the profile.

name: Edge Draft
definition: Edge draft of the profile.

name: Draft Base Offset
definition: Draft base offset of the profile.

name: Draft Side Offset
definition: Draft side offset of the profile.

name: Base Chamfer
definition: Base chamfer of the profile.

name: Key Depth
definition: Key depth of the profile.

name: Key Height
definition: Key height of the profile.

name: Key Offset
definition: Key offset of the profile.

name: Bottom Cover
definition: Bottom cover of the profile.

name: Core Spacing
definition: Core spacing of the profile.

name: Core Base Height
definition: Core base height of the profile.

name: Core Middle Height
definition: Core middle height of the profile.

name: Core Top Height
definition: Core top height of the profile.

name: Core Base Width
definition: Core base width of the profile.

name: Core Top Width
definition: Core top width of the profile.

name: Center Core Spacing
definition: Center core spacing of the profile.

name: Center Core Base Height
definition: Center core base height of the profile.

name: Center Core Middle Height
definition: Center core middle height of the profile.

name: Center Core Top Height
definition: Center core top height of the profile.

name: Center Core Base Width
definition: Center core base width of the profile.

name: Center Core Top Width
definition: Center core top width of the profile.

name: Minimum Plate Thickness
definition: This value may be needed for stress analysis and to handle buckling problems. It can also be derived from the given profile geometry or classification and therefore it is only an optional feature allowing for an explicit description. For example measured in mm.

name: Maximum Plate Thickness
definition: This value may be needed for stress analysis and to handle buckling problems. It can also be derived from the given profile geometry or classification and therefore it is only an optional feature allowing for an explicit description. For example measured in mm.

name: Centre Of Gravity In X
definition: Location of the profile's centre of gravity (geometric centroid), measured along xp.

name: Centre Of Gravity In Y
definition: Location of the profile's centre of gravity (geometric centroid), measured along yp.

name: Shear Centre Z
definition: Location of the profile's shear centre, measured along zs.

name: Shear Centre Y
definition: Location of the profile's shear centre, measured along ys.

name: Moment Of Inertia Y
definition: Moment of inertia about ys (second moment of area, about ys). For example measured in mm4.

name: Moment Of Inertia Z
definition: Moment of inertia about zs (second moment of area, about zs). For example measured in mm4

name: Moment Of Inertia YZ
definition: Moment of inertia about ys and zs (product moment of area). For example measured in mm4.

name: Torsional Constant X
definition: Torsional constant about xs. For example measured in mm4.

name: Warping Constant
definition: Warping constant of the profile for torsional action. For example measured in mm6.

name: Shear Deformation Area Z
definition: Area of the profile for calculating the shear deformation due to a shear force parallel to zs. For example measured in mm². If given, the shear deformation area zs shall be non-negative.

name: Shear Deformation Area Y
definition: Area of the profile for calculating the shear deformation due to a shear force parallel to ys. For example measured in mm². If given, the shear deformation area ys shall be non-negative.

name: Maximum Section Modulus Y
definition: Bending resistance about the ys axis at the point with maximum zs ordinate. For example measured in mm³.

name: Minimum Section Modulus Y
definition: Bending resistance about the ys axis at the point with minimum zs ordinate. For example measured in mm³.

name: Maximum Section Modulus Z
definition: Bending resistance about the zs axis at the point with maximum ys ordinate. For example measured in mm³.

name: Minimum Section Modulus Z
definition: Bending resistance about the zs axis at the point with minimum ys ordinate. For example measured in mm³.

name: Torsional Section Modulus
definition: Torsional resistance (about xs). For example measured in mm³.

name: Shear Area Z
definition: Area of the profile for calculating the shear stress due to shear force parallel to the section analysis axis zs. For example measured in mm². If given, the shear area zs shall be non-negative.

name: Shear Area Y
definition: Area of the profile for calculating the shear stress due to shear force parallel to the section analysis axis ys. For example measured in mm². If given, the shear area ys shall be non-negative.

name: Plastic Shape Factor Y
definition: Ratio of plastic versus elastic bending moment capacity about the section analysis axis ys. A dimensionless value.

name: Plastic Shape Factor Z
definition: Ratio of plastic versus elastic bending moment capacity about the section analysis axis zs. A dimensionless value.

name: Electro Magnetic Tripping Unit Type
definition: A list of the available types of electric magnetic tripping unit  from which that required may be selected. These cover overload, none special, short circuit, motor protection and bi-metal tripping.

name: I4
definition: The lower electromagnetic testing current limit in [x In], indicating that for currents lower than I4, the tripping time shall be longer than the associated tripping time, T5, i.e. the device shall not trip instantaneous.

name: I5
definition: The upper electromagnetic testing current limit in [x In], indicating that for currents larger than I5, the tripping time shall be shorter than or equal to the associated tripping time, T5, i.e. the device shall trip instantaneous.

name: T5
definition: The electromagnetic testing time in [s] associated with the testing currents I4 and I5, i.e. electromagnetic tripping time

name: Tripping Unit Release Current
definition: The value of tripping or residual current for which the device has the possibility to be equipped. The values are given in mA.

name: Earth Failure Device Type
definition:
A list of the available types of circuit breaker from which that required may be selected where:Standard: Device that operates without a time delay.
TimeDelayed: Device that operates after a time delay.

name: Usage Time
definition: Total time using the equipment including operating time and idle time.

name: Operating Time
definition: Productive time using the equipment including operating time and excluding idle time.

name: Standard Work
definition: Work that is performed at regular times, up to a particular limit after which overtime rates may apply.

name: Overtime Work
definition: Work that is performed after exceeding a particular limit such as hours per day and/or hours per week, after which company or municipal policy requires a different rate to apply.  Note: Policies for when overtime takes effect are the responsibility of the user or application; they are not modelled in IFC.
